common.speaker: player
common.text: 手术是〈本次术式〉。这是真正按高级手术流程执行的一台大手术，不是比划两下的示范演习。先把准备项目、团队安排和预计时间看完。
common.text_en: The procedure is 〈本次术式〉. This is a full-scale advanced operation executed to exact clinical standards, not a mock drill. Take a look through the prep items, team roster, and estimated duration first.

common.speaker: player
common.text: 全麻期间，你不会清醒地经历手术；院内的特殊复原机制也保障你术后会完全恢复，不会留下任何永久损伤。但手术本身是真刀真枪的——切开、止血、切除、缝合，每一步都会在你身上完整做完。
common.text_en: Under general anesthesia, you won't experience the surgery while awake; our hospital's special recovery mechanism also guarantees you will heal completely afterward with zero permanent damage. However, the operation itself is completely real—incision, hemostasis, resection, and closure will all be carried out on your body from start to finish.

common.speaker: player
common.text: 在落笔之前，你随时可以暂缓。但只要签下名字、扣上腕带，全院的手术室排班和准备流程就会正式锁定，直到手术完成前都不能中途取消。想清楚了吗？
common.text_en: Before you put pen to paper, you are free to put this on hold. But the moment you sign your name and snap on that wristband, the hospital's OR schedule and prep workflow are officially locked—there is no canceling halfway until the surgery is over. Have you thought it through?

doc_sayaka.title: 保健室老师今天也要吓哭
doc_sayaka.title_en: Even the School Nurse Wants to Cry Today

consult.speaker: narrator
consult.text: 小夜香把计划书翻得哗啦作响；最后几页却越翻越慢。
consult.text_en: Sayaka flips through the surgical plan with a crisp rustle; by the last few pages, her fingers slow down.

consult.speaker: patient
consult.text: 我刚才看见‘预计时间’还笑了一下。她们是打算从早上一直把我切开折腾到晚餐时间吗？
consult.text_en: I actually laughed when I first saw the 'Estimated Duration.' Are the girls planning to cut me open and fuss over me from morning all the way till dinnertime?

consult.speaker: player
consult.text: 签字以前还来得及合上文件夹。
consult.text_en: There's still time to close the folder before you sign.

consult.speaker: patient
consult.text: 才不要合上呢。我只是没想到，自己会成为全院一整天的大工程。……好啦，字签好了，腕带也扣上了。同事们明天可别因为我是老师，就省掉哄我的那一句。
consult.text_en: No way am I closing it. I just didn't expect to become the whole hospital's full-day project. ...Alright, signed and wristband snapped on. Make sure our colleagues don't skip the part where they coax me tomorrow just because I'm a teacher.

night.speaker: narrator
night.text: 她一见坂口就坐到床沿，拍了拍身侧，比平日更不肯绕弯。
night.text_en: The moment she sees Sakaguchi, she sits on the edge of the bed and pats the space beside her, even more direct than usual.

night.speaker: patient
night.text: 明天真要做那么大的手术啦。坂口医生，你现在还有最后一次表现的机会。
night.text_en: Tomorrow I'm really having that huge operation. Dr. Sakaguchi, this is your last chance to put on a good performance.

night.speaker: player
night.text: 哪方面？
night.text_en: In what capacity?

night.speaker: patient
night.text: 当我的男朋友呀。今晚别只会说‘全麻很安全’。我今天想要的是你。
night.text_en: As my boyfriend, obviously. Don't just stand there telling me 'general anesthesia is perfectly safe' tonight. What I want today is you.

night.speaker: narrator
night.text: 她拉着他确认没人会突然进来，笑嘻嘻地看他反锁房门、脱去白大褂和所有衣服。她把病号服抛向椅背，褪下粉红色的小内裤，赤着身子钻进被单里，歪着头拍拍身旁的枕头。
night.text_en: She tugs him over to make sure no one will barge in, grinning as she watches him lock the door and strip off his white coat and clothes. She tosses her hospital gown onto the chair back, slips off her pink panties, slides naked under the sheet, and tilts her head while patting the pillow beside her.

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 小夜香脸上还带着红晕，在被单里惬意地打了个滚，一抬头瞥见床头夹着的明日手术准备单，整个人僵住了。
after.text_en: Flushed and glowing, Sayaka rolls around happily in the sheets—until she glances up, spots tomorrow's pre-op prep sheet clipped to the headboard, and freezes.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: ……等一下。我明天干吗来着？
after.text_en: ...Wait a second. What am I doing tomorrow again?

after.speaker: player
after.text: 〈本次术式〉。
after.text_en: 〈本次术式〉.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 啊啊啊！这种时候你一定要回答得这么清楚吗！
after.text_en: Aaaah! Did you have to answer so clearly at a time like this?!

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她猛地拉起被单，只露出一双后悔莫及的眼睛。
after.text_en: She yanks the sheet up, leaving only a pair of resentful eyes peeking out.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 刚才还舒服得什么都忘了，过几个小时我就要戴着帽子光着躺在那张手术台上，全麻睡上十几个小时，肚子里外都要被你们切开折腾一遍！我白天怎么会答应的？谁替我签的字？！
after.text_en: A minute ago I felt so good I forgot everything, and in a few hours I have to put on a cap, lie stark naked on that operating table, sleep under general anesthesia for over ten hours, and have my belly cut open and worked over inside and out! How did I ever agree to this during the day?! Who signed for me?!

after.speaker: player
after.text: 你本人。而且排班表已经锁死了，现在就算哭着找院长也没法取消。
after.text_en: You did, in person. And the OR roster is locked—even if you cried to the Director right now, it can't be canceled.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 那位勇敢签字的女士现在已经下班了！她强烈要求撤回申请！
after.text_en: That brave lady who signed her name has clocked out for the night! She strongly demands to withdraw her application!

after.speaker: player
after.text: 驳回。明早八点护士准时来推床。
after.text_en: Request denied. The nurses will be here with the gurney at eight sharp tomorrow morning.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 呜……你好狠的心！刚睡完女朋友，转头就摆出主刀医生的脸孔！
after.text_en: Uu... You're so heartless! You just finished sleeping with your girlfriend, and now you put your attending surgeon face right back on!

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她抓起内裤和患者服，犹豫半天，又啪地扔回床尾。
after.text_en: She grabs her panties and patient gown, hesitates for a long moment, then slaps them back onto the foot of the bed.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 反正逃不掉了是吧？那我今晚干脆不穿了！明天她们横竖还要把我扒光做准备，我就这么光着等到早上好了！她们要推我上台，就从被窝里直接推！
after.text_en: There's no escaping it anyway, right? Then I'm not putting them back on tonight! They're going to strip me bare for prep tomorrow morning either way, so I'll just stay naked until morning! If they want to wheel me onto the table, they can wheel me straight out of these covers!

after.speaker: player
after.text: ……你要我现在去借一辆推床？
after.text_en: ...Want me to go borrow a gurney right now?

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 你敢！
after.text_en: Don't you dare!

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她笑得打嗝，随即眼圈忽然红了，手腕上的塑料腕带蹭着被角。
after.text_en: She laughs until she hiccups, then her eyes suddenly turn red as the plastic wristband brushes against the corner of the duvet.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 真讨厌。明明知道全麻会睡过去，也知道过两天就能像没事人一样活蹦乱跳，可一想到明天真的要挨那么大的刀，连逃跑都不行了……为什么我还是怕得想哭？
after.text_en: This isn't fair. I know I'll be asleep under general anesthesia, and I know I'll be bouncing around good as new in a couple of days, but when I think about actually taking such a big knife tomorrow with zero chance of running away... why am I still so scared I want to cry?

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她一把将他的手拉进被单，死死按在自己胸口。
after.text_en: She pulls his hand under the sheet and presses it tightly against her bare chest.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 先别讲道理。既然不准我当逃兵，今晚就得让我耍赖到底，天亮以后我再给你当乖患者。
after.text_en: Don't give me a sensible answer yet. Since you won't let me desert, you have to let me be completely unreasonable tonight—I'll go back to being an obedient patient after sunrise.

success.speaker: patient
success.text: 你知道吗？她们推我进手术室的时候，我差点把床栏杆攥出印子来，脑子里全在喊‘老师不想进去’。现在平安醒过来一想，前天晚上我光着身子把内裤扔到床尾、还哭着求你撤回申请的样子，实在太丢人啦！
success.text_en: You know what? When the girls were wheeling me into the OR, I nearly left fingernail marks in the side rails, screaming 'Teacher doesn't want to go in!' inside my head. Now that I'm awake in one piece, thinking back to how I threw my panties to the foot of the bed naked and cried for you to cancel my application two nights ago... it's way too embarrassing!

success.speaker: player
success.text: 当时是谁说‘那位勇敢的女士已经下班了’？
success.text_en: Who was it that said 'that brave lady has clocked out for the night'?

success.speaker: patient
success.text: 不许学我！……不过嘛，想起那天晚上在被窝里被你抱得那么紧、弄得浑身发软的滋味，哪怕后来真的挨了十几个小时的刀，现在心里居然还甜滋滋的。来，告诉我最难的步骤是怎么过去的吧。
success.text_en: No quoting me! ...Still, when I remember how tightly you held me under the covers that night and made me go weak all over, even after taking the knife for over ten hours, my heart still feels all warm and sweet. Come on, tell me how you got past the hardest step.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 你看！我就说前天晚上我看着准备单眼皮直跳、哭着想当逃兵是有先见之明的吧！结果还真没按计划做完！
failure.text_en: See! I told you my eyelid was twitching when I looked at the prep sheet two nights ago! Crying to desert was pure foresight—we really didn't finish as planned!

failure.speaker: player
failure.text: 我会如实复盘。没有不可逆的伤害，但这次确实是我没达成目标。
failure.text_en: I'll give you a full, honest debriefing. There's no irreversible harm, but I did fail to reach the target this time.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 哼，坂口医生，你老实交代——是不是手术前一天晚上在床上把我折腾得太狠，把你自己的腰力和精力全榨干了，第二天站在手术台上才手软的呀？
failure.text_en: Hmph. Confess, Dr. Sakaguchi—did you wear me out so hard in bed the night before surgery that you drained all your own stamina and waist strength, and that's why your hands went soft at the operating table the next day?

failure.speaker: narrator
failure.text: 她用手指戳了戳坂口的手背，见他神色认真，又噗嗤一声笑出来，脸颊微红地拉住他的手。
failure.text_en: She pokes the back of Sakaguchi's hand with her finger; seeing his serious expression, she bursts into a giggle and blushes, lacing her fingers with his.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 好啦，逗你的。虽然手术没做成有点小失落，但一想起前天晚上被你摸遍全身、顶到最里面去了好几次的滋味……这顿刀挨得也算值回票价啦。把报告拿来吧，你的小患者听得懂。
failure.text_en: Alright, I'm just teasing you. Even though falling short is a little disappointing, whenever I think back to how you touched every inch of me two nights ago and drove all the way to my deepest spot until I came again and again... taking this knife was still well worth the ticket price. Hand over the report—your little patient can handle it.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 看，患者已经乖乖躺好。接下来可不是给你做术前核对的时候。
dark.text_en: See? The patient is lying down nice and obediently. And right now is definitely not the time for a surgical time-out.

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 他靠近亲吻。灯光压暗；两人在床上紧紧相拥。
dark.text_en: He leans in to kiss her. The lights dim as the two embrace closely on the bed.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 你怎么真的一脸认真呀……会害羞的！
dark.text_en: Why are you looking at me with such a serious face... You're making me blush!

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: ……嗯。再亲一下。这回不许叫我老师。
dark.text_en: ...Mmn. Kiss me again. And no calling me 'Teacher' tonight.

dark.speaker: player
dark.text: 小夜香。
dark.text_en: Sayaka.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 啊……这样叫就对了。
dark.text_en: Ah... That's how you should call me.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 我刚才还在吓得要命，奇怪，现在倒想笑。
dark.text_en: I was scared out of my wits a minute ago—funny how I feel like laughing now.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 喂，别停下来说医嘱……今晚我们不是医生和患者。
dark.text_en: Hey, don't stop to give medical instructions... Tonight we aren't doctor and patient.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 嗯……靠过来嘛。让我再撒一会儿娇。
dark.text_en: Nnh... Come closer. Let me spoil myself a little longer.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 真好。要是今晚能不结束就好了。
dark.text_en: This feels so good. I wish tonight would never end.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 你的小患者这么乖，明天要躺上去让你真刀真枪地开大手术，今晚是不是该用你这里好好疼我一下？
dark.text_en: Your little patient is being so good, lying down on the table tomorrow so you can perform a real major surgery on her—shouldn't you use what's down here to give me a proper reward tonight?

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 啊、啊……！进来吧，我要你……快一点……！
dark.text_en: Ah, aah...!! Come inside, I want you... Hurry...!!

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 画面完全黑下，时间经过。再亮时，床沿落着她先前扔下的病号服和内裤。
dark.text_en: The screen fades completely to black as time passes. When the light returns, the hospital gown and panties she tossed aside earlier are draped across the edge of the bed.

doc_serika.title: 她看不见的十几个小时
doc_serika.title_en: The Ten-Plus Hours She Cannot See

consult.speaker: narrator
consult.text: 芹香盯着患者腕带，绕着自己手腕转了一整圈。桌上的影像报告始终没被翻开。
consult.text_en: Serika stares at the patient wristband, turning it a full circle around her wrist. The imaging reports on the desk remain unopened.

consult.speaker: patient
consult.text: 这几天我已经把资料读熟了。可是腕带一扣上，连退路都被锁死的时候，我忽然发现……原来这次我真的不是来给你们看影像的。
consult.text_en: I've memorized the files over the past few days. Yet the moment this wristband snapped shut and locked away every exit, it suddenly hit me... I really am not here to read scans for you this time.

consult.speaker: player
consult.text: 现在签字，明天的排程就彻底定下来了。
consult.text_en: Once you sign now, tomorrow's schedule is set in stone.

consult.speaker: patient
consult.text: 嗯，我不改。只是别在我面前说‘你反正看得懂’，那会让我更想逞强。
consult.text_en: Yes, I'm not changing my mind. Just don't say 'you understand the procedure anyway' in front of me—that'll only make me try harder to act tough.

night.speaker: narrator
night.text: 芹香坐在窗边，单手握着那杯一直没喝的水。坂口进来，她不看他，先说了一句。
night.text_en: Serika sits by the window, holding a glass of water she hasn't touched in one hand. When Sakaguchi enters, she speaks before looking up at him.

night.speaker: patient
night.text: 今晚别问我看出什么了。让我什么也不用判断一会儿。
night.text_en: Don't ask me what I've diagnosed tonight. Let me go a little while without having to judge anything.

night.speaker: player
night.text: 那我坐在你旁边？
night.text_en: May I sit beside you?

night.speaker: patient
night.text: 坐近一点。……我好不容易才忍住没有去值班，跑回病房等你。
night.text_en: Sit closer. ...It took everything I had not to sneak back to the reading room on duty instead of waiting for you in this ward.

night.speaker: narrator
night.text: 她看他关门，轻声确认锁舌扣好。坂口脱下白大褂与衣物。芹香背过身解开病号服，褪下素雅的浅蓝色内衣与内裤，整整齐齐叠在床头小柜旁；她下意识用手臂遮了遮胸口，随即自己掀开被单，红着耳根让他坐进来。
night.text_en: She watches him close the door, quietly making sure the latch clicks shut. Sakaguchi removes his white coat and clothes. Turning her back, Serika unbuttons her hospital gown and slips off her simple pale-blue bra and panties, folding them neatly beside the nightstand; she instinctively crosses an arm over her chest, then lifts the sheet herself, ears burning as she invites him in.

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 芹香眼角还带着潮湿的红意，正背对坂口慢慢拉好被单，平复着微乱的呼吸。病房外突然传来担架车轮经过地砖缝的轻响。
after.text_en: With damp redness still lingering at the corners of her eyes, Serika faces away from Sakaguchi as she slowly pulls up the sheet, steadying her uneven breaths. Outside the room, the faint click of gurney wheels rolling over floor tiles echoes down the hall.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: ……那是什么声音？
after.text_en: ...What was that sound?

after.speaker: player
after.text: 夜班推床。
after.text_en: A night-shift gurney.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 啊。……那我明早也会听见这个吧。
after.text_en: Ah. ...I'll be hearing that tomorrow morning too, won't I.

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她试图接着说句玩笑，声音却卡住。
after.text_en: She tries to follow up with a joke, but her voice catches.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 刚才被你抱着的时候，连一秒钟都觉得好清楚。可是明天……他们会给我全麻，然后真刀真枪地切开十几个小时。对患者来说，一闭眼一睁眼；对站在手术台边的你们来说，却是大半天。怎么感觉全医院偷偷过了那么久，只有我被按下了暂停键？
after.text_en: When you were holding me just now, every single second felt so vivid. Yet tomorrow... they'll put me under general anesthesia and cut me open for real for over ten hours. To the patient, it's closing her eyes and opening them; to all of you standing around the operating table, it's more than half a day. Why does it feel like the whole hospital is secretly living through all those hours while only I get paused?

after.speaker: player
after.text: 你在害怕失去那段时间？
after.text_en: Are you afraid of losing that time?

after.speaker: patient
after.text: ……我不知道。如果现在还没签字，我说不定会偷偷溜回读片室躲起来。可是腕带已经扣上了，明天就算再怕也必须躺上去。
after.text_en: ...I don't know. If I hadn't signed my name already, I might have snuck back to the reading room to hide. But the wristband is locked on, so no matter how scared I am tomorrow, I have to lie down on that table.

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她把椅背上的病服扯下来，又看了看滑落在地毯上的内裤，摊在膝上好半天没有穿。
after.text_en: She pulls the hospital gown off the chair back, glances at her panties on the carpet, and leaves the gown spread across her knees for a long time without putting it on.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 刚才我明明只顾得上抓着你，什么答案都不需要。现在明明知道没有任何后遗症，我却连把病号服穿回去都不敢……好像一穿上，就等于承认明早真的逃不掉了。
after.text_en: A little while ago, all I cared about was holding onto you, needing no answers at all. Now, even knowing there won't be any permanent harm, I don't even dare put this gown back on... as if putting it on means admitting there's really no escaping tomorrow morning.

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她突然很不讲理地瞪着他，把病号服往旁边一推，重新赤着身子缩回他怀里。
after.text_en: She suddenly glares at him unreasonably, shoves the hospital gown aside, and curls back into his arms stark naked.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 今晚我不穿了。反正明早她们还得按流程给我换装准备……等手术结束，醒来时你要亲口对我说‘我在’，好不好？别拿着报告站在床尾，像在交片子。
after.text_en: I'm not putting it on tonight. They have to change and prep me per protocol tomorrow morning anyway... When the surgery is over and I wake up, will you tell me 'I'm here' in your own voice? Don't just stand at the foot of the bed holding a chart like you're delivering film scans.

after.speaker: player
after.text: 我会在。
after.text_en: I'll be right here.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 嗯。……如果明早我抓住护士的袖子不想上推床，你别马上笑我。
after.text_en: Mmn. ...And if I grab the nurse's sleeve tomorrow morning and refuse to get on the gurney, don't laugh at me right away.

success.speaker: patient
success.text: 原来十几个小时真的会这样消失。我刚醒来还以为麻醉没有开始……现在回想起来，手术前夜我听见走廊推床声就吓得不敢穿衣服、光着身子缩在你怀里耍赖的样子，实在有点太没出息了。
success.text_en: So ten-plus hours really can vanish just like that. When I first woke up, I thought the anesthesia hadn't even started... Looking back now, hearing a gurney in the hall on the night before surgery and getting so scared I refused to put my clothes on, curling up naked in your arms throwing a tantrum—that was way too pathetic of me.

success.speaker: player
success.text: 做完了，结果很好。而且我一直都在。
success.text_en: It's all done, and the result is excellent. And I was right here the whole time.

success.speaker: patient
success.text: ……嗯，我一睁眼就看见你了。其实全麻闭上眼之前，我脑子里想的全是前天夜里被你抱紧、填得满满的温度……有那个记在身体里，十几个小时的空白好像也没那么可怕了。现在，可以把报告给我了。
success.text_en: ...Yes, you were the first thing I saw when I opened my eyes. Truth is, right before my eyes closed under anesthesia, all I could think about was the warmth of being held so tightly and filled to the brim by you two nights ago... With that memory in my body, those ten-plus blank hours didn't feel so frightening after all. You can hand me the report now.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 我醒过来第一句话，居然是‘是不是还没开始’。结果是已经结束，而且没按计划完成……看来前天夜里我听见推床声就觉得心慌、想溜回读片室躲起来，也不完全是胡思乱想。
failure.text_en: The first thing I said when I woke up was actually 'Has it not started yet?' Only to find out it's already over, and didn't finish as planned... Looks like my heart racing when I heard the gurney two nights ago and wanting to hide in the reading room wasn't entirely my imagination.

failure.speaker: player
failure.text: 抱歉，我会把发生的事全部说明。
failure.text_en: I'm sorry. I'll walk you through everything that happened.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 别露出那种表情……如果非要找原因的话，大概是因为术前那天晚上，主刀医生在病房里只顾着欺负患者、把力气全花在床上了吧？
failure.text_en: Don't make that face... If we have to assign blame, maybe it's because on the night before surgery, the attending surgeon spent all his energy bullying his patient in bed instead of saving his strength?

failure.speaker: narrator
failure.text: 她极其罕见地开了一句冷幽默的玩笑，耳根随之漫上一层薄红，指尖轻轻勾住坂口的手指。
failure.text_en: She cracks an extraordinarily rare deadpan joke, the tips of her ears turning pink as her fingertips lightly hook around Sakaguchi's.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: ……不过，我不后悔签那个字。前天夜里你进入我最深处的时候，我是真的很安心、很舒服。光是为了那个晚上，躺上这张手术台也值得了。来吧，把手术记录念给我听。
failure.text_en: ...Still, I don't regret signing that form. When you came into my deepest place two nights ago, I felt genuinely safe and wonderful. For that night alone, lying on this operating table was worth it. Go ahead—read me the operative note.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 别看我手在抖。现在不是因为明天……是因为你。
dark.text_en: Don't look at my hands shaking. Right now it isn't because of tomorrow... it's because of you.

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 灯暗。他们互相拥吻，发烫的皮肤在被单下紧密相贴。
dark.text_en: The lights dim. They kiss and embrace, hot skin pressing flush beneath the covers.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: ……我刚才差点说‘谢谢医生’。真丢脸。
dark.text_en: ...I almost said 'thank you, Doctor' just now. How embarrassing.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 隆司。嗯……这样叫可以吗？
dark.text_en: Takashi. Mmn... Is it okay if I call you that?

dark.speaker: player
dark.text: 再叫一次。
dark.text_en: Say it again.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 隆司……你真会使坏。……唔、手指别突然碰那里……
dark.text_en: Takashi... You're being mean. ...Nnh, don't touch right there all of a sudden...

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 哈啊……先别笑我。让我靠着你……再抱紧一点。
dark.text_en: Haah... Don't laugh at me yet. Let me lean on you... hold me tighter.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 很奇怪，我这会儿什么也不想知道……只想让你进到最里面来，让我知道你真的在这儿。
dark.text_en: It's strange. Right now I don't want to know anything... I just want you to come all the way inside me so I know you're really here.

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 坂口沉下身，缓缓与她融为一体。芹香猛地抓紧他的肩膀，仰起脖颈漏出细碎而压抑的鼻音。
dark.text_en: Sakaguchi lowers himself, slowly uniting with her. Serika clutches his shoulders tightly, tilting her neck back with muffled, breathless whimpers.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 啊……！嗯、唔……隆司……好深……里面被填得满满的……
dark.text_en: Ah...! Nnh, mmn... Takashi... So deep... You're filling me up completely...

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 别停……再重一点也没关系……啊、哈啊……隆司、隆司……！要、要去了……唔啊啊……！
dark.text_en: Don't stop... It's okay if you're a little rougher... Ah, haah... Takashi, Takashi...! I-I'm coming... mmaah...!

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 窗外的路灯暗了又亮；彻底黑屏、时间跳过。再亮时，床头小柜旁那叠素色内衣已经有一半滑落到了地毯上。
dark.text_en: The streetlight outside the window dims and brightens; the screen fades completely to black as time skips forward. When the light returns, half of the neatly folded pale-blue underwear beside the nightstand has slipped onto the carpet.

doc_emiko.title: 一份没有指挥权的病假
doc_emiko.title_en: A Sick Leave Without Command Authority

consult.speaker: narrator
consult.text: 御堂发现自己不在团队名单任何一栏，差点伸手去改。
consult.text_en: Discovering her name is absent from every single slot on the surgical team roster, Mido nearly reaches out to edit it.

consult.speaker: patient
consult.text: 空得令人心烦。这个团队，我连一个职位都没有？
consult.text_en: An irritatingly empty roster. I don't hold a single position on this team?

consult.speaker: player
consult.text: 你是患者。而且一旦签字，明天就算你在手术室门口发脾气，也没法把主刀位置抢回去。
consult.text_en: You're the patient. And once you sign, even if you lose your temper at the OR doors tomorrow, you can't take back the lead surgeon's spot.

consult.speaker: patient
consult.text: 我看见了！……你最好别露出那种终于轮到我闭嘴的表情。签字拿来。
consult.text_en: I can see that! ...You'd better wipe off that look that says you finally get to make me shut up. Hand me the signature page.

night.speaker: narrator
night.text: 她把工作通讯器摁灭，放进抽屉，像在处理什么危险物品。
night.text_en: She switches off her work communicator and shuts it inside the drawer as if disposing of hazardous material.

night.speaker: patient
night.text: 今晚一项指令：你不能在床上讲手术计划。
night.text_en: One standing order for tonight: you are forbidden from discussing surgical plans in bed.

night.speaker: player
night.text: 既然是指令，我可以申请撤销吗？
night.text_en: Since it's an order, may I file an appeal?

night.speaker: patient
night.text: 不批准。今晚我想和你做恋人，不想成为你的会诊对象。
night.text_en: Appeal denied. Tonight I want to be your lover, not your consultation subject.

night.speaker: narrator
night.text: 她亲手把门锁扣上，回身见坂口还穿着白大褂，不耐烦地指了指。
night.text_en: She clicks the door lock shut herself; turning around to see Sakaguchi still wearing his white coat, she points at it impatiently.

night.speaker: patient
night.text: 那个也脱掉。别让我在自己病房里像在接受主任检查。
night.text_en: Take that off too. Don't make me feel like I'm undergoing a department chief's inspection in my own ward.

night.speaker: narrator
night.text: 他换下全部衣服。御堂干脆利落地解开病服，脱下黑色蕾丝边的胸罩与内裤放到一边，一丝不挂地端坐在床中央；她忽然觉得这个姿势滑稽，耳根发热，伸手一把将他拉下来。
night.text_en: He removes all his clothes. Mido crisply unbuttons her patient gown, takes off her black lace-trimmed bra and panties, sets them aside, and sits upright in the center of the bed stark naked; suddenly finding her own posture ridiculous, her ears warm, and she reaches out to pull him down.

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 御堂浑身发软地靠在床头，胸口还残留着激烈的余喘，久久没有穿回衣服，正试图恢复往日冷静。墙上的钟“嗒”地跳了一格。
after.text_en: Limply leaning against the headboard with residual tremors in her chest, Mido makes no move to dress for a long while, trying to regain her usual composure. The wall clock ticks forward a notch.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: ……我突然想到一个不能接受的事实。
after.text_en: ...I've just realized an unacceptable fact.

after.speaker: player
after.text: 什么？
after.text_en: Which is?

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 刚才在你身下的时候，我连自己的声音都控制不住；而明天我一旦全麻，十几个小时内更是连一句‘暂停’都发不出来！一个习惯负责最后决断的外科医长，竟然要变成躺在台上一句话也说不了、任人切开缝合的患者。
after.text_en: Beneath you just now, I couldn't even control my own voice; and tomorrow, once I'm under general anesthesia, I won't even be able to utter a single 'hold' for over ten hours! A surgical chief accustomed to making the final call is about to become a patient lying on the table unable to say a word while being cut open and sutured.

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她烦躁地扯了一下被角，遮住身上的吻痕。
after.text_en: Irritated, she tugs the corner of the duvet up to cover the kiss marks on her skin.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 说是有复原保障，睡一觉起来就能恢复如初。那又怎么样？我现在仅仅因为想到明早护士要替我戴帽子、摆体位、插管消毒，而且日程已经锁死不能取消，就想从这张床上逃走！
after.text_en: They say there's a recovery guarantee, that I'll wake up good as new. So what? Just thinking about the nurses putting a cap on me, positioning my limbs, catheterizing and prepping me tomorrow morning—with the schedule locked so I can't even cancel—makes me want to bolt from this bed right now!

after.speaker: player
after.text: 可惜御堂医生下午自己签了字，现在连院长也没法给你批退院手续。
after.text_en: Too bad Dr. Mido signed the form herself this afternoon. Even the Director can't approve a discharge for you now.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 要你提醒！我害怕，但我没有撤回决定的打算！
after.text_en: I don't need your reminder! I'm scared, but I have no intention of revoking my decision!

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 沉默片刻，她盯着地上的病服和黑色内裤。
after.text_en: After a brief silence, she glares at the hospital gown and black panties on the floor.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: ……患者御堂江美子现决定，从此刻起停止配合一切非必要着装。反正天亮她们还得把我重新准备一遍，我就这么光着在被子里待命！
after.text_en: ...Patient Emiko Mido hereby declares that effective immediately, she is ceasing cooperation with all non-essential attire. Since they have to prep me from scratch at dawn anyway, I shall remain on standby naked under these covers!

after.speaker: player
after.text: 这是正式公告？
after.text_en: Is that an official bulletin?

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 不是！……这是我在床上跟你耍赖发脾气。你连这种事都看不出来？
after.text_en: No! ...It's me acting spoiled and throwing a tantrum in bed with you. Can't you even tell that much?

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她重新拉住他的手，指尖有些发凉。
after.text_en: She takes his hand again; her fingertips are cool.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 明早我万一黑着脸说‘别碰我’，请先问我究竟是在怕什么。不要让所有人以为我只会骂人。
after.text_en: If I scowl and say 'don't touch me' tomorrow morning, ask me what I'm actually afraid of first. Don't let everyone assume I only know how to bark orders.

success.speaker: patient
success.text: 手术成绩不错。……至于术前那天晚上，我光着身子在被窝里说什么‘停止配合一切非必要着装’、还嚷嚷着想从床上逃走的事，命令你立刻从脑子里删掉。
success.text_en: A respectable surgical score. ...As for the night before surgery, when I sat naked under the covers declaring I was 'ceasing cooperation with all non-essential attire' and threatening to bolt from the bed—I order you to delete that from your memory immediately.

success.speaker: player
success.text: 当时御堂医长在床上耍赖的样子，其实挺少见的。
success.text_en: Seeing Chief Mido act spoiled in bed was actually quite a rare treat.

success.speaker: patient
success.text: 闭嘴！……不过，那天夜里把指挥权彻底交给你、在你身下什么都不用管的滋味……确实好得让人上瘾。看在你在床上和手术台上都表现合格的份上，这次就不扣你分了。
success.text_en: Shut up! ...Still, handing over command completely to you that night and not having to manage a single thing beneath you... felt addictively good. Since you performed up to standard both in bed and at the operating table, I won't deduct any points from you this time.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 我就知道！术前那天晚上我心里莫名烦躁、总觉得把指挥权全交出去不踏实，果然在台上出岔子了吧！
failure.text_en: I knew it! On the night before surgery, I felt inexplicably restless handing over all command authority—and sure enough, something went sideways on the table!

failure.speaker: player
failure.text: 决策链和终止节点我都记下来了，这次是我的责任。
failure.text_en: I've logged the decision chain and termination point. The responsibility for this one is mine.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 当然是你的责任！我倒要问问你，坂口隆司——是不是术前夜在病房里按着我做得太起劲，只顾着在床上顶到最里面让我求饶，结果第二天拿手术刀的时候手腕没力气了？
failure.text_en: Of course it's yours! In fact, I'd like to interrogate you, Takashi Sakaguchi—did you get so carried away pressing me into the mattress the night before surgery, focusing entirely on driving into my deepest spot until I begged, that your wrists ran out of strength when holding the scalpel the next day?

failure.speaker: narrator
failure.text: 她冷哼一声别过脸，耳尖却隐隐泛红，半晌才伸手拽住他的衣袖。
failure.text_en: She lets out a cool snort and turns her head away, though the tips of her ears flush pink before she reaches out to tug his sleeve.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: ……算了。专业上我认可你们的止损，而且回想起来，前天晚上被你抱在怀里弄得一塌糊涂的快感……倒也值得我陪你挨这一刀。把复盘报告拿来吧。
failure.text_en: ...Forget it. Professionally, I approve of the call to abort safely; and looking back, the pleasure of being held in your arms and thoroughly undone two nights ago... was worth taking this knife for you. Hand over the debriefing report.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 我没有发下一步命令。你应该明白现在可以亲我了。
dark.text_en: I haven't issued the next command. You should be smart enough to know you can kiss me now.

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 床头灯渐暗，唇齿交缠间，平时威严的外科前辈呼吸渐渐乱了节奏。
dark.text_en: The bedside lamp dims; as their lips entangle, the usually commanding senior surgeon's breathing gradually loses its composure.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: ……嗯。刚才那句不是命令……手、手可以再往下一点。
dark.text_en: ...Mmn. That last line wasn't an order... Your hand—you can move it lower.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 再近些。啊……不用请示……我都已经这样躺在你面前了。
dark.text_en: Closer. Ah... Stop asking for permission... I'm already lying bare in front of you like this.

dark.speaker: player
dark.text: 江美子，我想你。
dark.text_en: Emiko, I want you.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: ……你总算说了一句合格的话。……唔、那里已经湿了，别光用手指试探我！
dark.text_en: ...Finally, a satisfactory line out of you. ...Nnh, I'm already wet down there, so stop just testing me with your fingers!

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 今天我不想当那个永远知道怎么办的人……快点进来，让我什么都别管……
dark.text_en: Tonight I don't want to be the one who always knows what to do... Hurry up and come inside me, let me forget about managing anything...

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 当坂口挺身深入的瞬间，御堂倒吸一口凉气，原本端正的腰线骤然弓起，双臂死死箍住他的后背。
dark.text_en: The instant Sakaguchi drives deep inside her, Mido sucks in a sharp breath, her poised waistline arching tautly as both arms lock around his back.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 啊——！哈啊、唔……！好烫……一上来就顶到最里面……你这是在报复我平时训你吗……！
dark.text_en: Aah—! Haah, mmn...! So hot... Hitting the deepest spot right from the start... Are you getting back at me for lecturing you at work...?!

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 不、不要停……就这样用力抱紧我……！啊、嗯……隆司……我不逞强了、要去了……啊啊……！
dark.text_en: D-Don't stop... Just hold me tight like this...! Ah, nnh... Takashi... I won't act tough anymore, I'm coming... aah...!

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 彻底黑屏，钟表前移。床边那套黑色贴身衣物被散乱的病号服半掩着。
dark.text_en: The screen fades completely to black as the clock advances. Beside the bed, her black lingerie lies half-covered by the crumpled hospital gown.

consult.speaker: narrator
consult.text: 佳織在页边写了三个问题，问完又在空白处划了第四条：‘为什么明知签了字就不能退货，我还是想跑？’
consult.text_en: Kaori jots down three questions in the margin, asks them all, then scribbles a fourth line in the blank space: *'Why do I want to run away right now even knowing there's no refund after signing?'*

consult.speaker: patient
consult.text: 我可以把第四条也当成正式提问吗？
consult.text_en: Can I count item four as an official question too?

consult.speaker: player
consult.text: 当然。不过只要你签下去，明天就算想跑也会被推床截回来。
consult.text_en: Sure. Though once you sign, even if you try to run tomorrow, the gurney team will intercept you.

consult.speaker: patient
consult.text: 那就好。要是留着退路，我今晚肯定会纠结到天亮。……签好了，虽然我接下来肯定会后悔好几个小时。
consult.text_en: Good. If you left me an exit, I'd definitely agonize over it until sunrise. ...Signed! Even though I'm 100% going to regret this for the next several hours.

night.speaker: narrator
night.text: 她像商量一件不容置疑的正事那样，把坂口领到门边。
night.text_en: As if discussing an indisputable clinical matter, she leads Sakaguchi to the door.

night.speaker: patient
night.text: 我想了一整天，找到一个临时疗法。今夜你留在这里陪我，别再翻病历。
night.text_en: I've thought about it all day and came up with a temporary therapy. Stay here with me tonight, and stop flipping through charts.

night.speaker: player
night.text: 有什么疗效？
night.text_en: What's the expected efficacy?

night.speaker: patient
night.text: 不保证效果。我只是想和我喜欢的人亲热一晚——轮到我能不能少追问一次？
night.text_en: No guaranteed efficacy. I just want to spend a passionate night with the man I love—can't you spare me the follow-up questions when it's my turn?

night.speaker: narrator
night.text: 坂口笑着关门落锁，脱掉白大褂与衣服。佳織把病服解开，连同简洁的白色纯棉内衣裤一起扔到床脚，难得大胆地赤身率先躺下，红着脸拍拍枕头示意他过来。
night.text_en: Smiling, Sakaguchi locks the door and strips off his white coat and clothes. Kaori unbuttons her hospital gown and tosses it along with her simple white cotton bra and panties to the foot of the bed, lying down naked first with rare boldness and patting the pillow with a flushed face.

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 佳織浑身汗津津地窝在被单里，舒坦地伸了个懒腰，突然爆发出一声绝望的笑。
after.text_en: Sweaty and languid under the sheet, Kaori stretches comfortably—then suddenly bursts into a laugh of pure despair.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 坏了。疗法有严重反跳。
after.text_en: Uh-oh. The therapy has a severe rebound effect.

after.speaker: player
after.text: 什么反跳？
after.text_en: What kind of rebound?

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 刚才到顶峰的时候，我一度把明天的〈本次术式〉忘得干干净净！现在脑子一清醒，想到明天要全麻十几个小时，真刀真枪地切开、止血、再缝起来，而且已经签了字不能反悔——我真想跳窗。啊，当然只是说说！
after.text_en: While I was climaxing just now, I completely forgot about tomorrow's 〈本次术式〉! Now that my head is clear again, thinking about ten-plus hours of general anesthesia, being cut open for real, bleeding, and being sewed back up with my signature locked in so I can't back out—I seriously want to jump out the window. Ah, figuratively speaking, of course!

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她用枕头敲了一下自己的额头。
after.text_en: She bonks her own forehead with the pillow.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 我太懂那台手术每一层要切哪里了。懂得越多，越想让自己直接失忆到明天晚上。
after.text_en: I know every single layer that surgery cuts through way too well. The more I know, the more I wish I could induce amnesia until tomorrow night.

after.speaker: player
after.text: 至少全麻的时候，你不会感觉到那段时间。
after.text_en: At least under general anesthesia, you won't feel those hours passing.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 对，所以我该欢呼吗？‘太好了，我要丢掉十几个小时的意识，躺着被大家开膛破肚啦’？
after.text_en: Right, so am I supposed to cheer? 'Hooray, I get to lose ten-plus hours of consciousness while everyone opens up my torso'?

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她转头看到床脚的内裤和病服，突然理直气壮地把光溜溜的肩膀缩进被窝。
after.text_en: Spotting her panties and hospital gown at the foot of the bed, she self-righteously tucks her bare shoulders back under the covers.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 今晚我不穿回去了。明早同事们反正要替我换装、检查、做准备。既然已经没有取消这个选项了，不如把我当成已经开始候台的全裸患者！
after.text_en: I'm not putting them back on tonight. Our colleagues have to change, inspect, and prep me tomorrow morning anyway. Since canceling isn't an option anymore, you might as well treat me as a stark-naked patient who's already entered pre-op standby!

after.speaker: player
after.text: 现在还没到候台时间。
after.text_en: Standby hours haven't started yet.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 你少在我的疗程里挑错！
after.text_en: Stop nitpicking my treatment regimen!

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 两人笑到一半，她忽然垂下头。
after.text_en: Halfway through their laughter, she suddenly lowers her head.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: ……我是真的怕。不是怕丢脸，也不是怕你手艺差。就是想到自己躺在那儿，浑身都不听使唤，连喊停都不可能。
after.text_en: ...I really am scared. Not of losing face, and not of your surgical skill. Just the thought of lying there completely unable to move or call a stop.

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她将额头靠在他肩上。
after.text_en: She rests her forehead against his shoulder.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 陪我再坐一会儿吧。病人还没准备好回到现实。
after.text_en: Sit with me a little longer. The patient isn't ready to return to reality yet.

success.speaker: patient
success.text: 报告先放一边。我现在清醒过来，一想到前天晚上自己用枕头敲脑门、嚷嚷着想跳窗，还把内裤踢到床脚赖着不穿的样子，真是恨不得找个地缝钻进去……
success.text_en: Set the report aside for a second. Now that I'm wide awake, remembering how I bonked my head with a pillow two nights ago yelling about jumping out the window, and kicked my panties to the foot of the bed refusing to dress... I wish I could crawl into a hole!

success.speaker: player
success.text: 那套‘临时疗法’最后评价如何？
success.text_en: And what's your final clinical evaluation of that 'temporary therapy'?

success.speaker: patient
success.text: 疗效超标了！直到昨天上台吸氧气的时候，我身体里好像还留着被你烫熟的温度。现在想看报告了——不过先容我得意十秒钟，我居然真的没当逃兵。
success.text_en: Efficacy exceeded all expectations! Right up until they put the oxygen mask over my face on the table yesterday, my body still felt like it was holding onto the heat of you filling me up. Now I'm ready to see the report—right after you let me gloat for ten seconds that I didn't desert!

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 我就说前天夜里我的‘疗法反跳’是一种临床预警吧！当时心里直打鼓，结果真在关键步骤上卡住了！
failure.text_en: I told you my 'therapy rebound' two nights ago was a clinical warning sign! My heart was drumming like crazy back then, and sure enough, we hit a snag at a critical step!

failure.speaker: player
failure.text: 确实是在关键节点出了变数，我来给你复盘。
failure.text_en: We did run into a variable at a key juncture. Let me walk you through the debriefing.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 复盘之前我先合理怀疑一下——坂口主刀，你是不是手术前夜在我的病床上表现得太卖力，把我喂饱了，结果把你自己的专注力全消耗在我的被窝里了？
failure.text_en: Before we debrief, allow me to raise a reasonable suspicion—Lead Surgeon Sakaguchi, did you work so hard in my hospital bed the night before surgery satisfying me that you burned through all your own focus under my covers?

failure.speaker: narrator
failure.text: 她曲起手指弹了一下他的袖口，随即自己红着脸轻叹一口气，靠回枕头上。
failure.text_en: She flicks his cuff with her finger, then blushes and lets out a soft sigh, leaning back against the pillow.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 算啦。虽然手术没完成让人很不甘心，但前天晚上被你摸遍全身、顶到最深处什么都不用想的滋味，确实治好了我的术前焦虑。冲着那一晚的疗效，这台手术我也不算白躺。说吧，哪一步出了问题？
failure.text_en: Forget it. Even though falling short is frustrating, having you touch every inch of me two nights ago and drive deep inside until I couldn't think at all genuinely cured my pre-op panic. For the efficacy of that night alone, lying on that table wasn't a waste. Tell me—which step gave us trouble?

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 瞧，我已经摆好姿势了。现在不准用医疗术语形容我。
dark.text_en: Look, I'm already positioned. And you're forbidden from describing me with medical terminology right now.

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 她伸手勾住他的脖子吻上去。灯暗，两人在被褥间紧紧交缠。
dark.text_en: She hooks her arms around his neck and kisses him. The lights dim as the two entwine closely between the sheets.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 还在笑？……我有这么不会撒娇吗？
dark.text_en: Still smiling? ...Am I really that clumsy at acting spoiled?

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 嗯……你的手好热……碰到胸口的时候，心跳快得像要报警了。
dark.text_en: Mmn... Your hands are so hot... When you touch my chest, my heart races like it's about to set off a monitor alarm.

dark.speaker: player
dark.text: 你今天很可爱。
dark.text_en: You're adorable tonight.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 啊……你故意挑这个时候说，我没办法反驳……唔、下面那里……别光用手指欺负我呀……
dark.text_en: Ah... Saying that at a moment like this leaves me zero room to argue... Nnh, down there... don't just tease me with your fingers...

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 再亲一次。……隆司，快点进来吧，我想用你的温度把脑子里的胡思乱想全挤出去。
dark.text_en: Kiss me again. ...Takashi, hurry and come inside me—I want to use your heat to crowd every anxious thought right out of my head.

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 坂口覆上她的身体，沉稳而有力地挺入深处。佳織的腰肢剧烈一颤，平日干练的声线瞬间碎成了急促的喘息。
dark.text_en: Sakaguchi covers her body, pressing steadily and powerfully into her depths. Kaori's waist shudders violently, her usually crisp voice shattering into breathless gasps.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 呀啊……！唔、嗯……！太、太深了……一下子就顶到了……
dark.text_en: Kyaa...! Mmn, nnh...! T-Too deep... You reached all the way in at once...

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 好棒……今天我非常满意这个临时疗法……啊、嗯……还可以再快一点……今晚我想稍微贪心一点……啊啊、要去了……！
dark.text_en: So good... I'm very satisfied with this temporary therapy tonight... Ah, nnh... You can go a little faster... Tonight I want to be a little greedy... Aah, I'm coming...!

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 暗场延续片刻，完全黑屏、时钟推进。再亮时，床脚散落着她昨晚扔下的病服和白色小内裤。
dark.text_en: The dim scene lingers briefly before fading completely to black as the clock advances. When the light returns, the hospital gown and white panties she tossed aside last night lie scattered at the foot of the bed.

doc_asuka.title: 院长对病号服提出抗议
doc_asuka.title_en: The Director Lodges a Protest Against Hospital Gowns

consult.speaker: narrator
consult.text: 明日香拿起自己的手术帽，审视了三秒钟，放回。
consult.text_en: Asuka picks up her surgical cap, inspects it for three seconds, and sets it back down.

consult.speaker: patient
consult.text: 这东西设计得不错。我以为我会很喜欢。
consult.text_en: This cap is well designed. I thought I'd love it.

consult.speaker: player
consult.text: 你现在好像不喜欢了。
consult.text_en: You don't look too fond of it right now.

consult.speaker: patient
consult.text: 我不喜欢的是想象自己戴着它躺上台，还被我自己立下的‘签字后不准取消’的规定绑得死死的。……好奇怪，我明明还让人给它做过满意度调查。拿来，本院长签字。
consult.text_en: What I'm not fond of is picturing myself wearing it on the operating table, bound hand and foot by the very 'no cancellation after signing' rule I approved myself. ...How strange, I even commissioned a satisfaction survey for these caps. Hand it over—the Director will sign.

night.speaker: narrator
night.text: 病房桌上放着她下午批准的文件。她把文件翻过去，满脸严肃。
night.text_en: On the ward table lie the documents she approved that afternoon. She flips them face-down with a solemn expression.

night.speaker: patient
night.text: 院长正式宣布，今晚特别病房一切工作停止，只有私人访客可以留下。
night.text_en: The Director officially declares that all hospital business in the Special Ward is suspended for the night. Only private visitors are permitted to remain.

night.speaker: player
night.text: 我是私人访客？
night.text_en: Am I a private visitor?

night.speaker: patient
night.text: 是我喜欢的人。不合格就请出去。
night.text_en: You're the man I love. If you fail inspection, you'll be escorted out.

night.speaker: narrator
night.text: 她忍着笑看坂口关好门，脱掉白大褂和衣物；自己也慢条斯理地解开病服，褪下精致的香槟色真丝胸罩与内裤，故意像检查客房一样，赤着身子把枕头调整来调整去，最后忽然把他拽到床边。
night.text_en: Holding back a smile, she watches Sakaguchi lock the door and take off his white coat and clothes; unhurriedly unbuttoning her patient gown, she slips off her champagne-silk bra and panties, deliberately fussing with the pillows stark naked as if inspecting a guest suite before suddenly yanking him down to the bedside.

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她像只吃饱的猫一样懒洋洋地陷在枕头里，脸上还带着欢爱后的潮红，目光慢慢转到天花板的灯。
after.text_en: Sinking lazily into the pillows like a well-fed cat with the flush of lovemaking still on her cheeks, Asuka slowly turns her gaze toward the ceiling fixture.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: ……我刚想到一个严重的制度设计漏洞。
after.text_en: ...I just thought of a severe flaw in our institutional policies.

after.speaker: player
after.text: 现在还要管医院？
after.text_en: Still managing the hospital at this hour?

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 当初是谁规定‘签署同意书进入准备流程后，患者不得临阵取消手术’的？……好像是我自己签字批准的！而且手术室那几盏无影灯也是我买的，明天它们要照着我被切开十几个小时，**我本人全麻，连反悔和欣赏的机会都没有！**
after.text_en: Who was it that enacted the rule stating 'once informed consent is signed and prep workflow begins, a patient may not cancel surgery at the last minute'? ...Pretty sure I signed off on that myself! And I bought those shadowless lamps in the OR too—tomorrow they're going to shine down on me being cut open for over ten hours, **while I'm under general anesthesia with zero chance to back out or even admire them!**

after.speaker: player
after.text: ……院长需要修改医院章程吗？可惜今晚行政科已经下班了。
after.text_en: ...Does the Director wish to amend the hospital charter? Too bad the administration office has clocked out for the night.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 可恶！这叫作茧自缚！我要申请心情退款！
after.text_en: Darn it! Talk about being hoisted by my own petard! I demand an emotional refund!

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她掀开被单去摸病号服和内裤，忽然凶巴巴地把它们推远。
after.text_en: She lifts the sheet to reach for her hospital gown and panties, then ferociously shoves them away.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 算了，今晚不穿啦！刚才出了那么多汗，明早她们又要替我做一遍复杂准备。反正院长大人明天怎么都逃不掉、非得光着躺上手术台不可了，我现在就维持全裸待机状态！
after.text_en: Forget it, I'm not getting dressed tonight! I sweated so much with you just now, and the nurses have to put me through a whole complex prep routine tomorrow morning anyway. Since the Director has zero chance of escaping tomorrow and has to lie naked on the operating table no matter what, I'm staying in full-nude standby mode right now!

after.speaker: player
after.text: 护士大概不会认可这种待机状态。
after.text_en: I doubt the nursing department recognizes that standby mode.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 那就把意见写在院长信箱，等我从全麻里醒来再处理！
after.text_en: Then they can drop their complaints in the Director's suggestion box for me to process after I wake up from general anesthesia!

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她拍着枕头笑，笑着笑着忽然安静下来。
after.text_en: She pats the pillow laughing, until her laughter gradually quiets down.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: ……那个，隆司。明天真的要把我推到那盏灯下面，真刀真枪地做完全程，对吧？
after.text_en: ...Say, Takashi. Tomorrow they're really going to wheel me under that lamp and cut me open from start to finish, aren't they?

after.speaker: player
after.text: 是。如果你在麻醉前害怕，不用在她们面前端着院长的架子。
after.text_en: Yes. And if you feel scared before induction, you don't have to put on the Director's front in front of the girls.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 我现在已经怕得腿软了。明天千万不要因为我是院长，就假装看不出来。
after.text_en: My legs are already jelly just thinking about it. Tomorrow, don't you dare pretend you can't tell I'm terrified just because I'm the Director.

success.speaker: patient
success.text: 患者反馈第一条：全麻醒来以后，想起自己术前夜光着屁股在床上骂医院章程、还嚷嚷着要‘全裸待机’的蠢话，院长的威严简直荡然无存！
success.text_en: Patient Feedback Item One: Waking up from general anesthesia and remembering how I lay naked in bed cursing the hospital charter I wrote myself and yelling about 'full-nude standby mode'... the Director's dignity is in absolute shambles!

success.speaker: player
success.text: 需要我替院长保密吗？
success.text_en: Would the Director like me to classify that record?

success.speaker: patient
success.text: 当然要！……至于患者反馈第二条嘛，术前夜某位私人访客在床上的服务非常到位，弄得本院长到现在想起来腰还是酥的。看在那晚那么舒服、手术又圆满成功的份上，奖励你今天不用写检讨直接复盘！
success.text_en: Obviously! ...As for Patient Feedback Item Two: the bedside service provided by a certain private visitor on the night before surgery was exemplary—my waist still feels tingly just thinking about it. Since that night felt so amazing and the surgery succeeded without a hitch, I hereby reward you with a direct debriefing, no written self-criticism required!

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 哼，我就知道！前天晚上我看着天花板想改医院章程、觉得自己作茧自缚的时候，就预感这台手术没那么容易过关！
failure.text_en: Hmph, I knew it! Two nights ago when I was staring at the ceiling wanting to rewrite the hospital charter because I felt trapped by my own rules, I had a hunch this operation wouldn't let me off easy!

failure.speaker: player
failure.text: 为了安全我及时叫停了手术，没有硬撑。
failure.text_en: I called a halt for safety rather than forcing it.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 及时停下是对的，但我还是要追究一下主刀医生的场外责任——隆司，你是不是前天晚上拉着本院长胡闹得太久、在床上把看家本领全使出来了，结果到了无影灯底下反而差了一口气呀？
failure.text_en: Stopping in time was the right call, but I still need to investigate the lead surgeon's off-duty accountability—Takashi, did you spend way too long fooling around with the Director two nights ago and use up all your best moves in bed, leaving you a breath short under the shadowless lamp?

failure.speaker: narrator
failure.text: 她鼓着脸颊瞪了他一眼，随即又忍不住弯起嘴角，伸手勾住他的手腕。
failure.text_en: She puffs her cheeks and glares at him, before her lips curve into a fond smile and she hooks her fingers around his wrist.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 不过呢，心情退款我就不申请了。毕竟术前夜被你抱在怀里疼爱得那么彻底，光是回味那个晚上，本院长就觉得这趟住院一点都不亏。来吧，把手术情况老老实实汇报上来。
failure.text_en: Still, I'll waive my claim for an emotional refund. Considering how thoroughly you pampered and loved me in your arms on the night before surgery, just savoring that night makes this hospital stay a net profit for the Director. Come on, report the surgical details honestly.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 满意了。……接下来的安排只听女朋友的。
dark.text_en: Inspection passed. ...From here on, we only take orders from your girlfriend.

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 她在他颊边亲了一下，灯逐渐暗下，被窝里很快传出衣物摩挲与急促的呼吸声。
dark.text_en: She plants a kiss on his cheek; the lights dim, and the rustle of sheets and quickening breaths soon fill the bed.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 等等，不准说‘遵命院长’！……唔、手怎么直接摸到胸口来了……
dark.text_en: Wait—saying 'Yes, Director' is strictly prohibited! ...Nnh, how did your hand go straight to my chest...

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: ……嗯。现在可以夸我漂亮……连同里面一起夸。
dark.text_en: ...Mmn. Now you may compliment how pretty I am... including how I feel inside.

dark.speaker: player
dark.text: 你一直很漂亮。
dark.text_en: You're always gorgeous.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 呀……你怎么突然这么会讲话……啊、那里已经湿透了……别光蹭着不进来呀……
dark.text_en: Kya... Since when did you get so smooth with words... Ah, I'm already soaked down there... Don't just rub against the entrance without coming in...

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 再过来一点。今天这床可是给我们两个人的……快点把我填满嘛，隆司……
dark.text_en: Come closer. This bed belongs to just the two of us tonight... Hurry up and fill me all the way up, Takashi...

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 坂口沉腰一举推进到底，明日香娇媚地轻叫一声，双腿顺势缠上他的腰侧，随着他的冲击轻轻摇晃。
dark.text_en: Sakaguchi sinks his hips and drives all the way to the hilt in one stroke; Asuka lets out a sweet cry, wrapping her legs around his waist as her body sways with his thrusts.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 啊——！哈啊、好深……！我好像已经忘了自己住在医院……脑子里全都是你了……
dark.text_en: Aah—! Haah, so deep...! I think I've already forgotten I'm staying in a hospital... My head is completely full of you...

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 嗯、啊……！别急着停下，好不好？今晚我批准自己任性到底……要、要去了！隆司——啊啊……！
dark.text_en: Nnh, ah...! Don't stop yet, okay? Tonight I'm authorizing myself to be completely spoiled... I-I'm coming! Takashi—aah...!

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 真正黑屏，时间前移。椅背上悬挂着那套香槟色真丝内衣。
dark.text_en: Full fade to black as time advances. Her champagne-silk lingerie hangs over the back of the chair.

doc_artoria.title: 本人到场，但不允许指挥
doc_artoria.title_en: Present in Person, Stripped of Command

consult.speaker: narrator
consult.text: 她读完计划，双手放在膝上，久久未动。
consult.text_en: After reading the surgical plan, she rests both hands on her knees, motionless for a long while.

consult.speaker: patient
consult.text: 我终于明白，为什么大家都在问我还有没有问题。一旦签下名字，明日无论如何都必须躺上手术台，我的问题多到问完也不会安心。
consult.text_en: I finally understand why everyone keeps asking if I have any further questions. Once I sign my name, I must take my place on the operating table tomorrow no matter what—my questions are so numerous that asking them all would still bring no peace of mind.

consult.speaker: player
consult.text: 那就不必装作安心。
consult.text_en: Then there's no need to feign peace of mind.

consult.speaker: patient
consult.text: 我同意参加。……明日请把我当一名普通患者，而不是前来检阅的将领。
consult.text_en: I consent to participate. ...Tomorrow, please treat me as an ordinary patient rather than a general arriving to inspect the troops.

night.speaker: narrator
night.text: 被角折得笔直。阿尔托莉雅端坐着，神情像是要发表战前训话。
night.text_en: The corners of the duvet are folded with military precision. Artoria sits upright as though preparing to deliver a pre-battle address.

night.speaker: patient
night.text: 今晚有一件私事，恐怕比向你申请一支援军还难开口。
night.text_en: There is a personal matter tonight that I find harder to broach than requesting a relief column from you.

night.speaker: player
night.text: 你说。
night.text_en: Tell me.

night.speaker: patient
night.text: 请留下来。我想与你亲近，不想独自面对明早。
night.text_en: Please stay. I wish to be close to you, and would rather not face tomorrow morning alone.

night.speaker: narrator
night.text: 她坚持亲手把门关严，坂口锁上，脱去外衣。她像卸下甲胄一般庄重地脱下病服，解开纯白镶蓝边的贴身内衣与内裤，整齐叠好放在床头，随即又将枕头摆得端正。坂口站在床边看她毫无遮掩的身躯，她耳根通红。
night.text_en: She insists on closing the door firmly herself while Sakaguchi locks it and removes his outer clothes. With the solemnity of unbuckling armor, she takes off her hospital gown, unfastens her white blue-trimmed bra and panties, folds them neatly at the head of the bed, and squares the pillow once more. As Sakaguchi stands by the bed looking at her unshielded body, her ears turn bright red.

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她呼吸微促，胸前还泛着动情的潮红，忽然翻身坐起，茫然望着自己折得整整齐齐的衣物。
after.text_en: Breathing unevenly with a flush still lingering across her chest, she suddenly sits upright, staring blankly at her neatly folded clothes.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 不对。明日那场行动，军令状已经签下，我本人必须到场，却要在最关键的十几个小时里完全失去意识？
after.text_en: Wait. For tomorrow's campaign, the military pledge is already signed and I must attend in person—yet I am to lose consciousness completely during the most decisive ten-plus hours?

after.speaker: player
after.text: 手术是全麻。
after.text_en: The operation is under general anesthesia.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 一场主角什么也不知道、连撤退命令都无权下达的行动！刚才在你怀里失态也就算了，明天她们替我换衣、摆位、确认无误，然后我就睡过去任凭切开。连抗议‘这个姿势不威严’的机会都没有！
after.text_en: A campaign in which the principal figure knows nothing and holds no authority even to order a retreat! Losing my composure in your arms just now is one thing, but tomorrow the nurses will change my clothes, position my body, verify everything, and put me to sleep to be cut open—without even a chance to protest that 'this posture lacks dignity'!

after.speaker: player
after.text: 你现在可以在房间里抗议。
after.text_en: You're free to lodge your protest inside this room right now.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 那我就抗议！……抗议自己既然已经签了字，怎么还会这么害怕。
after.text_en: Then I hereby protest! ...I protest how terrified I still am even after signing my name.

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她拉高被单遮住赤裸的胸口，正襟危坐地宣布。
after.text_en: Pulling the sheet up to cover her bare chest, she sits bolt upright to make a pronouncement.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 由于明日已有正式换装安排，今夜着装义务暂时解除。所有内衣与病服留在原处，我就这样在被单中待命。
after.text_en: Inasmuch as formal attire preparation is scheduled for tomorrow morning, tonight's dress obligations are temporarily suspended. All undergarments and patient gowns shall remain where they are while I stand by beneath the sheets.

after.speaker: player
after.text: 听起来像真的军令。
after.text_en: That sounded like a real military order.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 当然是假的！……请允许我暂时保有一点可笑的威严。
after.text_en: Of course it's fake! ...Please allow me to preserve a shred of laughable dignity for the night.

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她还想强装镇定，指尖却碰到了坂口的手。
after.text_en: She tries to maintain a composed front, but her fingertips brush against Sakaguchi's hand.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 全麻那段时间里，我什么也无法为自己做。……明早，你能在我闭眼之前，再叫一次我的名字吗？
after.text_en: During those hours under anesthesia, I can do nothing for myself. ...Tomorrow morning, right before my eyes close, will you call my name one more time?

success.speaker: patient
success.text: 你们出色地完成了任务。现在回想起来，术前那一夜我居然赤身裸体地坐在被单里下达什么‘解除着装义务’的假军令，还因为害怕失去意识而向你抗议……真是令人汗颜。
success.text_en: You accomplished the mission splendidly. Looking back now, sitting stark naked under the sheet two nights ago issuing a phony military order to 'suspend dress obligations' and protesting because I was afraid of losing consciousness... is deeply mortifying.

success.speaker: player
success.text: 但那天夜里的阿尔托莉雅非常坦率。
success.text_en: Though the Artoria of that night was remarkably honest.

success.speaker: patient
success.text: 咳……隆司，不许再提我当时求你进入我的事了。不过，正因为在那一夜体会到了完全委身于你的幸福，我才能安心把这十几个小时交给你们。谢谢你，我的主刀。
success.text_en: Ahem... Takashi, I forbid you from bringing up how I begged you to enter me back then. Still, it was precisely because I experienced the bliss of giving myself completely to you that night that I could entrust those ten-plus hours to your team in peace. Thank you, my lead surgeon.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 我理解为什么必须中止。看来术前夜我对‘主角失去意识无法指挥’的担忧，某种程度上确实应验了。
failure.text_en: I understand why the operation had to be halted. It seems my unease on the night before surgery about 'the principal figure losing consciousness and command' proved somewhat prophetic.

failure.speaker: player
failure.text: 这次没有达到目标，责任在我。
failure.text_en: We didn't reach the target this time. The responsibility rests with me.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 我不打算责备你的判断。只是……隆司，你该不会是因为前天夜里在病床上与我缠绵得太过激烈，导致次日出征时体力不济吧？
failure.text_en: I have no intention of faulting your judgment. Only... Takashi, could it be that our entanglement in this bed two nights ago grew so intense that your stamina was depleted before taking the field the next day?

failure.speaker: narrator
failure.text: 看到坂口微怔的表情，她耳根一红，轻轻握住他的手掌。
failure.text_en: Seeing Sakaguchi's slightly stunned expression, her ears flush red and she gently clasps his palm.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: ……请把刚才那句当作不成熟的玩笑。尽管手术未能竟全功，但回想起术前夜在你怀中卸下一切重担、与你结合的温暖，我便一点也不后悔签下那份同意书。现在，请把战况如实告诉我吧。
failure.text_en: ...Please disregard that last remark as an immature jest. Even if the surgery fell short of full victory, whenever I recall the warmth of laying down all my burdens in your arms and becoming one with you on that pre-op night, I do not regret signing that consent form in the slightest. Now, please deliver the battle report.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: ……我是不是又像在准备检阅？对不起。过来吧。
dark.text_en: ...Am I acting as though I'm preparing for an inspection again? Forgive me. Come here.

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 他坐下，她主动拥吻，灯光暗去。
dark.text_en: He sits down; she initiates the kiss and embrace as the lights dim.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 今夜不用敬礼。也不用等待许可……唔、你的手……
dark.text_en: There is no need for salutes tonight. Nor any need to await permission... Nnh, your hand...

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 嗯……这样抚摸我，很好……身体比我想象的还要诚实。
dark.text_en: Mmn... Touching me like this feels wonderful... My body is far more honest than I anticipated.

dark.speaker: player
dark.text: 阿尔托莉雅。
dark.text_en: Artoria.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 啊……你这样叫我的名字，再碰那里的话……我会彻底失去平日的镇定……
dark.text_en: Ah... If you call my name like that while touching me there... I shall lose my everyday composure entirely...

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 再亲我一次。我不是在发布命令……是在请求你，现在就进入我……
dark.text_en: Kiss me once more. I am not issuing a command... I am begging you to come inside me right now...

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 坂口分开她紧绷的双腿，缓缓沉入那片湿润而紧致的深处。向来端庄的骑士发出一声破碎的轻吟，手指紧紧扣住了他的背肌。
dark.text_en: Sakaguchi parts her tense thighs and sinks slowly into her wet, tight warmth. The ever-dignified knight lets out a fractured whimper, her fingers digging into the muscles of his back.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 唔——！啊、哈啊……！好烫……今夜让我靠着你，不必照看任何人……
dark.text_en: Mmn—! Ah, haah...! So hot... Tonight, let me lean on you without having to watch over anyone else...

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 嗯、啊……！顶得太深了……隆司……我非常幸福……啊、要守不住了……就这样抱紧我——唔啊啊……！
dark.text_en: Nnh, ah...! You're pressing so deep... Takashi... I am truly happy... Ah, I can't hold back anymore... Hold me tight just like this—mmaah...!

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 完全黑屏，时间推移。再亮时，唯有床头那叠纯白内衣还维持着整洁的形状。
dark.text_en: Full fade to black as time passes. When the light returns, only the stack of white underwear at the headboard retains its neat shape.

nurse_hiroko.title: 交班以前把被子藏起来
nurse_hiroko.title_en: Hide the Sheets Before Shift Handover

consult.speaker: narrator
consult.text: 弘子看完编组表，把最上面那张纸翻过去，不再看。
consult.text_en: After reading the team roster, Hiroko flips the top page face-down and refuses to look at it again.

consult.speaker: patient
consult.text: 名单没问题。准备单也没有问题。……现在该怎么办？平时我的患者签完字知道没法反悔的时候，可没有一个还要顺便评价护士站工作的。
consult.text_en: The roster is fine. The prep sheet is fine too. ...Now what do I do? Normally, when my patients sign the form and realize there's no backing out, none of them are also expected to evaluate the nurses' station.

consult.speaker: player
consult.text: 你今天不用评价她们。
consult.text_en: You don't have to evaluate them today.

consult.speaker: patient
consult.text: 嗯。你把笔给我。我签了以后就乖乖去病房，尽量少管闲事。
consult.text_en: Right. Hand me the pen. Once I sign, I'll head straight to the ward and try my best not to meddle.

night.speaker: narrator
night.text: 弘子已经将房间收拾得近乎整洁，床铺平得没有一条褶。
night.text_en: Hiroko has tidied the room to near-perfection, the bedsheet smoothed without a single crease.

night.speaker: patient
night.text: 真不成样子。我明明应该休息，却把枕头整理了七遍。
night.text_en: This is hopeless. I'm supposed to be resting, yet I've fluffed and straightened the pillow seven times.

night.speaker: player
night.text: 要我把它弄乱吗？
night.text_en: Want me to mess it up for you?

night.speaker: patient
night.text: ……可以。今晚你留下来，把它弄乱一点也没关系。
night.text_en: ...Yes, please. Stay with me tonight—it's fine if you mess it up a little.

night.speaker: narrator
night.text: 她说完自己先红了脸，抬手拉着坂口进房。坂口反锁门、脱掉工作服和其他衣物；她换下病服，解开稳重的深紫罗兰色胸罩与内裤，本来想仔细叠好，最后索性红着脸把它们放在椅子上就不再碰，赤着成熟丰润的身体钻进被窝。
night.text_en: Blushing at her own words, she reaches out to pull Sakaguchi inside. He locks the door and removes his uniform and clothes; changing out of her hospital gown, she unfastens her deep-violet bra and panties, starts to fold them out of habit, then finally blushes and leaves them on the chair untouched, slipping her mature, curvesome body under the covers.

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 弘子余韵未消地喘着气，猛然从坂口怀里坐起来，一双眼睛盯着身下皱成一团、还沾着些许痕迹的床单。
after.text_en: Still panting in the afterglow, Hiroko bolts upright in Sakaguchi's arms, staring wide-eyed at the crumpled, slightly stained bedsheet beneath them.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 完蛋了。
after.text_en: We're doomed.

after.speaker: player
after.text: 怎么？
after.text_en: What's wrong?

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 刚才折腾得太凶了！明早谁来接我？如果是我带过的年轻护士，她们看见这张乱七八糟的床，还有椅子上乱丢的内衣，绝对会想起我以前怎么训人的！
after.text_en: We got way too carried away just now! Who's assigned to pick me up tomorrow morning? If it's the junior nurses I trained, and they walk in to see this wrecked bed and my underwear tossed on the chair, they'll remember every lecture I ever gave them!

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她光着身子抓起床单想拉平；坂口一动，另一边又皱起来。
after.text_en: Stark naked, she grabs the edge of the sheet to smooth it out; the moment Sakaguchi shifts, the other side wrinkles again.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 别动！……不对，你可以动。哎呀，我到底在干什么？
after.text_en: Don't move! ...No, wait, you can move. Goodness, what am I even doing?

after.speaker: player
after.text: 你明天还要做十几个小时的大手术呢。
after.text_en: You have a ten-plus-hour major surgery tomorrow.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 我知道！而且字已经签了，明早就算觉得丢脸也逃不掉！明天那些姑娘们给我做全套准备，扶我上台，麻醉一开始我就什么也帮不上忙，只能躺着被你们切开了！
after.text_en: I know! And the form is signed, so even if I'm mortified tomorrow morning, there's no escaping it! Tomorrow those girls will do my full pre-op prep, help me onto the table, and once the anesthesia starts, I won't be able to help at all—just lie there while you cut me open!

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她放弃去拿椅子上的内裤，干脆把整条床单往头上蒙，半晌才传来闷闷的声音。
after.text_en: Giving up on retrieving her panties from the chair, she pulls the entire sheet over her head, her voice muffled from underneath.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 算了，衣服也不穿了，床也不铺了！我有那么多次对签完字想打退堂鼓的患者说‘放松’……原来轮到自己没退路的时候，这两个字听起来这么讨厌。
after.text_en: Forget it—I'm not getting dressed, and I'm not making the bed! Do you know how many times I've told patients who wanted to back out after signing to 'just relax'? ...Now that I'm the one with no exit, those two words sound awful.

after.speaker: player
after.text: 那就先不整理。
after.text_en: Then let's leave the bed messy tonight.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 好。……但是明早如果护士问这张床怎么回事，你替我回答。
after.text_en: Okay. ...But if the nurses ask what happened to this bed tomorrow morning, you're answering for me.

after.speaker: player
after.text: 回答什么？
after.text_en: And what should I tell them?

after.speaker: patient
after.text: ‘杉村前辈今晚休息得很好。’一个字都不准多说。
after.text_en: 'Sugimura-senpai rested very well tonight.' Not a single word more.

success.speaker: patient
success.text: 她们推床的时候问我还要什么，我本来还惦记着前天晚上被我们弄得乱七八糟的床单和乱丢的内衣，结果一紧张说成了‘请握一下我的手’……现在想起来，我那天晚上蒙着床单赖着不穿衣服的样子，实在太不稳重了。
success.text_en: When the girls wheeled my gurney out and asked if I needed anything else, I was still worrying about the crumpled bedsheet and the underwear we left on the chair two nights ago, and ended up blurting out 'Please hold my hand'... Thinking back now, hiding naked under the sheet refusing to dress was so unbecoming of a senior nurse.

success.speaker: player
success.text: 但那天晚上把床单弄乱的过程，弘子不是挺开心的吗？
success.text_en: Though Hiroko seemed to thoroughly enjoy the process of messing up that bedsheet that night.

success.speaker: patient
success.text: 坂口君！……真是的，现在想起来身体还会发热呢。多亏你那晚那么温柔地抱着我，我才能顺顺利利挺过这十几个小时。我回去绝不会拿床单的事教育后辈了。
success.text_en: Sakaguchi-kun! ...Honestly, my body still warms up just thinking about it. Thanks to how tenderly you held me that night, I made it through all ten-plus hours smoothly. When I return to duty, I'll never lecture my juniors over a wrinkled sheet again.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 你看，前天晚上我看着揉皱的床单直发慌、觉得心里乱糟糟的时候，就隐约觉得这次手术没那么顺利吧。
failure.text_en: See? Two nights ago when I was panicking over the crumpled bedsheet and feeling all flustered inside, I had a vague premonition this operation wouldn't go smoothly.

failure.speaker: player
failure.text: 没有人跳过核对，但这次确实没能达成预期目标。
failure.text_en: Nobody skipped a single verification step, but we did fail to reach the intended goal this time.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 我懂什么时候该停手。不过坂口君……你是不是前天晚上在病房里只顾着帮我‘把床铺弄乱’、在我身体里用力过猛，结果第二天站在主刀位置上反而累着了？
failure.text_en: I know when a team has to call a halt. Still, Sakaguchi-kun... could it be that you focused so hard on 'messing up the bedsheets' inside me in the ward two nights ago that you wore yourself out before standing at the operating table the next day?

failure.speaker: narrator
failure.text: 她掩嘴轻笑了一声，眼底的失落化作了温柔的嗔怪，伸手覆在坂口手背上。
failure.text_en: She covers her mouth with a soft laugh, her disappointment melting into gentle affection as she lays her hand over the back of Sakaguchi's.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 开玩笑的。虽然手术没做成有点遗憾，但一想起术前夜难得任性一回、被你抱在怀里疼爱到忘乎所以的滋味……我觉得这三天一点也没白费。来，跟我说说当时的情况吧。
failure.text_en: I'm just teasing. Even though it's a shame the surgery didn't finish, whenever I recall how I got to be selfish for once on the pre-op night and was loved by you until I forgot everything else... these three days weren't wasted at all. Come on, tell me how it went.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 真难得。我居然想故意不收拾。
dark.text_en: How rare for me. I actually want to leave things untidy on purpose.

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 她拉他在床上躺下，轻轻亲吻。灯渐暗。
dark.text_en: She pulls him down onto the bed and kisses him softly. The lights dim.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 嗯……别急，今天让我主动一次。
dark.text_en: Mmn... No rush—let me take the lead for once tonight.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 你手怎么这么暖……摸得我腰都软了。……啊，这句不像我会说的话。
dark.text_en: Why are your hands so warm... You're making my waist go weak. ...Ah, that didn't sound like something I'd usually say.

dark.speaker: player
dark.text: 我很喜欢。
dark.text_en: I love hearing it.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 那就……再亲我一次。今晚你不要叫我前辈，我听了会想去检查器械。
dark.text_en: Then... kiss me again. And don't call me 'Senpai' tonight—hearing that will make me want to go inspect the instrument trays.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: ……唔、那里……已经被你弄得这么湿了……别忍着，进来吧，坂口君……
dark.text_en: ...Nnh, down there... You've already gotten me this wet... Don't hold back, come inside me, Sakaguchi-kun...

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 当两人彻底结合在一起，原本平整的床单在深入的律动下迅速皱成一团。弘子捂着嘴，指缝间还是漏出了高亢的喘息。
dark.text_en: As the two join completely, the pristine bedsheet rapidly crumples beneath their deep rhythm. Hiroko covers her mouth, yet high, breathless moans still slip between her fingers.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 啊、嗯……！对，就这样抱着我……我真的好久没有这么任性了……
dark.text_en: Ah, nnh...! Yes, hold me just like this... It's been so long since I let myself be this selfish...

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 不、不行……那里太用力了……床单要全乱了……啊、哈啊……不管了、要去了……坂口君——！
dark.text_en: N-No... Thrusting that hard right there... the bedsheet is going to be a total wreck... Ah, haah... I don't care anymore, I'm coming... Sakaguchi-kun—!

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 彻底黑屏，时钟推进。
dark.text_en: Full fade to black as the clock advances.

nurse_satsuki.title: 我和病号服谁先认输
nurse_satsuki.title_en: Who Surrenders First: Me or the Hospital Gown?

consult.speaker: narrator
consult.text: 皐月把术前说明折得整齐，握着笔的指尖却有些发白。
consult.text_en: Satsuki folds the pre-op information sheet neatly, though her knuckles gripping the pen turn white.

consult.speaker: patient
consult.text: 坂口医生……那个，一旦在这里签了字，明天哪怕我在推床上哭出来，手术也绝对不会取消了，对吧？
consult.text_en: Dr. Sakaguchi... um, once I sign my name here, even if I burst into tears on the gurney tomorrow morning, the surgery won't be canceled no matter what, right?

consult.speaker: player
consult.text: 对。签字之后排程就锁死了，直到手术做完为止。
consult.text_en: Right. Once signed, the schedule is locked until the operation is completed.

consult.speaker: patient
consult.text: ……好。其实要是告诉我随时能退缩，我明早肯定会当逃兵的。所以，趁我现在还有勇气……我签好了！
consult.text_en: ...Okay. Honestly, if you told me I could back out anytime, I'd definitely desert tomorrow morning. So while I still have my courage... I've signed it!

night.speaker: narrator
night.text: 皐月抱着膝盖坐在床角，看见坂口，竟主动伸出了手。
night.text_en: Sitting in the corner of the bed hugging her knees, Satsuki actually reaches out her hand first when she sees Sakaguchi enter.

night.speaker: patient
night.text: 我练习了一整天怎么说。……今晚留下来，陪我，好吗？我很想亲你。
night.text_en: I practiced how to say this all day. ...Will you stay with me tonight? I really want to kiss you.

night.speaker: player
night.text: 不用背台词。
night.text_en: You don't need to recite a script.

night.speaker: patient
night.text: 那、那我就照自己想的来。
night.text_en: Th-Then I'll just do what I'm feeling.

night.speaker: narrator
night.text: 她领他进来，小声催他锁门。坂口脱掉衣物；皐月慢吞吞地脱下病服，羞得满脸通红地褪下带有小碎花的白色纯棉内衣裤，紧紧攥着被单遮住微微发抖的赤裸身体，鼓起勇气把身旁的位置让给他。
night.text_en: She leads him inside and whispers for him to lock the door. Sakaguchi removes his clothes; Satsuki slowly unbuttons her hospital gown and, blushing scarlet, slips off her floral-print white cotton bra and panties, clutching the sheet tightly against her trembling bare body as she musters the courage to make room for him beside her.

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 皐月浑身软绵绵地趴在坂口胸口，把发烫的脸埋进枕头。下一秒，床边的患者服和碎花内裤从椅背滑落，她吓得浑身一哆嗦。
after.text_en: Limp against Sakaguchi's chest, Satsuki buries her flushed face into the pillow. The next second, her patient gown and floral panties slip off the back of the chair, making her flinch from head to toe.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 呀！……是、是衣服啊。
after.text_en: Kya! ...I-It's just my clothes.

after.speaker: player
after.text: 你以为是谁？
after.text_en: Who did you think it was?

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 以为是明早来押我去手术室的前辈！呜，真糟糕，刚才被你抱着的时候明明什么都不怕了，结果现在一静下来，听见一点声音就以为要被推去开刀了……
after.text_en: I thought it was the senior nurses coming to escort me to the OR tomorrow morning! Uu, this is terrible—while you were holding me just now I wasn't scared of anything, but the second it gets quiet, any tiny noise makes me think I'm about to be wheeled in to go under the knife...

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她低头看见手腕上的患者腕带，手指突然用力去抠那个一次性塑料搭扣，声音带上了哭腔。
after.text_en: Looking down at the patient wristband around her wrist, her fingers suddenly claw at the disposable plastic snap lock, her voice thick with tears.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 坂口医生……这、这个腕带扣得好死，根本摘不下来……明天可是要真刀真枪地切开十几个小时啊，真的会流血、真的会把里面全打开……我现在突然好害怕，我能不能、能不能偷偷把今天签的那张同意书作废呀……？
after.text_en: Dr. Sakaguchi... Th-This wristband is snapped on so tight, it won't come off at all... Tomorrow is a real ten-plus-hour surgery where you cut me open, where I'll really bleed and have my insides laid wide open... I'm suddenly so scared—c-can't we secretly void that consent form I signed today...?

after.speaker: player
after.text: 作废不了了，皐月。手术室和明早的护理组都已经排好班，明早你就是第一台。
after.text_en: There's no voiding it now, Satsuki. The OR and tomorrow morning's nursing team are already scheduled—you're the first case on the board tomorrow.

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 坂口握住她乱抠腕带的手，把光着身子发抖的她重新按回怀里。皐月吸了吸鼻子，眼泪啪嗒掉在他锁骨上，却又莫名松了口气似的贴紧他。
after.text_en: Catching her hand clawing at the wristband, Sakaguchi pulls her trembling naked body back into his embrace. Satsuki sniffles, her tears pattering against his collarbone, yet she presses closer against him as if strangely relieved.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 呜……我就知道没得退了……连坂口医生都不放我走。明明知道睡一觉起来不会有任何后遗症，可一想到明早不管怎么哭都得乖乖躺上去被你们切开，腿就软得连病号服都不敢穿了……
after.text_en: Uu... I knew there was no backing out... Not even Dr. Sakaguchi will let me run away. Even knowing I'll wake up without any lasting harm, just realizing that no matter how hard I cry tomorrow morning I still have to lie down obediently and be cut open makes my legs so weak I don't even dare put my hospital gown back on...

after.speaker: player
after.text: 害怕的话，明早不用装勇敢。
after.text_en: If you're scared tomorrow morning, you don't have to pretend to be brave.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: ……嗯。反正怎么都逃不掉了，那明早我如果吓哭了，你别劝我‘别怕’，好不好？你就按住我的手，告诉大家我会乖乖配合的。至于今晚……先让病号服输给我一次，我就这样光着让你抱到天亮。
after.text_en: ...Okay. Since there's no escaping it anyway, if I burst into tears tomorrow morning, please don't tell me 'don't be scared,' alright? Just hold my hand down and tell everyone I'll cooperate obediently. As for tonight... let the hospital gown lose to me just once, and hold me naked like this until sunrise.

success.speaker: patient
success.text: 进手术室前我真的哭得直打嗝，前辈们一边帮我擦眼泪一边把我抱上了手术台……现在平安做好了，一想起前天晚上我被自己掉下来的内裤吓一跳、还哭着抠腕带求你作废同意书的样子，脸都要烧起来了……
success.text_en: Right before entering the OR I really cried until I hiccuped, and my seniors wiped my tears while lifting me onto the operating table... Now that it's safely over, remembering how I jumped at my own falling panties two nights ago and cried while clawing at my wristband begging you to void my consent form makes my whole face burn...

success.speaker: player
success.text: 现在不怕了？
success.text_en: Not scared anymore?

success.speaker: patient
success.text: 嗯！而且……只要一想起那天夜里光着身子被坂口医生抱在怀里、连最里面都被你温柔填满的感觉，我就觉得幸好当时你没放我当逃兵。我现在终于敢高高兴兴地听报告啦。
success.text_en: No! And... whenever I remember lying stark naked in Dr. Sakaguchi's arms that night and having even my deepest place gently filled by you, I feel so glad you didn't let me desert back then. Now I can finally listen to the report happily!

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 呜……我就知道前天晚上掉衣服的时候我吓得心惊肉跳，是预感到了今天会听见这个结果……
failure.text_en: Uu... I knew jumping out of my skin when my clothes fell two nights ago was a premonition that I'd hear this result today...

failure.speaker: player
failure.text: 不是因为你害怕才没完成，是术中客观条件限制。
failure.text_en: It didn't fall short because you were scared—it was due to objective intraoperative conditions.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 我知道啦……不过坂口医生，你、你是不是前天夜里在床上哄我哄得太久，一直抱着我做到那么晚，结果第二天拿手术刀的时候也跟我一样腿软了呀……？
failure.text_en: I know... Um, Dr. Sakaguchi, c-could it be that you spent too long coaxing me in bed two nights ago and held me so late into the night that your legs went weak when holding the scalpel the next day, just like mine...?

failure.speaker: narrator
failure.text: 她鼓起勇气小声开了句玩笑，瞬间羞得把半张脸埋进被子里，只伸出一只手拉住他的衣角。
failure.text_en: Mustering her courage to make a tiny joke, she immediately buries half her blushing face under the covers, reaching out one hand to tug the corner of his coat.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 对不起，我不该乱开玩笑……其实就算手术没做成，一想到那天晚上你摸着我的胸口、进到我身体里让我一点都不孤单的滋味，我就觉得挨这一刀还是好值得。等我擦干眼泪，你再把报告讲给我听好不好？
failure.text_en: I'm sorry, I shouldn't make silly jokes... Truth is, even if the surgery didn't finish, just remembering how you touched my chest that night and came inside me so I didn't feel lonely at all makes taking this knife feel completely worth it. Once I wipe my tears, will you read me the report?

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 我自己愿意的。你过来吧……真的。
dark.text_en: I'm doing this because I want to. Come here... really.

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 她先闭上眼，轻轻吻他。房间逐渐暗下来。
dark.text_en: Closing her eyes first, she kisses him softly as the room dims.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 啊……对不起，你的手一碰到胸口，我还是吓了一跳……
dark.text_en: Ah... Sorry, the moment your hand touched my chest, I still jumped a little...

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 嗯。再来一次，我想学会不躲……哈啊、唔……
dark.text_en: Mmn. Try again, I want to learn not to flinch... Haah, nnh...

dark.speaker: player
dark.text: 皐月，慢慢来。
dark.text_en: Take your time, Satsuki.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 我知道……你别离我那么远嘛。……呀！手指、碰到下面了……不是说讨厌，是有点太敏感了……
dark.text_en: I know... Just don't stay so far away from me. ...Kya! Your fingers—they touched down there... I don't mean I dislike it, it's just a little too sensitive...

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 我很喜欢你。这句没有练习过……所以，进来吧，坂口医生……
dark.text_en: I really love you. I didn't practice that line... So please, come inside me, Dr. Sakaguchi...

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 坂口温柔地分开她的双腿，缓缓沉入其中。皐月小声惊呼了一下，眼角泛起生理性的泪花，双手却死死抱住了他的脖子不肯松开。
dark.text_en: Sakaguchi gently parts her legs and sinks slowly inside. Satsuki lets out a tiny gasp, physiological tears brimming at the corners of her eyes as both arms lock around his neck, refusing to let go.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 唔……！啊、嗯……好满……里面全都是你……原来被这样抱着，一点都不会觉得孤单……
dark.text_en: Mmn...! Ah, nnh... So full... You're filling me up all the way inside... Being held like this makes me feel not the least bit lonely...

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 啊、哈啊……再深一点也没关系……现在，我好像终于敢一直看着你了……要、要去了……呜啊啊……！
dark.text_en: Ah, haah... It's okay if you go even deeper... Right now, I feel like I finally dare to keep looking right at you... I-I'm coming... uwaah...!

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 画面完全黑，片刻后时间跳过。
dark.text_en: The screen fades completely to black, skipping forward a moment later.

doc_aqua.title: 全麻前最后一次不讲理
doc_aqua.title_en: One Last Unreasonable Tantrum Before General Anesthesia

consult.speaker: narrator
consult.text: 阿库娅把每一项手术准备都问完，脸色却比刚进门还难看。
consult.text_en: Aqua asks about every single pre-op preparation item, her expression growing paler than when she walked in.

consult.speaker: patient
consult.text: 怪了，我每问清楚一项，心就更慌。这个术前谈话可真不成功。
consult.text_en: Weird. Every time I clarify an item, my heart panics even more. This pre-op briefing is a total failure.

consult.speaker: player
consult.text: 签了字可就不能撤回了。
consult.text_en: Once you sign, there's no revoking it.

consult.speaker: patient
consult.text: 当然签！只是明天你如果看见我在台上装死，请记住那是动物面对不可逃避风险时的本能僵直，还没开始全麻呢。
consult.text_en: Of course I'm signing! Just remember tomorrow, if you see me playing dead on the operating table, that's an animal's instinctive tonic immobility when facing inescapable danger—the general anesthesia hasn't started yet.

night.speaker: narrator
night.text: 阿库娅正在把枕头翻来覆去，像在找世界上最合适的一面。
night.text_en: Aqua flips her pillow over and over as if searching for the most scientifically optimal side in the world.

night.speaker: patient
night.text: 大脑很麻烦。我知道明天每一步为什么合理，它还是不肯安静。
night.text_en: The human brain is a nuisance. I understand why every step tomorrow is rational, yet it still refuses to shut up.

night.speaker: player
night.text: 今晚先不做科学家？
night.text_en: Taking the night off from being a scientist?

night.speaker: patient
