night.text: 好。我今晚想被你亲，想和你做到底。这项请求不需要文献支持。
night.text_en: Yes. Tonight I want you to kiss me and go all the way with me. This request requires zero literature citations.

night.speaker: narrator
night.text: 她把他领到床前，指着门示意锁上。坂口脱掉衣物；阿库娅利落地甩掉病号服，解开水蓝色运动风内衣，连同内裤一起踢到床尾，把那本差点拿来复习的书推得远远的。她赤身坐上床，带点坏笑地把他拉近。
night.text_en: She leads him to the bed and points at the door lock. Sakaguchi removes his clothes; Aqua briskly sheds her hospital gown, unhooks her aqua-blue sporty bra, kicks it along with her panties to the foot of the bed, and shoves the textbook she nearly brought for review far away. Sitting naked on the mattress, she pulls him close with a mischievous grin.

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她满身薄汗地瘫在枕头上，忽然从枕头底下摸出术前单，似乎自己都不知道为什么会把它藏在那里。
after.text_en: Sprawled across the pillow slick with sweat, she reaches under the pillow and pulls out the pre-op sheet, looking baffled as to why she hid it there herself.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 这玩意儿怎么在这儿？……不对，天啊，明天的手术！
after.text_en: Why is this thing under here? ...Wait, oh god, tomorrow's surgery!

after.speaker: player
after.text: 你不是打算今晚不谈？
after.text_en: Didn't you say we weren't discussing it tonight?

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 理论上是！刚才多巴胺和内啡肽分泌的时候我明明什么都不怕了，结果现在贤者时间一来——十几个小时的全麻大手术啊！你们所有人都拿着刀和拉钩在我身上忙活，只有被动刀的本主任什么也不知道！喂，隆司，我们现在偷偷进系统把明天的手术申请删掉好不好？！
after.text_en: In theory, yes! While dopamine and endorphins were flooding my system just now I wasn't scared of anything, but the second post-coital clarity hits—it's ten-plus hours of general anesthesia! All of you will be busy wielding scalpels and retractors inside me, while Chief Mizuki on the table knows nothing! Hey, Takashi, can't we hack into the hospital system right now and delete tomorrow's surgical booking?!

after.speaker: player
after.text: 权限已经锁死了，水城主任。
after.text_en: Permissions are locked, Chief Mizuki.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 呜哇！什么破系统！连让我反悔的余地都不给！
after.text_en: Uwaaah! What a garbage system! Leaving me zero room for buyer's remorse!

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她用书挡住通红的脸，忽然把书一扔，看了一眼床尾的水蓝色内裤。
after.text_en: She shields her flushed face with the textbook, then tosses it aside and glances at the aqua-blue panties at the foot of the bed.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 既然删不掉，那我宣布今晚从医护行业辞职十二个小时！医学常识暂时失效！不穿内裤！不穿病号服！不听科普！明天护士来做准备，爱把我准备成什么样就什么样！
after.text_en: Since it can't be deleted, I hereby resign from the medical profession for the next twelve hours! Medical common sense is temporarily null and void! No panties! No hospital gown! No educational lectures! When the nurses come to prep me tomorrow morning, they can prep me however they like!

after.speaker: player
after.text: ……你明早大概会提出二十个要求。
after.text_en: ...You're probably going to make twenty demands tomorrow morning.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 是的！而且每一个都很合理！
after.text_en: I am! And every single one of them will be scientifically sound!

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她突然低声，赤裸的肩膀往他怀里缩了缩。
after.text_en: Lowering her voice suddenly, she tucks her bare shoulders into his embrace.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 不过有一个不合理的。……明早被按在台上全麻诱导的时候，我肯定会怕那种意识往下沉、彻底逃不掉的感觉。请让麻醉医生先和我说说话，不要急着开始倒数。
after.text_en: Except for one unreasonable request. ...Tomorrow morning when they hold me down on the table for general anesthesia induction, I know I'm going to panic at that sensation of consciousness sinking away with nowhere to run. Please ask the anesthesiologist to chat with me first instead of starting the countdown right away.

after.speaker: player
after.text: 我会告诉她。
after.text_en: I'll let her know.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: ……唉，早知道签完字这么吓人，我就只当你床上胡闹的女朋友，不当这倒霉的患者了。
after.text_en: ...Sigh. If I'd known how terrifying it feels after signing, I would've stuck to being your unruly girlfriend in bed instead of this unlucky patient.

success.speaker: patient
success.text: 麻醉前我居然还在心里跟自己辩论怎么逃跑，辩到一半就没意识了！现在醒过来想想，前天晚上我嚷嚷着要黑进系统删申请、还光着身子宣布‘从医护行业辞职十二个小时’的样子，真是太有损本主任的学术形象了！
success.text_en: Right before anesthesia, I was actually debating escape routes in my head, and blacked out mid-argument! Waking up now and remembering how I begged to hack the system to delete my booking two nights ago, then sat there naked declaring my 'twelve-hour resignation from the medical profession'... my academic image as Chief is ruined!

success.speaker: player
success.text: 毕竟当时多巴胺和内啡肽刚分泌完。
success.text_en: Well, the dopamine and endorphins had just worn off.

success.speaker: patient
success.text: 喂，不准拿我自己的话堵我！……不过不得不承认，术前夜被你捏着敏感的地方、一路顶到脑子彻底罢工的临床体验，确实是顶级水准。看在那一晚那么爽、手术也顺利做完的份上，本主任准许你开始复盘了！
success.text_en: Hey, no using my own words against me! ...Still, I have to admit, the clinical experience of having you pinch my sensitive spots on the pre-op night and drive deep inside until my brain went on strike was top-tier. Since that night felt incredible and the operation went smoothly, Chief Mizuki grants you permission to begin the debriefing!

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 我就知道！前天晚上我从枕头底下摸出术前单、吵着想删掉手术申请的时候，我的第六感就已经察觉到这台手术有猫腻了！
failure.text_en: I knew it! Two nights ago when I pulled the pre-op sheet from under the pillow and clamored to delete the surgical booking, my sixth sense had already detected a catch with this operation!

failure.speaker: player
failure.text: 止损的判断是按规程做的，等你好一点我们再研究替代方案。
failure.text_en: The call to abort was made by the book. Once you've rested up, we'll look into alternative approaches.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 道理我都懂，但本主任现在要提出一项科学质疑——隆司，是不是因为术前夜你在床上验证手法的时候太卖力，把我弄得高潮了那么多次，结果把主刀医生自己的体能储备给透支了呀？
failure.text_en: I know the theory, but as Chief I must raise a scientific inquiry—Takashi, did you put so much effort into 'verifying your manual technique' in bed two nights ago and make me climax so many times that the lead surgeon overdrew his own physical reserves?

failure.speaker: narrator
failure.text: 她坏笑着睨了坂口一眼，随后又软下身子靠进他怀里，手指卷着他的白大褂衣角。
failure.text_en: She shoots Sakaguchi a wicked grin, then softens and leans into his chest, twirling the corner of his white coat around her finger.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 好啦，不拿你开涮了。虽然手术没完成让我气得想扔医学书，但一回味起前天晚上在你身下舒服得什么都不用想的滋味……这笔买卖本主任还是稳赚不赔的。先把水递给我，再讲讲卡在哪一步了吧。
failure.text_en: Alright, I'll stop teasing you. Even though falling short makes me want to hurl medical textbooks, the moment I savor how good it felt beneath you two nights ago without a single thought in my head... Chief Mizuki still came out ahead on this deal. Hand me my water first, then tell me which step stalled.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 这次不用给我讲解步骤。……直接用身体来验证吧，过来。
dark.text_en: No need to explain the steps to me this time. ...Let's verify it directly with our bodies. Come here.

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 灯暗，急促的吻与爱抚让被窝里的温度迅速升高。
dark.text_en: The lights dim as urgent kisses and caresses send the temperature under the covers soaring.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 嗯……现在我对你的手法非常赞同……哈啊、乳尖被捏得有点发麻了……
dark.text_en: Mmn... Right now I strongly endorse your manual technique... Haah, pinching my nipples like that is making them tingle...

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 啊……你不要挑我喘气的时候笑！
dark.text_en: Ah... Don't laugh right when I'm gasping for air!

dark.speaker: player
dark.text: 我没说话。
dark.text_en: I didn't say a word.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 那就别光用手了……我已经湿得一塌糊涂了，你明明摸到了吧？
dark.text_en: Then stop just using your hands... I'm already a soaked mess down there, and you clearly felt it, didn't you?

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 今晚不要叫我主任或者医生……快点进来，让我脑子彻底罢工！
dark.text_en: Don't call me Chief or Doctor tonight... Hurry up and come inside me so my brain goes on strike completely!

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 坂口沉身挺入，阿库娅修长的双腿猛地绷紧，原本试图维持理性的声音瞬间变成了高亢的娇喘。
dark.text_en: Sakaguchi sinks his hips and drives in; Aqua's long legs pull taut as her attempt at a rational tone shatters into high-pitched gasps.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 啊——！唔、好深……！原来什么都不用想、只被你顶着最里面是这种感觉……
dark.text_en: Aah—! Mmn, so deep...! So this is what it feels like to think about nothing at all and just have you pressing against my deepest spot...

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 你还没说你喜欢我呢……啊、听见了！再抱紧一点、再用力一点！要、要坏掉了……啊啊啊……！
dark.text_en: You haven't said you love me yet... Ah, I heard it! Hold me tighter, thrust harder! I-I'm going to break... aaah...!

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 黑屏，时间推移。
dark.text_en: Fade to black as time advances.

nurse_rin.title: 完美护士被早班查房
nurse_rin.title_en: The Perfect Nurse Caught by Morning Rounds

consult.speaker: narrator
consult.text: 美佳微笑着读完表格，又笑着确认每一个问题。直到坂口提醒签字后即锁定排程，她才抬手按住页边。
consult.text_en: Mika reads the form with a smile and confirms every question gracefully. Only when Sakaguchi reminds her that signing locks the schedule does she rest her fingers on the edge of the page.

consult.speaker: patient
consult.text: ……再留一分钟吧。我明明没有问题，却总觉得现在一签完字，明天就会来得太快。
consult.text_en: ...Give me just one more minute. I don't have any questions left, yet I feel like the moment I finish signing, tomorrow morning will arrive far too quickly.

consult.speaker: player
consult.text: 没关系，等你准备好再落笔。
consult.text_en: Take your time. Put pen to paper when you're ready.

consult.speaker: patient
consult.text: 谢谢。……好啦，签好了。真少见，我居然也有亲手把自己送进手术室的一天。
consult.text_en: Thank you. ...There, signed. How rare—to think the day would come when I personally sign myself onto the operating table.

night.speaker: narrator
night.text: 美佳在镜前调整头发，房间整齐得像没人住过。她看到坂口，从镜子里向他笑。
night.text_en: Adjusting her hair before the mirror, Mika has kept the room looking as pristine as if it were unoccupied. Spotting Sakaguchi in the reflection, she smiles at him.

night.speaker: patient
night.text: 欢迎。今天没有护士可以帮我们把一切安排得妥妥当当。
night.text_en: Welcome. Tonight there's no nurse here to arrange everything neatly for us.

night.speaker: player
night.text: 你会失望？
night.text_en: Disappointed?

night.speaker: patient
night.text: 不会。今晚我正想把‘妥当’这个词扔掉。……陪我好吗？只是因为我想要你。
night.text_en: Not at all. Tonight I was hoping to toss the word 'neat' right out the window. ...Will you stay with me? Simply because I want you.

night.speaker: narrator
night.text: 坂口反锁门，脱下衣物。美佳脱去病号服、换下米色蕾丝内衣与内裤时仍习惯把每件衣物折齐；折到最后，她忽然故意把整叠内衣推乱，赤着身躯，像个恶作剧得逞的人。
night.text_en: Sakaguchi locks the door and removes his clothes. Even while taking off her hospital gown and beige lace bra and panties, Mika habitually folds each piece neatly; at the very end, she deliberately shoves the folded stack of lingerie askew, standing bare with the smile of someone who just pulled off a prank.

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 美佳香汗淋漓地靠在枕边，下意识冲着房门微笑，仿佛有人敲了门。其实走廊安静得很。
after.text_en: Resting against the pillow dewy with sweat, Mika reflexively smiles toward the ward door as though someone had knocked. The hallway outside is dead silent.

after.speaker: player
after.text: 你在对谁笑？
after.text_en: Who are you smiling at?

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 对明天早班来接我的护士。我要先练习好第一句话：‘患者状况良好，请放心进行准备。’
after.text_en: At the morning-shift nurse coming to pick me up tomorrow. I have to practice my opening line in advance: 'The patient is in good condition; please proceed with pre-op prep at your convenience.'

after.speaker: player
after.text: 那是患者该说的话吗？
after.text_en: Is that a line a patient is supposed to say?

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 我知道不是。……可是既然已经签了字没法取消，如果不开玩笑，我怕明早真的会死死拉住她的袖子说‘能不能别推我进去’。
after.text_en: I know it isn't. ...But since I've already signed and can't cancel, if I don't make a joke out of it, I'm afraid tomorrow morning I'll actually grab her sleeve and beg, 'Can't you wait a little longer before wheeling me in?'

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她仍笑着，放在被单上的手却轻微发抖。
after.text_en: She keeps smiling, though her hand resting on the duvet trembles faintly.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 她们大概会被吓坏。最爱教人怎么安慰患者的中井护士，刚才在床上叫得那么失态，明天居然是最不想躺上那张手术台的人。
after.text_en: The girls would probably be shocked. Nurse Nakai, who loves teaching everyone how to soothe anxious patients, was moaning so shamelessly in bed a minute ago, and tomorrow she'll be the one who least wants to get on that operating table.

after.speaker: player
after.text: 那就让她们知道你也会害怕。
after.text_en: Then let them see that you get scared too.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 有意思。我一直想让别人觉得我很好相处，这会儿却只想让你看见我狼狈。
after.text_en: How interesting. I always want everyone to think I'm easygoing and composed, yet right now you're the only one I want to show my messiest side to.

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她瞥了眼椅上被自己推乱的米色内衣和病服，轻轻哼了一声。
after.text_en: Glancing at the beige lingerie and hospital gown she shoved askew on the chair, she lets out a soft hum.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 明早如果她们看到这个房间，看到我还光着身子躲在被子里……我可不打算解释为什么这么乱。
after.text_en: If they walk into this room tomorrow morning and see me still hiding naked under the covers... I have no intention of explaining why it's such a mess.

after.speaker: player
after.text: 需要我替你整理？
after.text_en: Want me to tidy it up for you?

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 不。……留着吧。今晚我本来就不打算做一个完美的护士。
after.text_en: No. ...Leave it as it is. Tonight I never intended to be a perfect nurse anyway.

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她突然把他的手握得很紧，像终于放弃表演。
after.text_en: Suddenly she squeezes his hand tightly, as if dropping the act at last.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 我现在真的怕得要命。先别告诉任何人。
after.text_en: I'm honestly scared out of my mind right now. Don't tell a soul.

success.speaker: patient
success.text: 护士来接我的时候，我没有说预先练习过的那句漂亮话，只说了句‘请慢一点’。现在手术顺利做完了，回想起前天晚上我故意把内衣推乱、还对着空房门傻笑练习台词的样子，连我自己都觉得害羞呢。
success.text_en: When the nurse came for me, I didn't use that polished line I practiced—I just said 'Please go a little slowly.' Now that the surgery is safely over, thinking back to how I deliberately shoved my underwear into a mess two nights ago and smiled at an empty door practicing lines... even I feel embarrassed.

success.speaker: player
success.text: 那晚那个‘不装淑女’的美佳，只有我一个人看见了。
success.text_en: Only I got to see the Mika who stopped acting like a lady that night.

success.speaker: patient
success.text: 呵呵，你还敢提……不过，一想起那天夜里被你抱在怀里弄得那么乱、连声音都忍住不叫出来的余韵，我就觉得偶尔不当完美护士也挺好的。谢谢你，隆司。
success.text_en: Hehe, how dare you bring that up... Still, whenever I recall being held in your arms and undone so thoroughly that I couldn't hold back my voice, I think dropping the perfect-nurse act once in a while is rather nice. Thank you, Takashi.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 你看，前天晚上我手一直在抖、总觉得明天来得太快的时候，果然是女人的直觉在提醒我这台手术没那么容易吧。
failure.text_en: See? Two nights ago when my hands wouldn't stop trembling and I felt tomorrow was coming too fast, my feminine intuition really was warning me this surgery wouldn't be so easy.

failure.speaker: player
failure.text: 抱歉，这次没能按计划完成。
failure.text_en: I'm sorry we couldn't complete it as planned this time.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 不用道歉呀。非要找原因的话……该不会是术前那天夜里，坂口医生在床上遵照我的要求‘手太不礼貌、做得太深太重’，结果把第二天开刀的力气都提前用光了吧？
failure.text_en: No need to apologize. If we must look for a cause... could it be that on the night before surgery, Dr. Sakaguchi followed my request in bed a little too well—being 'impolite with his hands and going so deep and hard'—that he used up tomorrow's surgical stamina ahead of schedule?

failure.speaker: narrator
failure.text: 她弯起眉眼促狭地笑了笑，随后把探病花束转到一旁，温软的手掌轻轻贴上他的脸颊。
failure.text_en: Her eyes crinkle with a teasing smile before she turns the visiting bouquet aside and gently presses her warm palm against his cheek.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 逗你玩的。虽然结果让人有些失落，但只要回味起前天晚上在你身下彻底放开自己的滋味，我就觉得为你躺上这张手术台完全值得。来，把复盘讲给我听吧。
failure.text_en: I'm only teasing you. Even though the outcome is a little disappointing, as long as I savor how completely I let myself go beneath you two nights ago, lying on this operating table for you was worth every bit of it. Come on, walk me through the debriefing.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 看见没有？我做了一件违反床旁管理原则的事。
dark.text_en: Did you see that? I just committed a violation of bedside management standards.

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 她拉他坐上床，轻吻他的唇。灯渐暗。
dark.text_en: She pulls him onto the bed and kisses his lips softly. The lights dim.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 嗯……没想到你会用这种眼神看着没穿衣服的我。
dark.text_en: Mmn... I didn't expect you to look at me undressed with eyes like that.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 今天可以不要那么礼貌吗？……再亲我一下，手也可以再过分一点。
dark.text_en: Can you stop being so polite tonight? ...Kiss me again, and let your hands be a little more forward.

dark.speaker: player
dark.text: 你自己也不用那么礼貌。
dark.text_en: You don't need to be polite either.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 啊，难得被你说中……唔、那里……已经被你摸得湿透了……
dark.text_en: Ah, you caught me... Nnh, down there... You've already touched me until I'm soaked...

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 让我抱着你。现在不用问我明天怎么办……直接进来，把我弄得更乱一点吧……
dark.text_en: Let me hold you. Don't ask me about tomorrow right now... Just come straight inside and mess me up even more...

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 坂口沉下腰，深深地进入她温润的身体。美佳平日得体的微笑瞬间化开，漏出一声带着颤音的叹息，手指紧紧抓住了床单。
dark.text_en: Sakaguchi sinks his hips, pushing deep into her warm body. Mika's composed everyday smile melts instantly into a trembling sigh as her fingers clutch the bedsheet.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: ……啊！嗯、哈啊……是，我今晚很高兴……被你顶到最深处的时候，连怎么装淑女都忘了……
dark.text_en: ...Ah! Nnh, haah... Yes, I'm so happy tonight... When you press against my deepest spot like that, I forget how to act like a lady at all...

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 如果听见我叫出声，就当作我们两个的秘密……啊、嗯……再重一点、我还不想让这个晚上结束……啊啊……！
dark.text_en: If you hear me cry out, keep it a secret between the two of us... Ah, nnh... Harder—I don't want this night to end yet... aah...!

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 完全黑屏、时间前移。
dark.text_en: Full fade to black as time advances.

doc_aoi.title: 那个“睡一觉就过去”的人
doc_aoi.title_en: The One Who Said "You Just Sleep Right Through It"

consult.speaker: narrator
consult.text: 成美在方案上圈出一句“术前按患者感受酌情安抚”，递回给坂口。
consult.text_en: Narumi circles the phrase *"soothe and wait as appropriate based on patient comfort prior to induction"* on the plan and hands it back to Sakaguchi.

consult.speaker: patient
consult.text: 这一句留着。既然签了字就不能打退堂鼓，我知道自己很可能会在进手术室前最后一分钟抓着你们不放。
consult.text_en: Keep this line in. Since signing means there's no backing out, I know very well I'll probably cling to you guys at the very last minute outside the OR doors.

consult.speaker: player
consult.text: 你不需要为此预先道歉。
consult.text_en: You don't need to apologize in advance for that.

consult.speaker: patient
consult.text: 好。我也不会拿‘我本来就是医生’当借口，假装自己天生不会怕。
consult.text_en: Good. And I won't use 'I'm a doctor myself' as an excuse to pretend I'm naturally immune to fear.

night.speaker: narrator
night.text: 成美将手机静音，连最后一条工作信息也不看。
night.text_en: Narumi puts her phone on silent without even checking the last work message.

night.speaker: patient
night.text: 我今晚谁也不照顾。我只想让你陪我，像其他普通恋人那样。
night.text_en: Tonight I'm not looking after anyone. I just want you to keep me company, like any ordinary couple.

night.speaker: player
night.text: 那么我今晚也不查房。
night.text_en: Then I'm off rounds tonight too.

night.speaker: patient
night.text: 这才对。……我想和你亲近，别逼我把愿望说成病历记录。
night.text_en: Now you're talking. ...I want to be close to you—don't make me phrase a wish like a medical chart entry.

night.speaker: narrator
night.text: 她亲手关掉顶灯。坂口锁门、脱去衣物；她大大方方地解开病号服，褪下酒红色的成熟内衣与内裤，把两人的衣物都推到门边，仿佛这样便能把工作关在外头。她赤着身躯将他拉到自己身旁。
night.text_en: She switches off the overhead light herself. Sakaguchi locks the door and removes his clothes; unfastening her hospital gown generously, she slips off her burgundy bra and panties and pushes both of their clothes over by the door, as if shutting work outside for good. Naked and warm, she pulls him down beside her.

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 成美散着微湿的长发，把发烫的脸埋在枕头里笑了好一会儿，忽然冲着天花板说出一句。
after.text_en: With damp hair spilling across her shoulders, Narumi buries her flushed face in the pillow and laughs for a long moment before speaking to the ceiling.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: ‘全麻嘛，睡一觉就过去了。’
after.text_en: 'It's general anesthesia—you just sleep right through it.'

after.speaker: player
after.text: 你在背谁的台词？
after.text_en: Whose line are you quoting?

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 我自己的！我以前对多少签完字没法反悔的患者这样说过？天哪，现在轮到我自己明天要被切开十几个小时，才发现这句话听起来真欠揍。
after.text_en: My own! How many patients who signed the form and couldn't back out have I said that to? Good grief, now that I'm the one being cut open for over ten hours tomorrow, I realize how punchable that line sounds.

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她坐起来，手忙脚乱地裹住被单遮住寸缕未着的身体。
after.text_en: Sitting up, she scrambles to wrap the sheet around her bare body.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 我明天真的要睡过去十几个小时，任由你们在台上动刀，然后醒来等你们宣布结果。可你看，我现在连门边的内裤和病号服都不敢去捡。刚才在你身下明明还快活得快晕过去！
after.text_en: Tomorrow I really have to sleep for over ten hours while you guys work on me with scalpels, then wake up waiting for your verdict. Yet look at me—right now I don't even dare walk over to the door to pick up my panties and hospital gown. Even though I was having the time of my life beneath you a minute ago!

after.speaker: player
after.text: 你不是现在才知道手术排程已经锁死了。
after.text_en: It's not like you just found out the surgical schedule is locked.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 知道！我知道得非常清楚！这就是我最想骂自己的地方！
after.text_en: I know! I know it crystal clear! That's precisely why I want to curse myself!

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她突然凶巴巴地指着坂口。
after.text_en: She suddenly points an accusing finger at Sakaguchi.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 我就这么光着赖在床上到明早了！如果明早我吓得说‘我不想进去’，就算按规矩肯定得把我推进去，你也绝对不许敷衍我一句‘睡一觉就好了’。不然我醒来就跟你翻脸！
after.text_en: I'm staying naked in this bed until morning! And if I panic tomorrow morning and say 'I don't want to go in,' even though protocol says you have to wheel me in anyway, you are strictly forbidden from brushing me off with 'you'll just sleep right through it.' Or I'll have it out with you when I wake up!

after.speaker: player
after.text: 那你希望我说什么？
after.text_en: What would you like me to say instead?

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 说你会认真开好每一刀。说有人在麻醉前陪着我。……然后让我抓住你一会儿，哪怕这听起来一点也不专业。
after.text_en: Tell me you'll make every incision count. Tell me someone will stay with me before induction. ...And let me hold onto you for a minute, even if it sounds completely unprofessional.

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她把手伸出来，喉咙一哽，笑容变得很小。
after.text_en: Holding out her hand, her throat catches, her smile shrinking.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 原来那句安慰真正难听的地方，是它省掉了人家害怕却又逃不掉的时间。
after.text_en: Turns out what's truly awful about that comforting line is how it skips right over the hours a person spends terrified with nowhere to run.

success.speaker: patient
success.text: 现在我可以亲口承认：‘睡一觉就好了’这句确实不够好。不过醒来以后回想前天夜里，我光着身子不敢去门边捡内裤、还凶巴巴地威胁你说错话就翻脸的样子……实在有点太丢人了。
success.text_en: Now I can admit it firsthand: 'You just sleep right through it' really isn't good enough. Though waking up and looking back at two nights ago—how I lay naked refusing to pick up my panties by the door and fiercely threatened to fall out with you if you said the wrong line... that was way too embarrassing.

success.speaker: player
success.text: 毕竟那晚有人在我身下刚快活得差点晕过去。
success.text_en: Well, someone had just nearly fainted from pleasure beneath me a few minutes earlier.

success.speaker: patient
success.text: 你还提！……不过，那天晚上你一边进入我、一边说喜欢我的感觉，直到现在想起来小腹里都还是热的。有那一晚垫底，这十几个小时的刀挨得倒也挺幸福。
success.text_en: Don't bring that up! ...Still, the feeling of you coming inside me while telling me you loved me that night still makes my lower belly warm just thinking about it. With that night under my belt, taking the knife for ten-plus hours actually felt pretty blissful.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 你看，我就说前天晚上我怎么都不敢去捡门边的病号服、心里直犯怵是有原因的吧。果然不是‘睡一觉就全都好了’那么简单。
failure.text_en: See? I told you there was a reason I couldn't bring myself to pick up my hospital gown by the door two nights ago and felt so on edge. Turns out it really isn't as simple as 'sleep once and everything's done.'

failure.speaker: player
failure.text: 这次没能完成目标，我先把具体原因跟你说清楚。
failure.text_en: We couldn't complete the target this time. Let me explain the exact reasons first.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 原因我当然要听。不过在此之前……坂口医生，你是不是术前夜在床上狠狠抱我的时候把力气全使完了，第二天上了手术台才没撑住的？
failure.text_en: Of course I'll listen to the reasons. But before that... Dr. Sakaguchi, did you use up every ounce of your strength holding me so fiercely in bed on the night before surgery that you couldn't hold out at the operating table the next day?

failure.speaker: narrator
failure.text: 她斜睨着他笑了一声，随后伸出微凉的手指握住他的手掌，声音柔和下来。
failure.text_en: She shoots him a sidelong glance with a chuckle, then reaches out her cool fingers to clasp his palm, her tone softening.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 别往心里去，我是拿你逗闷子呢。虽然手术没成挺让人失落的，但一想起前天晚上被你摸遍全身、一边听你说喜欢我一边去到顶峰的滋味……这趟患者我当得一点都不亏。说吧，当时是怎么决定停下的？
failure.text_en: Don't take it to heart, I'm just ribbing you. Even though falling short is disappointing, whenever I remember having every inch of me caressed two nights ago and climaxing while hearing you say you loved me... playing the patient this time wasn't a loss at all. Tell me, how did you make the call to stop?

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 过来。我现在不需要一位主刀坐得那么端正。
dark.text_en: Get over here. Right now I don't need an attending surgeon sitting with straight posture.

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 微光中亲吻，灯暗，粗重的呼吸很快在床间交织。
dark.text_en: They kiss in the dim glow; the lamp goes dark, and heavy breaths quickly entwine across the bed.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: ……嗯。今天总算有人只叫我的名字，只碰我的身体了。
dark.text_en: ...Mmn. Finally, someone is just calling my name and touching my body tonight.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 再亲我一下。……啊，别这么突然揉那里……会忍不住叫出来的……
dark.text_en: Kiss me again. ...Ah, don't rub me there so suddenly... I won't be able to keep my voice down...

dark.speaker: player
dark.text: 成美，我喜欢你。
dark.text_en: Narumi, I love you.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 这句我想再听一次……一边进来一边说给我听。
dark.text_en: I want to hear that line again... Say it to me while you come inside.

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 坂口顺应她的邀请沉身进入，成美发出一声沙哑而性感的闷哼，双腿紧紧盘住他的腰，迎合着每一次深入。
dark.text_en: Answering her invitation, Sakaguchi sinks his hips inside her; Narumi lets out a husky, sensual groan, wrapping her legs tightly around his waist to meet every deep stroke.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 唔、啊……！好深……今晚就这样狠狠抱着我……我这会儿好像真的什么都不怕了，真是没出息……
dark.text_en: Nnh, ah...! So deep... Just hold me hard like this tonight... Right now I don't feel scared of anything at all, how hopeless of me...

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 不要放开……再快一点，让我再得意一会儿……啊、嗯……我也喜欢你……要、要去了——啊啊……！
dark.text_en: Don't let go... Faster, let me ride this high a little longer... Ah, mmn... I love you too... I-I'm coming—aah...!

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 全黑，时间经过。门边堆着散落的酒红色内衣与白大褂。
dark.text_en: Full fade to black as time passes. By the door lies a tangled heap of burgundy lingerie and his white coat.

nurse_haru.title: 推床的方向反了
nurse_haru.title_en: The Gurney Is Rolling the Wrong Way

consult.speaker: narrator
consult.text: 恋本能地站在会诊桌边，准备给坂口递资料，听见“请坐”才意识到今天被照顾的是自己。
consult.text_en: Out of habit, Ren stands beside the consultation desk ready to hand files to Sakaguchi, only realizing upon hearing "Please have a seat" that she is the one being cared for today.

consult.speaker: patient
consult.text: 怪了。我连坐下来听你讲风险都需要提醒。明天真的躺上去，连取消都没法取消的时候，恐怕连手该放哪儿都不知道。
consult.text_en: How strange. I even needed a reminder just to sit down and listen to the risks. Tomorrow when I actually lie down on the table with zero chance of canceling, I probably won't even know where to put my hands.

consult.speaker: player
consult.text: 护士会帮你。
consult.text_en: The nurses will help you.

consult.speaker: patient
consult.text: ……知道。那这次轮到我好好麻烦大家了。
consult.text_en: ...I know. Then this time it's my turn to be in everyone's care.

night.speaker: narrator
night.text: 恋看见坂口先问了一句“累不累”，紧接着自己笑出声。
night.text_en: Seeing Sakaguchi enter, Ren instinctively asks "Are you tired?" before bursting into laughter at herself.

night.speaker: patient
night.text: 啊，我又在关心别人。……今晚换你关心我，好吗？
night.text_en: Ah, there I go worrying about others again. ...Tonight, will you worry about me instead?

night.speaker: player
night.text: 你想要什么？
night.text_en: What would you like?

night.speaker: patient
night.text: 想要你留下来，想要你抱我。不是因为我是患者才有这种资格……是因为我喜欢你。
night.text_en: I want you to stay, and I want you to hold me. Not because being a patient entitles me to it... but because I love you.

night.speaker: narrator
night.text: 坂口落锁，脱下工作服与其他衣物；恋换下病号服，褪下淡粉色的棉质胸罩与内裤时，一开始还习惯把它们放在供护士收取的篮子旁，随即摇摇头，羞怯地随手丢到床边，第一次不想替谁整理。她赤着身子拉起被单，让他坐下来。
night.text_en: Sakaguchi locks the door and takes off his uniform and clothes; changing out of her hospital gown and pale-pink cotton bra and panties, Ren starts to place them beside the collection basket for the nurses out of habit, then shakes her head and shyly tosses them beside the bed—for the first time not wanting to tidy up for anyone. Naked, she lifts the sheet and invites him to sit.

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 深夜走廊有人推车经过。原本还带着欢爱余韵、靠在坂口怀里的恋突然坐直，脱口而出。
after.text_en: Late at night, a cart rolls down the hallway outside. Still basking in the afterglow in Sakaguchi's arms, Ren suddenly bolts upright and blurts out:

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 这边让一下，推床经过——
after.text_en: Coming through on this side, gurney passing—

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她自己先愣住，被单从光裸的肩头滑落。
after.text_en: She freezes, the sheet sliding off her bare shoulders.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: ……不对，明早被推过去的是我啊！
after.text_en: ...Wait, tomorrow morning the one being wheeled down the hall is me!

after.speaker: player
after.text: 终于想起来了？
after.text_en: Finally remembered?

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 全麻十几个小时的大手术啊。刚才还被你弄得脑子一片空白，现在突然想起来，平时是我站在床头哄那些签了字想哭的患者‘我们走了’，明天却是我自己光着身子换上手术服，一刀一刀被你们切开缝合。方向完全反过来了。
after.text_en: It's a ten-plus-hour major surgery under general anesthesia! A minute ago you had my mind completely blank, and now it hits me: usually I'm standing at the head of the bed telling patients who want to cry after signing 'Off we go,' and tomorrow I'll be the one stripped bare in a surgical gown waiting to be cut open and sutured blade by blade. The direction is completely backwards!

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她看了一眼床边散落的淡粉色内裤，却没有去捡，只是把被单扯得很紧，眼泪毫无预兆地掉下来。
after.text_en: She glances at her pale-pink panties scattered beside the bed without picking them up, clutching the sheet tightly as tears spill down her cheeks without warning.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 我今晚不想穿衣服了，反正明天也逃不掉，还得被前辈们全都脱光检查一遍……我好想在病号服上别一张纸条：‘哪怕我已经签了字不能取消，推我的时候也请轻一点，我真的会哭。’……可是这样前辈一定以为我在开玩笑！
after.text_en: I don't want to put my clothes back on tonight—there's no escaping tomorrow anyway, and my seniors will strip me bare to inspect and prep me all over again... I really want to pin a note to my gown saying: 'Even though I signed and can't cancel, please wheel me gently, I really might cry.' ...But if I wrote that, my seniors would think I'm joking!

after.speaker: player
after.text: 你可以直接告诉她们。
after.text_en: You can tell them directly.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 我知道，可是我没法对自己说‘别怕’。我听见这两个字反而更想哭。
after.text_en: I know, I just can't tell myself 'don't be scared.' Hearing those two words only makes me want to cry harder.

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她想了片刻，赤着身子重新钻回他怀里。
after.text_en: After a moment's thought, she burrows naked back into his arms.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 明早我不要当特别懂事的护士。就算必须躺上手术台，我也要当一个能请她们握着我手缓一缓的患者。……你帮我记着，好吗？
after.text_en: Tomorrow morning I don't want to be a sensible nurse. Even if I have to get on the operating table, I want to be a patient who can ask them to hold my hand for a moment. ...Will you help me remember that?

success.speaker: patient
success.text: 推床那段路，明明每天走过，躺着看天花板却像第一次经过。现在手术顺利做完了，一想起前天半夜我光着身子坐在床上喊‘推床经过让一下’、还哭着说想在病号服上别纸条的样子，真是害羞得不敢见人了……
success.text_en: I walk that hallway with gurneys every single day, yet lying flat looking up at the ceiling felt like passing through it for the very first time. Now that the surgery is safely finished, remembering how I sat up naked at midnight yelling 'Gurney passing, coming through!' and cried about pinning a note to my gown... I'm too embarrassed to face anyone!

success.speaker: player
success.text: 但那天晚上你说‘想把连在一起的感觉留到明早’，确实留住了吧？
success.text_en: Though when you said that night you wanted to 'keep the feeling of staying connected until morning,' it stayed with you, didn't it?

success.speaker: patient
success.text: 呜，你别原封不动地学我说话呀……不过，被你从胸口一路摸下去、抱得紧紧的那种安心感，真的陪我撑过了麻醉前的害怕。谢谢你，隆司。
success.text_en: Uu, don't quote my exact words back to me... Still, the reassurance of having you caress me all the way down from my chest and hold me so close really carried me through the fear before anesthesia. Thank you, Takashi.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 我一睁眼就问‘是不是要再推回去重做’……看来前天半夜我听见推车声就吓得掉眼泪、总觉得方向反过来不踏实，果然是预感到了今天会不顺利吧。
failure.text_en: The first thing I asked when I opened my eyes was 'Do we have to wheel me back for a redo?' ...Looks like bursting into tears when I heard the cart at midnight two nights ago and feeling uneasy about the direction being reversed really was a premonition that today wouldn't go smoothly.

failure.speaker: player
failure.text: 抱歉，恋，这次手术没能按计划完成。
failure.text_en: I'm sorry, Ren. We couldn't complete the surgery as planned this time.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 你别这么严肃嘛……真要算账的话，是不是因为术前夜你在床上一直满足我的任性，抱我抱得太久、顶得太深，结果第二天开刀的时候你也累得没力气啦？
failure.text_en: Don't look so grim... If we really want to settle accounts, could it be that you indulged my selfishness in bed for too long on the night before surgery—holding me so tight and pressing so deep—that you wore yourself out for the operating table the next day?

failure.speaker: narrator
failure.text: 她红着脸小声拿他打趣了一句，随后轻轻握住他的手指贴在自己脸颊旁。
failure.text_en: Blushing, she teases him softly before lacing her fingers with his and pressing his hand against her cheek.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 我开玩笑的。虽然有一点难过，可只要想起前天晚上在你怀里不用照顾任何人、只被你一个人疼爱的滋味，我就觉得这顿刀挨得一点也不亏。来，告诉我为什么停下吧。
failure.text_en: I'm only joking. Even though I'm a little sad, whenever I remember lying in your arms two nights ago not having to look after anyone else and being loved by you alone, taking this knife wasn't a loss at all. Come on, tell me why we had to stop.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 今天不用帮别人铺床。我自己要躺下啦……你也来。
dark.text_en: No making beds for anyone else tonight. I'm lying down myself... Come join me.

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 她主动吻他，床头灯渐暗。
dark.text_en: She kisses him first as the bedside lamp dims.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 嗯……我本来以为自己会很害羞。
dark.text_en: Mmn... I thought I'd be too shy for this.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 啊，被你这样从胸口一路往下摸……还是好害羞。你别笑啦。
dark.text_en: Ah, having you caress me all the way down from my chest like that... is still so embarrassing. Don't laugh at me.

dark.speaker: player
dark.text: 不会笑。
dark.text_en: I'm not laughing.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 那就再亲我一下……拜托。……唔、下面已经湿了……我可不是因为你明天要替我开刀才变成这样的……
dark.text_en: Then kiss me again... please. ...Nnh, I'm already wet down there... And it's definitely not because you're operating on me tomorrow...

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 坂口温柔地覆上她，缓缓推进去。恋倒吸一口气，敏感的身体瞬间绷紧，双手紧紧抓住了他的手臂。
dark.text_en: Sakaguchi gently covers her and presses slowly inside. Ren sucks in a breath, her sensitive body tensing instantly as both hands grip his forearms.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 啊……！嗯、哈啊……好满……今天先不说谢谢，只说喜欢你……
dark.text_en: Ah...! Nnh, haah... So full... Tonight I won't say thank you, I'll only say I love you...

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 好高兴……里面又热又涨……今晚能不能就一直这么连在一起？……啊、嗯……再抱紧一点，我想把这感觉留到明早……要、要去了……啊啊……！
dark.text_en: I'm so happy... It's so hot and full inside... Can we stay connected just like this all night? ...Ah, mmn... Hold me tighter, I want to keep this feeling inside me until tomorrow morning... I-I'm coming... aah...!

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 黑屏，时间经过。
dark.text_en: Fade to black as time passes.

doc_shiori.title: 没有人要求你漂亮地挨刀
doc_shiori.title_en: Nobody Asked You to Take the Knife Gracefully

consult.speaker: narrator
consult.text: 詩織把笔握得端正漂亮，手心却湿得有些打滑。
consult.text_en: Shiori holds the pen with impeccable posture, though her palm is damp enough to slip.

consult.speaker: patient
consult.text: 你们说签完字就不能中途退场，也不用我表现得像‘模范患者’……我听了竟然有点委屈。
consult.text_en: When you told me there's no leaving halfway once I sign, and that I don't need to act like a 'model patient'... I actually felt a little aggrieved.

consult.speaker: player
consult.text: 为什么？
consult.text_en: Why is that?

consult.speaker: patient
consult.text: 因为我刚才真的在想，既然明天无论如何都得挨这十几个小时的刀，要怎样害怕才显得不难看。……算了，我签。我可以不漂亮地害怕一次。
consult.text_en: Because I was genuinely trying to figure out how to be terrified gracefully, given that I have to take the knife for over ten hours tomorrow no matter what. ...Forget it, I'll sign. I can afford to be ungracefully terrified just once.

night.speaker: narrator
night.text: 詩織把头发放下来，发箍收在小盒里。
night.text_en: Shiori lets her hair down, placing her headband inside a small case.

night.speaker: patient
night.text: 你看，今晚我一点也不像平时的我了。
night.text_en: Look—tonight I'm nothing like my usual self.

night.speaker: player
night.text: 我还是很喜欢。
night.text_en: I love you all the same.

night.speaker: patient
night.text: 那就来陪我过夜吧。今晚我想不用努力，就被你喜欢。
night.text_en: Then stay the night with me. Tonight I want to be loved by you without having to try so hard.

night.speaker: narrator
night.text: 她笑着去关门，坂口落锁，脱掉外衣；她换下病号服，红着脸解开纯白蕾丝胸罩与内裤，却没有像平常那样整理好，只用被单遮住自己匀称的裸体，朝床的另一侧拍了一下。
night.text_en: Smiling, she closes the door while Sakaguchi locks it and removes his outer clothes; changing out of her hospital gown, she blushes as she unfastens her pure-white lace bra and panties, leaving them unfolded for once and using only the sheet to shield her slender naked body as she pats the other side of the mattress.

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 詩織呼吸微乱地靠在枕头上，望见盒里的发箍，突然低呼出声。
after.text_en: Leaning against the pillow with flushed cheeks and uneven breaths, Shiori spots the headband case on the table and lets out a sudden gasp.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 等等！明天我戴手术帽的时候，头发得全部塞进去，对吧？
after.text_en: Wait! When I put on the surgical cap tomorrow, all of my hair has to be tucked inside, right?

after.speaker: player
after.text: 是。
after.text_en: Right.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 而且换衣、核对、备皮、插管……然后我就要在那盏无影灯底下睡上十几个小时，肚子里外被你们切开再缝上？！
after.text_en: And changing gowns, verification, skin prep, catheterization... and then I have to sleep under that shadowless lamp for over ten hours while you cut my belly open and sew it back up?!

after.speaker: player
after.text: 嗯。
after.text_en: Yes.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 天哪！刚才在你怀里的时候，我还可以自己决定怎么笑、怎么亲你；可一想到明天连头发怎么放、什么时候被切开都由不得我，甚至连说一句‘我今天状态不好，改天再做吧’都不被允许……隆司，我真的不能借口发烧把明天的手术退掉吗？！
after.text_en: Good heavens! In your arms just now, I could still choose how to smile and how to kiss you; but when I realize that tomorrow I don't even get a say in how my hair is tucked away or when I get cut open—and I'm not even allowed to say 'I'm not feeling up to it today, let's reschedule'... Takashi, can't I really claim I have a fever and cancel tomorrow's surgery?!

after.speaker: player
after.text: 你的体温和生命体征刚才我已经亲自确认过了，非常健康，退不掉。
after.text_en: I just personally verified your body temperature and vital signs a moment ago. You're in peak health—no cancellations.

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 詩織气鼓鼓地抱着发箍盒，眼圈却慢慢泛红。
after.text_en: Pouting as she hugs the headband case, Shiori's eyes slowly rim with red.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 你怎么这么铁面无私呀……要是明早那位总夸我漂亮的护士来推我，看见我想逃又逃不掉、在床上掉眼泪的样子，我该怎么办？她越温柔，我肯定越觉得丢人。
after.text_en: How can you be so strictly impartial... When the nurse who always compliments how pretty I am comes to wheel me away tomorrow morning and sees me wanting to run with nowhere to go, crying in bed, what am I supposed to do? The gentler she is, the more mortified I'll feel.

after.speaker: player
after.text: 那就哭出来。手术台上没人给你的仪态打分。
after.text_en: Then go ahead and cry. Nobody grades your poise on the operating table.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 说得容易……我现在连内衣和病号服都不敢穿回去了，仿佛一穿上，明早八点的推床就会立刻撞开门进来。
after.text_en: Easy for you to say... Right now I don't even dare put my underwear and hospital gown back on, as if the moment I dress, the eight-o'clock gurney will burst through the door.

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她把床边的纯白内裤和病服推远，理直气壮地光着身子钻回被单。
after.text_en: Pushing the white panties and gown beside the bed further away, she burrows naked back under the sheet.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 既然你不肯放我当逃兵，那今晚到此为止，不再当‘得体的藤崎医生’，我就这么光着赖在你怀里了！明早她们要什么样的患者再来接我！
after.text_en: Since you refuse to let me desert, tonight ends right here—no more 'graceful Dr. Fujisaki,' I'm staying naked in your arms! Tomorrow morning they can come collect whatever kind of patient I happen to be!

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她停了一下，声音小了。
after.text_en: She pauses, her voice dropping.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: ……不过，你明天能不能在她们面前也叫我詩織？我可能需要听见一个熟悉的声音。
after.text_en: ...Still, tomorrow in front of the nurses, will you call me Shiori too? I think I'll need to hear a familiar voice.

success.speaker: patient
success.text: 入室之前我真的哭得难看极了，护士只说‘没关系，我们等你呼吸平稳了再推’。现在手术顺利结束，回想起前天晚上我抱着发箍盒求你让我假装发烧退掉手术、还把内裤推远光着身子赖在你怀里的样子……实在太不淑女了。
success.text_en: Right before entering the OR I really cried terribly, and the nurse simply said, 'It's alright, we'll wait until your breathing steadies before wheeling you in.' Now that the surgery is over, remembering how I hugged my headband case two nights ago begging you to let me fake a fever to cancel, and pushed my panties away to cling to you naked... how utterly unladylike.

success.speaker: player
success.text: 我倒觉得那天晚上一点也不端庄的詩織非常迷人。
success.text_en: I thought the unpoised Shiori of that night was breathtaking.

success.speaker: patient
success.text: 笨蛋，不许再拿那晚我乱叫的事取笑我了！……不过，回味起那天夜里你一边看着我的眼睛一边深深进入我的感觉，比别人夸我漂亮一百遍都让我觉得幸福。现在我也准备好听报告啦。
success.text_en: Dummy, stop teasing me about the noises I made that night! ...Still, savoring how you looked into my eyes while pressing deep inside me that night made me happier than being called pretty a hundred times over. Now I'm ready to hear the report.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 你看，前天晚上我看着发箍盒心里发慌、怎么都想借口发烧把手术退掉，果然是因为我的直觉早就觉得这次不太妙吧。
failure.text_en: See? Two nights ago when I stared at my headband case panicking and desperately wanted to fake a fever to cancel the surgery, my intuition already knew things wouldn't go smoothly this time.

failure.speaker: player
failure.text: 抱歉，詩織，这次没能完成目标。
failure.text_en: I'm sorry, Shiori. We couldn't complete the target this time.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 哼，我是不是可以怀疑一下——某位主刀医生前天晚上在病房里拉着我确认‘体温和生命体征’的时候太过投入，把精力全花在让我害羞乱叫上了，结果第二天上台才没发挥好呀？
failure.text_en: Hmph, am I allowed to harbor a suspicion—that a certain lead surgeon got so carried away 'verifying my body temperature and vital signs' in bed two nights ago, spending all his energy making me blush and cry out, that he underperformed on the table the next day?

failure.speaker: narrator
failure.text: 她带着几分娇嗔白了他一眼，随后又轻轻叹了口气，主动握住他的手。
failure.text_en: She shoots him a coy look, then lets out a soft sigh and takes his hand.

failure.speaker: patient

success.text_en: Crystal clear! I couldn't forget that even without a sticky note... Just remembering the warmth of your palms and how deep you pressed inside me that night makes me so glad we finished this major surgery.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 我就说前天半夜我醒过来总想假装失忆不去手术室，是身体提前察觉到这次手术不太顺利吧！
failure.text_en: I knew waking up at midnight two nights ago wanting to fake amnesia to skip the OR was my body sensing ahead of time that this surgery would hit a bump!

failure.speaker: player
failure.text: 今天不用强迫自己写完整记录，我先跟你说说为什么停下。
failure.text_en: You don't have to force yourself to write a full log today. Let me tell you why we stopped first.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 嗯，我得记下来……不过隆司，第一条原因该不会是：主刀医生在手术前夜拉着患者在床上做得太激烈，害得我脑袋空空、连你自己的体力也忘在我的被窝里了吧？
failure.text_en: Okay, I should jot it down... Though Takashi, could Reason #1 be: the attending surgeon went so hard with the patient in bed on the night before surgery that he left my head blank and forgot his own stamina under my covers?

failure.speaker: narrator
failure.text: 她歪着头促狭地眨了眨眼，随即红着脸把他的手拉过来贴在脸颊上。
failure.text_en: Tilting her head, she blinks mischievously before blushing and pulling his hand against her cheek.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 开玩笑的啦。虽然这次没做好有点失望，但前天晚上被你抱紧、用身体记住你有多喜欢我的感觉，我一辈子都不会忘。光是为了那个晚上，躺这一回就非常值得了。
failure.text_en: Just kidding. Even though falling short this time is a little disappointing, the feeling of being held tight by you two nights ago and memorizing with my body how much you love me is something I won't forget for the rest of my life. For that night alone, lying on the table was worth it.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 我保证今晚不会把你的名字贴在枕头上。
dark.text_en: I promise I won't stick your name to the pillow tonight.

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 两人亲吻，灯光暗下来。
dark.text_en: They kiss as the lights dim.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 嗯……你手掌的温度，我不用写下来也能记住。
dark.text_en: Mmn... I don't need to write down the warmth of your palm to remember it.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 啊……你这样叫我名字，又摸我的胸口，我反而会害羞……
dark.text_en: Ah... Calling my name like that while touching my chest makes me feel shy all over...

dark.speaker: player
dark.text: 我喜欢你。
dark.text_en: I love you.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 再说一次，我想用身体记住……唔、下面已经湿了，快点进来吧……
dark.text_en: Say it again, I want to memorize it with my body... Nnh, I'm already wet down there, so hurry and come inside...

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 坂口覆上她的身体，缓缓挺入到底。遥凑睁大眼睛，随即发出一声轻喘，双臂紧紧环住他的脖子。
dark.text_en: Sakaguchi covers her body and presses slowly to the hilt. Haruka's eyes widen before she lets out a soft gasp, wrapping both arms tightly around his neck.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 啊……！嗯、哈啊……好满……要是明天忘了什么，也绝对不能忘记今晚被你填满的感觉……
dark.text_en: Ah...! Nnh, haah... So full... Even if I forget something tomorrow, I must never forget the feeling of being filled up by you tonight...

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 别笑，我说得很认真……啊、嗯……那里顶得好舒服……现在不许去找笔，用力抱住我……要、要去了——啊啊……！
dark.text_en: Don't laugh, I mean it seriously... Ah, mmn... Pressing right there feels so good... No looking for pens right now, just hold me tight... I-I'm coming—aah...!

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 完全黑屏，时钟推进。
dark.text_en: Full fade to black as the clock advances.

nurse_moe.title: 请允许我害怕五分钟
nurse_moe.title_en: Please Allow Me Five Minutes to Be Scared

consult.speaker: narrator
consult.text: 萌恵听得极认真，忽然在“准备时间”旁画了一个大圆圈，小声咽了下口水。
consult.text_en: Moe listens intently, then draws a big circle next to "Prep Time" and swallows nervously.

consult.speaker: patient
consult.text: 这、这里真的要这么早开始吗？而且刚才说签完字以后，就算明早害怕得发抖也不能取消手术了……
consult.text_en: D-Does prep really start this early? And you said once I sign, even if I'm shaking with fear tomorrow morning, the surgery can't be canceled anymore...

consult.speaker: player
consult.text: 是。如果你现在还没有下定决心，我们可以先不签。
consult.text_en: Yes. If you haven't made up your mind yet, we can hold off on signing.

consult.speaker: patient
consult.text: 不、我要签！正因为我很胆小，要是不把退路堵死的话，我明天一看见手术室大门肯定会逃跑的……请把笔给我！
consult.text_en: N-No, I want to sign! Precisely because I'm such a coward, if I don't block off my own escape route right now, I'll definitely run away the second I see the OR doors tomorrow... Please hand me the pen!

night.speaker: narrator
night.text: 萌恵坐在病床中央，双手放在膝上，仿佛已经做好了一场艰难的决定。
night.text_en: Moe sits in the center of the bed with both hands on her knees, as if having resolved a monumental decision.

night.speaker: patient
night.text: 今天我想自己开口……我想你留下来，想和你亲近。不是因为明天要做手术，我本来就想。
night.text_en: Tonight I want to ask for it myself... I want you to stay, and I want to be close to you. Not because I'm having surgery tomorrow—I wanted to all along.

night.speaker: player
night.text: 我愿意。
night.text_en: I'd love to.

night.speaker: patient
night.text: 那我就不再用‘打扰你了’做开场白啦。
night.text_en: Then I won't start with 'Sorry to bother you' tonight.

night.speaker: narrator
night.text: 她伸手去关门，坂口确认落锁，脱下外衣。她红着脸换下病号服，脱掉印着小草莓的白色纯棉胸罩与内裤，床边堆了几件衣物；见坂口还站着，她羞怯地拍了拍被单，认真地把位置挪出来。
night.text_en: She reaches out to close the door while Sakaguchi locks it and removes his outer clothes. Blushing crimson, she changes out of her hospital gown and slips off her strawberry-print white cotton bra and panties, leaving a small pile of clothes beside the bed; seeing Sakaguchi still standing, she shyly pats the sheet and earnestly makes room for him.

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 萌恵红扑扑地喘着气，一边笑，一边把被单拽得高高的遮住赤裸的胸口，忽然听见门外走廊传来有人问“几号病房”。
after.text_en: Panting with rosy cheeks, Moe giggles while pulling the sheet high up over her bare chest—until she hears someone in the hallway outside ask "Which room number?"

after.speaker: patient
after.text: ……呀啊！是、是来接我去做手术了吗？！
after.text_en: ...Kyaa! A-Are they here to take me to surgery already?!

after.speaker: player
after.text: 不是，只是夜班查房。明天早上才给你做术前准备。
after.text_en: No, that's just night rounds. Your pre-op prep isn't until tomorrow morning.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 呜……吓死我了！刚才和你在一起太舒服了，我居然把明天要做〈本次术式〉的事忘得一干二净……十几个小时的全麻大手术，真的要把肚子切开、流那么多血、还要切掉里面的东西……
after.text_en: Uu... That scared the life out of me! Being with you felt so good just now that I completely forgot I'm having 〈本次术式〉 tomorrow... Over ten hours of major surgery under general anesthesia, where you really cut my belly open, make me bleed, and cut things out inside...

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她低头看着自己光溜溜的身体，眼泪突然在眼眶里打转，小手紧紧揪住坂口的胳膊。
after.text_en: Looking down at her bare body under the sheet, tears suddenly well up in her eyes as her small hands clutch Sakaguchi's arm.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 坂口医生……我、我白天是不是太冲动了？我现在突然好害怕，肚子一抽一抽地发紧……我们能不能跟明天的前辈们说一声，就说萌恵临时反悔了，这次先不做了好不好……？
after.text_en: Dr. Sakaguchi... W-Was I too impulsive during the day? I'm suddenly so terrified, my stomach is cramping up... Can't we tell my seniors tomorrow morning that Moe got cold feet and cancel it just this once...?

after.speaker: player
after.text: 不行哦，萌恵。同意书已经进档了，明早准备车一推过来，就算你躲进被窝里也会被前辈们抱上推床的。
after.text_en: No can do, Moe. The consent form is already filed—once the prep cart rolls in tomorrow morning, even if you hide under the covers, your seniors will scoop you right onto the gurney.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 呜呜……怎么这样……明明知道不会留下永久伤害，过两天就能恢复，可是一想到明天真的逃不掉了、非得躺在手术台上被切开不可，我连床边的草莓内裤都不敢伸手去拿了……
after.text_en: Uuu... How could you... Even knowing it won't leave permanent damage and I'll heal in a couple of days, just realizing there's really no escaping tomorrow and I have to lie on that table and be cut open makes me too scared to even reach for my strawberry panties beside the bed...

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她吸了吸鼻子，干脆把脑袋缩进坂口怀里，光着身子贴紧他。
after.text_en: Sniffling, she ducks her head into Sakaguchi's chest, pressing her naked body flush against him.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 既然怎么求你都不准取消……那我今晚就不穿内裤和病号服了！反正明天前辈们还要替我换衣、备皮、插管做全套准备。明早我肯定会吓哭的，到时候就算不准停下手术，你也得让前辈们等我哭完五分钟再推我进去……
after.text_en: Since begging won't get it canceled... I'm not putting my panties or hospital gown back on tonight! My seniors have to change me, prep my skin, and catheterize me tomorrow morning anyway. I'm definitely going to cry tomorrow morning, so even if you won't call off the surgery, you have to make my seniors wait five minutes for me to finish crying before wheeling me in...

success.speaker: patient
success.text: 那天早上弘子前辈一边摸我的头哄我，一边帮我换好手术衣抱上了推床。现在平安醒过来，一想起前天半夜我听见查房声就吓得揪住你胳膊、哭着求你取消手术、还不敢去拿草莓内裤的样子……真是羞死人了。
success.text_en: That morning, Sugimura-senpai patted my head to coax me while helping me into my surgical gown and lifting me onto the gurney. Now that I'm safely awake, remembering how I heard night rounds at midnight two nights ago and clutched your arm crying to cancel the surgery—while refusing to put on my strawberry panties... I'm so ashamed I could die!

success.speaker: player
success.text: 现在觉得怎么样？
success.text_en: How do you feel now?

success.speaker: patient
success.text: 现在我很高兴！而且……只要回想起那天夜里我自己主动求你摸我、被你热乎乎地填满全身的感觉，我就觉得幸好当时你没答应让我退缩。谢谢你，坂口医生。
success.text_en: Now I'm super happy! And... whenever I remember begging you to touch me that night and being filled with your warmth from head to toe, I'm so glad you didn't let me back out. Thank you, Dr. Sakaguchi.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 呜……我就知道前天半夜我肚子一抽一抽地发紧、哭着想临时反悔，是因为身体早就预感到这次手术不太妙了……
failure.text_en: Uu... I knew my stomach cramping up at midnight two nights ago and crying to back out was my body sensing ahead of time that this surgery wouldn't go smoothly...

failure.speaker: player
failure.text: 结果没达到，但团队及时做了安全止损。我把原因讲给你听。
failure.text_en: We didn't reach the final goal, but the team aborted safely in time. Let me explain why.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 嗯……不过坂口医生，有件事我不知道该不该问……是不是因为前天晚上我在床上太贪心、一直缠着让你用力顶我，把坂口医生的力气都耗光了，第二天手术才没成功的呀……？
failure.text_en: Okay... Um, Dr. Sakaguchi, I don't know if I should ask this... Could it be because I was too greedy in bed two nights ago and kept clinging to you asking you to thrust harder, draining all of Dr. Sakaguchi's strength before the surgery the next day...?

failure.speaker: narrator
failure.text: 她红着小脸怯生生地说完，又赶紧握住坂口的手摇了摇。
failure.text_en: Blushing furiously as she asks timidly, she quickly clasps Sakaguchi's hand and gives it a little shake.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 对、对不起，我是跟你开玩笑的！虽然手术没做成有点难过，可是一想起前天晚上被你抱在怀里那么舒服、那么幸福的滋味，我就觉得挨这一刀一点都不后悔！
failure.text_en: I-I'm sorry, I was just trying to make a joke! Even though I'm a little sad the surgery didn't finish, whenever I remember how good and happy it felt being held in your arms two nights ago, I don't regret taking this knife one bit!

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 已经脱光准备好啦。……等等，我是指今晚的事！明天那件还没准备好。
dark.text_en: I'm all undressed and ready. ...Wait, I mean for tonight! I'm still not ready for tomorrow's thing at all.

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 两人笑着亲吻，灯暗。
dark.text_en: Smiling, they kiss as the lights dim.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 啊……你一摸我，我刚才叫得太大声了吧？
dark.text_en: Ah... The moment you touched me, did I squeak too loudly just now?

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 嗯，你再亲一下……下面也摸一摸……我真的想。
dark.text_en: Mmn, kiss me again... and touch me down there too... I really want you to.

dark.speaker: player
dark.text: 没有人催你。
dark.text_en: Nobody's rushing you.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 那我就慢慢来……唔、那里已经湿透了……原来我也能这么兴奋……
dark.text_en: Then I'll take it slow... Nnh, I'm already soaked down there... I didn't know I could get this excited...

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 坂口温柔地沉身进入，萌恵娇小的身体猛地一颤，双手紧紧抱住他的背，声音里满是率直的欢喜与羞意。
dark.text_en: Sakaguchi gently sinks his hips inside; Moe's petite frame shudders as both arms wrap tightly around his back, her voice brimming with honest joy and bashfulness.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 啊——！进、进来了……好热、好满……抱紧一点，我今天好想一直和你连在一起……
dark.text_en: Aah—! I-It's in... So hot, so full... Hold me tighter, tonight I just want to stay connected with you forever...

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 别再说我很乖啦，我现在是自己想让你用力顶我的……啊、嗯……真好，今晚我一点也不想值班……要、要去了——啊啊……！
dark.text_en: Stop calling me a good girl, right now I'm the one asking you to thrust into me hard... Ah, mmn... This feels so wonderful, I don't want to think about ward shifts at all tonight... I-I'm coming—aah...!

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 画面完全暗下，时间推移。
dark.text_en: Full fade to black as time advances.

pharmacist_manami.title: 药物不能治疗自己吓自己

consult.speaker: narrator
consult.text: 真奈美正在核对麻醉用药，翻到自己的名字时把笔停住。
consult.text_en: Checking the anesthesia medication sheet, Manami pauses her pen when she reaches her own name.

consult.speaker: patient
consult.text: 这个药单非常合理。合理到一旦我签了字、明天没有反悔余地的时候，我可能会害怕得想把药房烧了。
consult.text_en: This medication regimen is impeccably rational. So rational that once I sign my name and have zero room to back out tomorrow, I might get so scared I want to burn down the pharmacy.

consult.speaker: player
consult.text: 所以你还需要确认什么？
consult.text_en: Anything else you need to verify?

consult.speaker: patient
consult.text: ……不用了，直接签吧。我签字前把话问完，明天被推上台的时候我可能连话都说不利索。
consult.text_en: ...No, let's just sign. I'll get all my questions out before signing, because when they wheel me onto the table tomorrow I probably won't even be able to speak straight.

night.speaker: narrator
night.text: 她在床头放了张纸，最上面写“今晚禁止提药”。
night.text_en: She places a sheet of paper at the head of the bed with *"No Mentioning Medications Tonight"* written at the top.

night.speaker: patient
night.text: 这是一项完全不科学、但我很想试的干预：你留下来过夜。
night.text_en: Here's a completely unscientific intervention I'm dying to test: you staying the night.

night.speaker: player
night.text: 不需要对照组？
night.text_en: No control group needed?

night.speaker: patient
night.text: 不需要。要是你敢提第二个参与者，我现在就把你赶出去。……我是在邀请我的男朋友。
night.text_en: None. If you dare suggest a second participant, I'm kicking you out right now. ...I'm inviting my boyfriend.

night.speaker: narrator
night.text: 坂口锁门、脱下衣物。真奈美换下病服，褪下薄荷绿色的贴身内衣与内裤，把那张“禁止提药”的纸贴在床头，赤着身子兴冲冲掀开被单让他进来。
night.text_en: Sakaguchi locks the door and removes his clothes. Changing out of her hospital gown, Manami slips off her mint-green bra and panties, sticks the *"No Mentioning Medications"* note to the headboard, and gleefully lifts the sheet stark naked to let him in.

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 真奈美浑身发软地伸了个懒腰，慢慢掰起手指。
after.text_en: Stretching languidly, Manami slowly counts on her fingers.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 我忽然想到：明天全麻十几个小时，算不算把今晚消耗的体力和今年的睡眠亏空一次还清？
after.text_en: It just occurred to me: does ten-plus hours of general anesthesia tomorrow count as paying off tonight's stamina expenditure and this year's sleep debt in one lump sum?

after.speaker: player
after.text: 那不等于睡觉。
after.text_en: Anesthesia isn't sleep.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 我知道啦！我给自己开个荒唐玩笑都不行吗？
after.text_en: I know that! Can't a girl crack an absurd joke for her own sanity?

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她突然坐起来，目光投向床头已经锁定的用药与手术清单。
after.text_en: She suddenly bolts upright, her eyes landing on the locked medication and surgical schedule at the head of the bed.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 等一下，我明天真的要接受那整套麻醉、然后被你们切开十几个小时！静脉推注一推下去，我还来不及喊‘等一下我后悔了’，就要把整具身体交给你们动刀了！
after.text_en: Wait a second—tomorrow I really have to take that full anesthesia protocol and get cut open by you guys for over ten hours! Once that IV push goes in, before I can even yell 'Wait, I changed my mind,' I'll be handing my entire body over to your scalpels!

after.speaker: player
after.text: 麻醉团队会先和你核对，不过手术确实没法取消。
after.text_en: The anesthesia team will run through verification with you first, though the surgery itself definitely can't be canceled.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 嗯，我知道没得退了。……可我刚才明明还在你怀里舒服得要命，现在一想起来明天铁定要挨这一刀，就吓得手脚冰凉。
after.text_en: Yeah, I know there's no backing out. ...Still, a minute ago I was feeling heavenly in your arms, and now just remembering I'm guaranteed to take the knife tomorrow turns my hands and feet ice-cold.

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她胡乱扯过病服和薄荷绿内裤，又默默推开。
after.text_en: She grabs her hospital gown and mint-green panties at random, then silently pushes them aside.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 算了，这件先不穿，我就这么光着到明早。明早反正要按术前流程换一遍。我现在宣布本患者进入‘请不要再给我讲科学’状态。
after.text_en: Forget it, I'm leaving these off and staying naked until morning. They have to change me per pre-op protocol tomorrow morning anyway. I hereby declare this patient has entered a 'Please Stop Explaining Science to Me' state.

after.speaker: player
after.text: 症状持续多久？
after.text_en: How long does that state last?

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 直到明天醒来！……啊，听我这么一说又怕了。
after.text_en: Until I wake up tomorrow! ...Ah, hearing myself say that made me scared all over again.

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她趴回枕头上，把脸贴在他胸口。
after.text_en: Flopping back onto the pillow, she presses her cheek against his chest.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 你就把手放这儿。今天治疗我胡思乱想最有效的东西只有这个。
after.text_en: Just keep your hand right here. Tonight, this is the only effective treatment for my overactive imagination.

success.speaker: patient
success.text: 实验结论：知道麻醉怎么起效，跟躺上去没法逃跑时敢不敢接受麻醉，完全是两回事！现在醒过来想想，前天晚上我吓得手脚冰凉、连薄荷绿内裤都不肯穿，还宣布进入什么‘请不要给我讲科学’状态，实在太丢药剂师的脸了。
success.text_en: Experimental conclusion: understanding the pharmacokinetics of anesthesia and actually having the guts to be put under when you can't run away are two completely different things! Waking up now and remembering how my hands and feet went ice-cold two nights ago, refusing to put on my mint-green panties and declaring a 'Stop Explaining Science to Me' state... what an embarrassment to pharmacists everywhere.

success.speaker: player
success.text: 但那晚的‘非科学干预’效果不错吧？
success.text_en: Though that 'unscientific intervention' worked pretty well that night, didn't it?

success.speaker: patient
success.text: 何止是不错……一想起那天晚上被你直接摸到下面、顶得我什么症状都忘了的滋味，比药房里任何镇静剂都管用。结果很满意，不过不许把我麻醉前发抖的事写进报告里哦！
success.text_en: More than well... Just remembering how you touched me straight down there and drove deep inside until I forgot every symptom beat any sedative in the dispensary. I'm very satisfied with the outcome—just don't you dare write about me shaking before induction in the case report!

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 我就说前天晚上我看着床头用药清单突然手脚冰凉、总觉得一口气睡十几个小时心里没底，原来是药剂师的直觉早就报警了吧！
failure.text_en: I knew staring at the medication sheet two nights ago with ice-cold hands and feeling uneasy about being knocked out for ten-plus hours was my pharmacist's intuition sounding the alarm early!

failure.speaker: player
failure.text: 不用‘副作用可逆’来敷衍你，我会给你完整的复盘报告。
failure.text_en: I won't brush you off with 'reversible side effects'—I'll give you the full debriefing report.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 算你老实。不过在那之前，我得先分析一下临床事故的场外诱因——坂口医生，是不是因为术前夜你在我身上省略前戏测试、一晚上做得太猛，把主刀医生的血糖和体力全消耗在我的病床上了呀？
failure.text_en: At least you're honest. Before that, though, let me analyze the external contributing factors to this clinical incident—Dr. Sakaguchi, did you skip pre-clinical trials on me a little too vigorously two nights ago and go so hard all night that the lead surgeon burned through all his blood sugar and stamina in my hospital bed?

failure.speaker: narrator
failure.text: 她促狭地笑出声，随后懒洋洋地拉过他的手贴在脸颊边。
failure.text_en: She lets out a teasing laugh, then lazily pulls his hand over to press against her cheek.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 好啦，逗你的。虽然手术没完成挺让人失望的，可只要回味起前天夜里被你占有、顶到最深处什么时间都不用算的快感，我就觉得这顿刀挨得还是挺划算的。等我缓一缓，我们再一起看报告吧。
failure.text_en: Alright, I'm just ribbing you. Even though falling short is disappointing, whenever I savor the rush of being possessed by you two nights ago and losing track of time completely, taking this knife was still a great deal. Once I catch my breath, let's go over the report together.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 今晚你只准叫我的名字，不准开处方。
dark.text_en: Tonight you're only allowed to call my name—writing prescriptions is strictly prohibited.

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 亲吻后灯暗，被单下很快传来湿热的触碰声。
dark.text_en: They kiss as the lights dim, the sound of hot, damp touches soon rising beneath the covers.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 嗯……我怀疑我会很喜欢这种疗法……你的手好烫……
dark.text_en: Mmn... I suspect I'm going to love this therapy... Your hands are so hot...

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 啊……你竟然没接我的玩笑，直接去摸下面了……
dark.text_en: Ah... You didn't even banter back, your hand went straight down there...

dark.speaker: player
dark.text: 我只是想吻你，想占有你。
dark.text_en: I just want to kiss you and make you mine.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 那就来啊……我已经湿了，不用再做前戏测试了……
dark.text_en: Then come on... I'm already wet, no need for further pre-clinical trials...

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 坂口挺身进入的瞬间，真奈美发出一声甜美的鼻音，腰肢不由自主地向上迎合。
dark.text_en: The instant Sakaguchi drives inside, Manami lets out a sweet nasal moan, her hips arching involuntarily to meet him.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 啊……！唔、好深……我现在不想算时间，也不想猜明天几点……
dark.text_en: Ah...! Nnh, so deep... Right now I don't want to calculate half-lives or guess what time it is tomorrow...

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 嗯、哈啊……你这样一顶进来，我什么症状都忘了……今晚不要下结论，再用力抱紧我一点……啊、要去了——啊啊……！
dark.text_en: Mmn, haah... When you thrust in like that, I forget every single symptom... Don't draw any conclusions tonight, just hold me tighter... Ah, I'm coming—aah...!

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 画面全黑，时间推进。
dark.text_en: Full fade to black as time advances.

nurse_iwasaki_rumi.title: 主角缺席的手术派对
nurse_iwasaki_rumi.title_en: A Surgical Party Missing Its Guest of Honor

consult.speaker: narrator
consult.text: 留美看着编组表，拍掌笑出声。
consult.text_en: Reading the team roster, Rumi claps her hands and bursts out laughing.

consult.speaker: patient
consult.text: 不得了，为了给我开〈本次术式〉，全院最豪华阵容都请来了。这个待遇平时值班可抢不到！
consult.text_en: Unreal! To perform 〈本次术式〉 on me, you assembled the most deluxe all-star lineup in the hospital. You couldn't snag VIP treatment like this on a regular shift if you tried!

consult.speaker: player
consult.text: 签了字，明天的派对主角可就不准中途离场了。
consult.text_en: Once you sign, the guest of honor isn't allowed to walk out halfway through tomorrow's party.

consult.speaker: patient
consult.text: 签！……不过你等我签完再把表收走，我现在看见上面的‘预计十几个小时’就想打嗝。
consult.text_en: Signing! ...Just wait till I finish signing before you take the sheet away—staring at 'Estimated Duration: 10+ Hours' is giving me the hiccups.

night.speaker: narrator
night.text: 她拿床头的纸杯当麦克风，模仿主持人发言。
night.text_en: Using a paper cup from the nightstand as a microphone, she mimics an MC.

night.speaker: patient
night.text: 欢迎来到‘岩崎留美术前最后一个自由之夜’！唯一嘉宾：明天的主刀兼今晚的男朋友！
night.text_en: Welcome to 'Rumi Iwasaki's Final Night of Pre-Op Freedom'! Our sole special guest: tomorrow's lead surgeon and tonight's boyfriend!

night.speaker: player
night.text: 我可以不参加吗？
night.text_en: Can I decline to appear on the show?

night.speaker: patient
night.text: 不行！我今晚就想跟你在一起。……这句是真的，别当成表演。
night.text_en: No way! Tonight I want to be with you. ...And I mean that for real, don't treat it as a bit.

night.speaker: narrator
night.text: 她把纸杯丢进废纸篓，亲自拉他过去落锁。坂口脱去衣物，她把病号服和活力十足的亮橙色内衣裤随手扔到椅背上，一丝不挂地夸张一鞠躬，笑嘻嘻地钻进被单。
night.text_en: Tossing the paper cup into the bin, she pulls him over to lock the door herself. Sakaguchi removes his clothes; flinging her hospital gown and vibrant bright-orange bra and panties onto the chair back, she takes an exaggerated bow stark naked and dives grinning under the sheet.

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 留美大汗淋漓地躺在床中央，一手举起想要谢幕，眼睛忽然看向墙上的“明日手术预约（已锁定）”。
after.text_en: Lying drenched in sweat in the center of the bed, Rumi raises one hand to take a curtain call—until her eyes land on the *"Tomorrow's Surgical Booking (Locked)"* sign on the wall.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: ……啊！坏了！明天还有正片！而且不准退票！
after.text_en: ...Ah! Crap! The main feature is still tomorrow! And tickets are non-refundable!

after.speaker: player
after.text: 你不是说今晚是自由之夜？
after.text_en: Didn't you say tonight was the Night of Freedom?

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 那明天是什么？全院办十几个小时的真刀真枪大手术派对，主角被全麻关机，肚子被切开折腾一整天，醒来还要听别人讲活动回顾？！这算什么节目啊！
after.text_en: Then what's tomorrow?! The whole hospital throws a ten-plus-hour live-blade surgical party where the guest of honor gets powered down under general anesthesia, has her belly cut open and worked on all day, and wakes up to listen to everyone else recap the event?! What kind of variety show is that?!

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她光着身子抓起病服和亮橙色内裤，举得高高的，像在演讲。
after.text_en: Stark naked, she snatches up her hospital gown and bright-orange panties, holding them high overhead like a podium speech.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 既然退不了票，我宣布今晚不穿了！刚才爽了那么久，明天反正她们得替我做一整套术前准备。现在我就这么光着待到早晨，她们来了就把我往车上一放，我直接这么光着上台！爱谁谁！
after.text_en: Since tickets are non-refundable, I hereby declare I'm not getting dressed tonight! I just felt amazing for hours, and tomorrow the girls have to put me through a full pre-op prep routine anyway. I'm staying naked right here until morning—when they show up, they can load me onto the gurney and wheel me straight onto the table naked! See if I care!

after.speaker: player
after.text: 你确定要让早班护士听见这句话？
after.text_en: Are you sure you want the morning-shift nurses to hear that quote?

after.speaker: patient
after.text: ……不！你要是敢告诉她们，我就把你踢出节目组！
after.text_en: ...No! If you dare tell them, I'm firing you from the production crew!

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她笑到一半，忽然发现自己举着衣服的手在颤抖。
after.text_en: Halfway through her laugh, she notices her hand holding the clothes is trembling.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: ……可恶。我本来想把这个笑话说得特别好笑。
after.text_en: ...Darn it. I meant to deliver that joke way funnier.

after.speaker: player
after.text: 我觉得挺好笑。
after.text_en: I thought it was pretty funny.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 那你为什么还看见我在抖？我知道不会有永久损伤，知道全麻时什么都感觉不到……但一想到明早真要被推进手术室动那么大的刀，连跑都没地方跑，我大概会哭得像个傻瓜。
after.text_en: Then why are you still watching me shake? I know there's zero permanent damage, and I know I won't feel a thing under general anesthesia... but just thinking about actually being wheeled through the OR doors tomorrow morning for such a huge operation with nowhere to run, I'm probably going to bawl like an idiot.

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她把衣服丢下，一把拉住他。
after.text_en: Dropping the clothes, she grabs hold of him.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 你千万别提前给我鼓掌。等我醒来再说。
after.text_en: Don't you dare applaud me ahead of time. Save it for after I wake up.

success.speaker: patient
success.text: 虽然我没听见你们在台上有没有给我办‘惊喜派对’，但结果确实太棒啦！现在醒过来想想，前天晚上我光着身子高举内裤发表演讲、结果手抖得差点哭出来的样子，真是本主持人最大的黑历史！
success.text_en: Even though I couldn't hear whether you guys threw me a 'surprise party' on the table, the result is seriously awesome! Waking up now and remembering how I held my panties overhead naked giving a speech two nights ago—only for my hands to shake until I nearly cried—is the biggest black mark on this MC's career!

success.speaker: player
success.text: 那场‘自由之夜’的节目效果倒是满分。
success.text_en: The ratings for that 'Night of Freedom' special were through the roof, though.

success.speaker: patient
success.text: 那是当然！一想起那天晚上被你直接摸到敏感的地方、顶得我连台词都忘光的滋味，我现在浑身还热乎乎的呢。来吧，现在可以为你的女主角鼓掌并汇报战果啦！
success.text_en: You bet they were! Just remembering how you touched my sensitive spots directly that night and drove inside until I forgot all my lines still makes my whole body burn. Come on, now you can applaud your leading lady and deliver the box-office report!

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 哇，真倒霉！我就说前天晚上我看见墙上写着‘不准退票’的时候手一直在抖，原来是主持人的第六感早就知道正片要翻车啊！
failure.text_en: Whoa, talk about tough luck! I told you my hands were shaking when I saw 'Non-Refundable' on the wall two nights ago—turns out this MC's sixth sense already knew the main feature was going to flop!

failure.speaker: player
failure.text: 抱歉，留美，这次没能顺利完成。
failure.text_en: I'm sorry, Rumi. We couldn't bring it across the finish line this time.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 喂，唯一嘉宾坂口先生，我严重怀疑——是不是因为术前夜你在‘自由之夜’节目里进入正题太猛，按着我顶了那么久，结果把第二天开刀的力气全留在我的床上了呀？
failure.text_en: Hey, Sole Special Guest Mr. Sakaguchi, I have a strong suspicion—did you jump into the main event a little too hard during our 'Night of Freedom' broadcast two nights ago, pinning me down and thrusting for so long that you left all your surgical stamina in my bed?

failure.speaker: narrator
failure.text: 她哈哈笑着拍了一下坂口的胳膊，随即又收起笑闹，红着脸握住他的手。
failure.text_en: She laughs and slaps Sakaguchi's arm, before quieting down and blushing as she squeezes his hand.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 好啦，开玩笑的！虽然正片没演完有点可惜，但前天夜里在你怀里不用表演勇敢、被你抱紧疼爱得那么爽的滋味，早就值回票价啦！来，认真告诉我卡在哪儿了吧。
failure.text_en: Alright, just messing with you! Even though it's a bummer the main feature didn't finish, lying in your arms two nights ago without having to put on a brave show and getting loved so thoroughly more than paid for the ticket! Come on, tell me seriously where we hit a snag.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 嘉宾请上床，今晚没有主持台词，直接进入正题！
dark.text_en: Special guest, please take the bed—no MC script tonight, we're jumping straight to the main event!

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 她伸手吻他，病房灯暗。
dark.text_en: She reaches up to kiss him as the ward lights dim.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: ……嗯。哇，你摸起人来居然这么不客气。
dark.text_en: ...Mmn. Whoa, your hands really don't hold back when touching a girl.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 啊……别挠我痒痒，直接碰敏感的地方嘛……你真想把我笑死呀？
dark.text_en: Ah... Stop tickling me and touch the sensitive spots directly... Are you trying to make me laugh to death?

dark.speaker: player
dark.text: 我是认真的。
dark.text_en: I'm being serious.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 那我也认真一下。……我真的很喜欢你……唔、下面已经湿成这样了，快点进来吧！
dark.text_en: Then I'll be serious too. ...I really, really love you... Nnh, I'm already this wet down there, so hurry up and come inside!

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 坂口沉腰一举没入，留美原本元气满满的笑声瞬间变成了一声高亢的惊喘，双腿紧紧锁住他的腰。
dark.text_en: Sakaguchi sinks his hips and buries himself to the hilt in one stroke; Rumi's bubbly laughter instantly turns into a high-pitched gasp as her legs lock tightly around his waist.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 啊——！好、好深……！刚才那句喜欢你，我说得有点不够响亮……哈啊、嗯……！
dark.text_en: Aah—! S-So deep...! When I said I love you just now, I didn't say it loud enough... Haah, mmn...!

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 今天的我可不是来表演勇敢的……抱住我，再用力顶我……让我假装明天不存在五分钟……啊、要去了——啊啊啊……！
dark.text_en: Tonight I'm not here to put on a brave show... Hold me tight, thrust into me harder... Let me pretend tomorrow doesn't exist for five minutes... Ah, I'm coming—aaah...!

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 完全黑屏，时间经过。
dark.text_en: Full fade to black as time passes.

nurse_yoneda_shiori.title: 患者有权哭鼻子
nurse_yoneda_shiori.title_en: A Patient Has the Right to Sniffle

consult.speaker: narrator
consult.text: 栞把准备表逐行问清楚，手指却一直绞着衣角，最后小声问出一个问题。
consult.text_en: Shiori asks through the prep sheet line by line, her fingers twisting the hem of her uniform until she whispers one last question.

consult.speaker: patient
consult.text: 坂口医生……我知道一旦签了字，明天手术就绝对不能取消了。那、那如果我明早在推床上吓得说不出话、甚至想往后缩，你们会不会生我的气，觉得‘你不是早就签字同意了吗’？
consult.text_en: Dr. Sakaguchi... I know that once I sign my name, tomorrow's surgery can never be canceled. B-But if I get so scared on the gurney tomorrow morning that I can't speak, or even try to shrink back, will everyone get mad at me and think, 'Didn't you already sign the consent form'?

consult.speaker: player
consult.text: 手术不会取消，但没有人会生你的气。大家都会握着你的手等你缓过来。
consult.text_en: The surgery won't be canceled, but nobody will get mad at you. Everyone will hold your hand and wait until you catch your breath.

consult.speaker: patient
consult.text: ……好。只要不会嫌我烦就好。那我签字了。
consult.text_en: ...Okay. As long as you won't think I'm a nuisance. I'll sign now.

night.speaker: narrator
night.text: 栞已经把一条毛巾卷成圆柱，不停在手里揉。
night.text_en: Shiori has rolled a hand towel into a cylinder, kneading it endlessly in her hands.

night.speaker: patient
night.text: 我刚才练习了十五次‘我不怕’。结果一句也没练成功。
night.text_en: I just practiced saying 'I'm not scared' fifteen times. And didn't succeed once.

night.speaker: player
night.text: 今晚不用练。
night.text_en: No need to practice tonight.

night.speaker: patient
night.text: 那我想请你陪我。想亲吻你，想过一个会让我忘记医院的晚上。
night.text_en: Then I'd like to ask you to stay with me. I want to kiss you, and spend a night that makes me forget all about the hospital.

night.speaker: narrator
night.text: 她抬头，等待坂口肯定的回应。他反锁门，换下全部衣物；栞红着脸脱下病服，褪下带着白色蕾丝花边的纯棉内衣裤，把毛巾放远，羞怯地遮着身体坐进被单里，认真拍了拍身边的位置。
night.text_en: She looks up, waiting for Sakaguchi's nod. He locks the door and removes all his clothes; blushing deeply, Shiori unbuttons her hospital gown, slips off her white lace-trimmed cotton bra and panties, sets the towel aside, and sits under the sheet shielding her body shyly as she earnestly pats the space beside her.

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 栞脸颊通红地喘着气，忽然从枕头里抬头。
after.text_en: Panting with crimson cheeks, Shiori suddenly lifts her head from the pillow.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 等等。刚才太舒服了，我好像差点以为自己是在和你度蜜月的普通旅馆。
after.text_en: Wait a second. That felt so good just now, I almost thought we were at an ordinary inn on our honeymoon.

after.speaker: player
after.text: 这里是特别病房。
after.text_en: This is the Special Ward.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 所以明早她们真的要来接我，做那份长得要命的准备单……然后把我推到手术台上，全麻十几个小时，真刀真枪地切开做那么大的手术……
after.text_en: Which means tomorrow morning they're really coming to pick me up, run through that impossibly long prep sheet... and wheel me onto the operating table for over ten hours of general anesthesia, cutting me open for real for a huge operation...

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她的呼吸一下子急促起来，光着身子往被窝深处缩成小小的一团，眼眶迅速红了一圈。
after.text_en: Her breathing quickens instantly;stark naked, she curls into a tiny ball deep under the covers, the rims of her eyes turning bright red.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 坂口医生……怎么办，我白天明明觉得自己能撑住的，可现在一想到明天真的要被切开流血、里面还要被动刀，我就怕得肚子发凉……我、我现在说想取消肯定来不及了，对不对？
after.text_en: Dr. Sakaguchi... What do I do? During the day I thought I could handle it, but now when I think about actually being cut open and bleeding tomorrow, having my insides operated on, my stomach goes ice-cold with fear... I-If I say I want to cancel right now, it's definitely too late, isn't it?

after.speaker: player
after.text: 来不及了，栞。同意书已经锁进档案柜，明早八点谁也没法把手术叫停。
after.text_en: Too late, Shiori. The consent form is locked in the filing cabinet—at eight tomorrow morning, nobody can call off the surgery.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 呜……我一猜就是这样……我今天下午还逞强说‘我可以承受’，现在却只想把你锁在房间里，不让明早的护士开门进来抓我……
after.text_en: Uu... I knew you'd say that... This afternoon I acted tough and said 'I can take it,' and now all I want is to lock you inside this room so tomorrow morning's nurses can't open the door and take me...

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她瞥见地上放着的患者服和蕾丝边内裤，赌气似的把被单蒙到眼睛上。
after.text_en: Spotting her patient gown and lace-trimmed panties on the floor, she pulls the sheet over her eyes in a sulk.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 既然绝对逃不掉了……那我今晚就不把内裤和病号服穿回去了！穿上之后，我就得像个认命的乖患者一样躺好等她们来推。至少在天亮被她们按上推床之前，我有权光着躲在你怀里哭鼻子，对吧？
after.text_en: Since there's zero chance of escaping... I'm not putting my panties or hospital gown back on tonight! Once I put them on, I'll have to lie there like a resigned, obedient patient waiting to be wheeled away. At least until sunrise when they hold me down on the gurney, I have the right to hide naked in your arms and sniffle, don't I?

after.speaker: player
after.text: 有。想哭多久都可以。
after.text_en: You do. You can cry as long as you like.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 那好，我宣布撤销‘米田栞今晚不许哭’这条规定。
after.text_en: Alright then, I hereby revoke the rule stating 'Shiori Yoneda is not allowed to cry tonight.'

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 话刚说完，她已经在被单底下小声哭了出来；被坂口隔着被子抱紧后，片刻又破涕为笑。
after.text_en: Before she even finishes the sentence, she is already sniffling under the sheet; held tightly by Sakaguchi through the duvet, she laughs through her tears a moment later.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: ……太晚了，规定根本没有执行成功。
after.text_en: ...Too late. That rule failed to execute from the very start.

success.speaker: patient
success.text: 进手术室大门的时候我真的吓得抓紧了栏杆，姐姐们等我哭完两声才把我推进去。现在平安醒过来，一想起前天晚上我把你当成蜜月旅馆、后来又光着身子蒙着被单哭鼻子想把你锁在房间里的样子，真是太难为情了……
success.text_en: At the OR doors I really got so scared I grabbed the side rails, and the older nurses waited until I finished crying a little before wheeling me inside. Now that I'm safely awake, remembering how I mistook this ward for a honeymoon inn two nights ago, then hid naked under the sheet sniffling and wanting to lock you in the room... it's so embarrassing...

success.speaker: player
success.text: 但我记得那天晚上有人主动让我进去的时候，表现得非常勇敢。
success.text_en: Though I recall someone being remarkably brave when she invited me inside her that night.

success.speaker: patient
success.text: 呀……坂口医生不许再提那句了！不过，只要回想起那天夜里你一边叫着‘栞’一边深深抱住我的温度，我就觉得有一点骄傲。谢谢你一直陪着我。
success.text_en: Kya... Dr. Sakaguchi, no bringing that line up! Still, whenever I remember how warm it felt having you call me 'Shiori' while holding me so deep two nights ago, I actually feel a little proud of myself. Thank you for staying with me.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 呜……我就知道前天晚上我怕得肚子发凉、哭着想把手术取消掉，是因为心里早就觉得这次不太对劲……
