failure.text_en: Uu... I knew my stomach going ice-cold two nights ago and crying to cancel the surgery was because my heart already sensed things wouldn't go quite right this time...

failure.speaker: player
failure.text: 我知道你很难受，这次没能完成目标，我来给你解释清楚。
failure.text_en: I know it's hard on you. We couldn't complete the target this time—let me explain everything clearly.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 嗯……那个，坂口医生，你别生我的气哦……是不是因为前天晚上我拉着你在假想的‘蜜月旅馆’里做了那么久，害你把力气都用在我身上了，第二天开刀才没撑住的呀……？
failure.text_en: Okay... Um, Dr. Sakaguchi, please don't be mad at me for asking... Could it be because I kept you in our imaginary 'honeymoon inn' for so long two nights ago that you used up all your strength on me, and couldn't hold out at the operating table the next day...?

failure.speaker: narrator
failure.text: 她红着眼眶却又羞怯地小声拿他打趣，随后乖巧地伸出双手握住他的手掌。
failure.text_en: With red-rimmed eyes, she shyly cracks a tiny joke before obediently reaching out both hands to clasp his palm.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 我只是想逗你笑一下……其实就算手术没做成，只要想起前天晚上被你摸着那里、热乎乎地填满全身的滋味，我就觉得这顿刀挨得一点都不委屈。等我不再发抖了，我们再一起看记录好不好？
failure.text_en: I just wanted to make you smile... Truth is, even if the surgery didn't finish, whenever I remember you touching me there two nights ago and filling me up so warmly, I don't feel wronged taking this knife at all. Once I stop shaking, can we read the chart together?

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 我没在开玩笑哦。……现在过来吧。
dark.text_en: I'm not joking, okay? ...Come here now.

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 她主动吻他，灯暗。
dark.text_en: She kisses him first as the lights dim.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 嗯……终于不用练习什么标准说法了。
dark.text_en: Mmn... Finally I don't have to practice any standard lines.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 啊……你别突然一边叫我栞，一边摸那里……我会不好意思。
dark.text_en: Ah... Don't suddenly call me Shiori while touching me there... You'll make me bashful.

dark.speaker: player
dark.text: 那我应该叫什么？
dark.text_en: What should I call you, then?

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: ……还是叫栞吧。我喜欢你这样叫……唔、下面已经湿了……今天我是自己想让你进来的。
dark.text_en: ...Keep calling me Shiori. I love it when you call me that... Nnh, I'm already wet down there... Tonight I'm the one who wants you to come inside.

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 坂口轻柔而坚定地进入她的身体，栞发出一声软糯的惊呼，眼角泛起泪花，双手紧紧攀住他的肩膀。
dark.text_en: Sakaguchi enters her gently yet firmly; Shiori lets out a soft cry, tears glistening at the corners of her eyes as both hands cling tightly to his shoulders.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 呀……！嗯、哈啊……好深、好热……抱紧一点……我现在好高兴……
dark.text_en: Kya...! Nnh, haah... So deep, so hot... Hold me tighter... I'm so happy right now...

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 今晚我不会再说‘我不怕’……我只想让你一直这么顶着我……啊、嗯……要、要去了！你别马上去开灯……呜啊啊……！
dark.text_en: Tonight I won't say 'I'm not scared' anymore... I just want you to keep pressing inside me like this... Ah, mmn... I-I'm coming! Don't turn the light on right away... uwaah...!

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 真正黑屏，时间推移。
dark.text_en: Full fade to black as time advances.

nurse_sonoda_itsumi.title: 请进，患者还没准备好
nurse_sonoda_itsumi.title_en: Come In, the Patient Is Not Ready Yet

consult.speaker: narrator
consult.text: 愛実举起腕带看了一眼，忽然笑起来。
consult.text_en: Holding up her wristband for a look, Itsumi suddenly laughs.

consult.speaker: patient
consult.text: 我的名字印得真清楚。平时我给签完字的患者系这个的时候，还会笑着哄她们‘已经不能反悔啦，加油哦’。今天系在我自己手上，居然第一时间想把它藏进袖子里。
consult.text_en: My name is printed so clearly. Normally when I fasten these onto patients who've signed the form, I smile and coax them with 'No backing out now, hang in there!' Now that it's fastened around my own wrist, my first instinct is to hide it up my sleeve.

consult.speaker: player
consult.text: 现在后悔还来得及。
consult.text_en: Still time to change your mind before signing.

consult.speaker: patient
consult.text: 不后悔！……但我希望你记得，我签字答应的是手术，不是答应明天被推上去的时候还能笑得出来。
consult.text_en: Not changing it! ...Just remember, I'm signing to agree to the surgery—not promising I'll still be able to smile when they wheel me onto the table tomorrow.

night.speaker: narrator
night.text: 她在门口迎坂口，笑得像打算给他准备一件意外的礼物。
night.text_en: She greets Sakaguchi at the door, beaming as if she has a surprise gift waiting for him.

night.speaker: patient
night.text: 今晚不准查房。你只有一项工作——做我的男朋友，陪我过夜。
night.text_en: No rounds allowed tonight. You have one job only—being my boyfriend and staying the night with me.

night.speaker: player
night.text: 今天的患者口气很坚决。
night.text_en: Today's patient sounds mighty resolute.

night.speaker: patient
night.text: 因为是我自己想要的呀。……进去吧。
night.text_en: Because it's what I want for myself! ...Come on in.

night.speaker: narrator
night.text: 他反锁门，脱去衣物。愛実把病服与樱花粉色的成套内衣裤脱下来放到椅上，把被单拉好，先赤着身子轻轻亲了一下他的脸，才带着羞意钻到床上。
night.text_en: He locks the door and removes his clothes. Taking off her hospital gown and cherry-blossom pink matching bra and panties, Itsumi sets them on the chair, straightens the sheet, and plants a light kiss on his cheek stark naked before slipping shyly into bed.

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 愛実余韵未散地舒服翻过身，面朝病房门突然练习似地说。
after.text_en: Rolling over languidly in the afterglow, Itsumi faces the ward door and suddenly practices a line out loud:

after.speaker: patient
after.text: ‘请进，患者已经准备好了。’……啊！我怎么说出这句！
after.text_en: 'Come in, the patient is ready.' ...Ah! Why did I say that?!

after.speaker: player
after.text: 你明早还会说吗？
after.text_en: Will you still say that tomorrow morning?

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 绝对不会！刚才在你怀里太舒服，我居然忘了自己明天要做〈本次术式〉！那可是十几个小时真刀真枪的大手术啊，要把皮肤和肌肉切开、流血、切除、再一层层缝起来！
after.text_en: Definitely not! It felt so good in your arms just now that I completely forgot I'm having 〈本次术式〉 tomorrow! That's over ten hours of real-blade major surgery where my skin and muscles get cut open, bleed, get resected, and get sutured back up layer by layer!

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她猛地坐起身，抓着坂口的手臂摇晃，声音里带着半真半假的哀求。
after.text_en: She bolts upright and grabs Sakaguchi's arm, shaking it with a half-joking, half-earnest plea.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 隆司……我们真的不能跟排班室说一声，就说愛実突然不舒服，把明天的手术取消掉吗？明明我身上没有任何毛病，知道术后会完全复原，为什么偏偏要去挨这一刀不可呀？！
after.text_en: Takashi... Can't we really call the scheduling office and tell them Itsumi suddenly feels unwell, so we're canceling tomorrow's operation? There's nothing wrong with my body, and we know I'll heal completely afterward, so why do I have to go take this knife?!

after.speaker: player
after.text: 因为你自己签了字。星见的规矩你比谁都熟，一旦排进明早的手术表，就算患者在床上打滚也得按时推进去。
after.text_en: Because you signed the form yourself. You know Hoshimi's rules better than anyone—once you're on tomorrow morning's OR board, even if the patient rolls around on the mattress, she gets wheeled in on time.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 呜……我以前怎么觉得这条医院规矩很合理呢！现在轮到自己被绑在案板上，简直太不讲人情了！
after.text_en: Uu... How did I ever think that hospital rule was reasonable?! Now that I'm the one strapped to the chopping block, it's completely inhumane!

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她看了一眼椅背上的樱花粉色内衣和病服，干脆光着身子缩回被窝，眼角泛起水光。
after.text_en: Glancing at her cherry-blossom pink underwear and hospital gown on the chair back, she shrinks back under the covers stark naked, moisture glistening at the corners of her eyes.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 既然怎么求你都没法取消……那我今晚一点也不想把内裤和病服穿回去了！反正明早又得被她们剥光了做准备。明早她们要是推门进来问我‘准备好了吗’，我肯定会哭着喊‘完全没准备好’的！到时候你可不准笑话我！
after.text_en: Since begging won't get it canceled... I don't want to put my panties or hospital gown back on tonight at all! They're going to strip me bare for prep tomorrow morning anyway. If they push the door open tomorrow morning and ask 'Are you ready?', I'm definitely going to bawl and yell 'Not ready at all!' And you're not allowed to laugh at me!

success.speaker: patient
success.text: 我醒来以后，第一句话差点还是‘请进’！现在手术做好了，一想起前天晚上我摇着你的胳膊求你去排班室谎报我不舒服、还光着身子骂医院规矩不讲人情的样子，真是羞得没脸回护士站了！
success.text_en: When I woke up, my first words were still almost 'Come in'! Now that the surgery is over, remembering how I shook your arm two nights ago begging you to fake a sick call to the scheduling office, and lay naked cursing the hospital rules as inhumane... I'm too mortified to go back to the nurses' station!

success.speaker: player
success.text: 毕竟那晚有人在床上说‘还要再陪我一起去一次’的时候，可一点都没说不舒服。
success.text_en: Well, when someone was in bed begging me to 'come with her one more time' that night, she certainly didn't sound unwell.

success.speaker: patient
success.text: 隆司！不许学我那时候的话！……不过，回味起那天夜里被你揉着胸口、深深顶到最里面的幸福感，我就觉得挨这十几个小时的刀完全值得啦。谢谢你照顾了我一整天！
success.text_en: Takashi! Stop quoting what I said back then! ...Still, savoring the bliss of having you knead my chest and press all the way to my deepest spot that night makes taking the knife for ten-plus hours completely worth it. Thank you for taking care of me all day!

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 你看吧！前天晚上我怎么都不想穿回樱花粉内裤、哭着求你去排班室取消手术的时候，就觉得这台手术没那么容易过关！
failure.text_en: See?! Two nights ago when I refused to put my cherry-blossom pink panties back on and cried for you to cancel the surgery with the scheduling office, I knew this operation wouldn't be a walk in the park!

failure.speaker: player
failure.text: 抱歉，愛実，这次确实没能达成目标。
failure.text_en: I'm sorry, Itsumi. We really couldn't reach the target this time.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 我本来想讲个笑话让大家轻松一下……比如问问我们的坂口主刀，是不是因为术前夜在床上按着我‘亲得太久、做得太深’，还陪我去了好几次，结果把第二天开刀的力气全透支在我身上了呀？
failure.text_en: I wanted to crack a joke to lighten the mood... like asking our Lead Surgeon Sakaguchi whether holding me down in bed two nights ago 'kissing too long and going too deep'—and coming with me so many times—overdrew all his strength for the operating table the next day?

failure.speaker: narrator
failure.text: 她扑哧一笑，眼圈虽然还有点红，却主动伸手把坂口的手掌拉进被窝里贴着。
failure.text_en: She bursts into a giggle; though her eyes are still slightly red, she reaches out to pull Sakaguchi's palm under the covers against her skin.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 好啦，不拿你开涮了。虽然手术没做成有点小难过，但只要想起前天晚上在你身下舒服得把台词全忘了的滋味，我就觉得这顿刀挨得一点都不亏。来，把结果原原本本告诉我吧。
failure.text_en: Alright, I'll stop teasing you. Even though falling short is a little sad, whenever I remember feeling so good beneath you two nights ago that I forgot all my lines, taking this knife wasn't a loss at all. Come on, tell me the whole story.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 现在可以亲得久一点、做得深一点了。……医生请上床。
dark.text_en: Now we can kiss longer and go deeper. ...Doctor, please get in bed.

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 灯光暗下，只有两人交缠的剪影与渐渐急促的喘息。
dark.text_en: The lights dim, leaving only their entwined silhouettes and quickening breaths.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 嗯……别笑，我本来想说一句很漂亮的台词……唔、手别突然揉胸口呀……
dark.text_en: Mmn... Don't laugh, I had a really pretty line prepared... Nnh, don't suddenly knead my chest like that...

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 啊……被你摸得全忘了。
dark.text_en: Ah... Your touch made me forget the whole line.

dark.speaker: player
dark.text: 那就不用说。
dark.text_en: Then you don't need to say it.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 不行，我至少得说一句：我喜欢你……而且下面已经为你准备好了。
dark.text_en: No way, I at least have to say this much: I love you... and I'm already wet and ready for you down there.

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 坂口沉身进入那片湿润之中，愛実发出甜美的娇吟，主动抬起双腿环住他的腰。
dark.text_en: Sakaguchi sinks his hips into her wet warmth; Itsumi lets out a sweet moan, actively lifting her legs to wrap around his waist.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 啊——！好满……再亲一下，好不好？……嗯、你这样深深地顶着我，我突然觉得今晚好长、好幸福……
dark.text_en: Aah—! So full... Kiss me again, okay? ...Mmn, when you press this deep inside me, tonight suddenly feels so long and blissful...

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 明天的事先放着嘛……再用力一点，再陪我一起去一次……啊、嗯……要、要去了——啊啊……！
dark.text_en: Let's leave tomorrow for tomorrow... Thrust a little harder, come with me one more time... Ah, nnh... I-I'm coming—aah...!

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 画面彻底黑，时间过去。
dark.text_en: Full fade to black as time passes.

consult.speaker: narrator
consult.text: 狩谷先核对了病假与补偿约定，然后就盯着计划书上那行预计手术时间与“签字后不可撤销”的条款不动。
consult.text_en: Kariya verifies the sick-leave and compensation terms first, then stares motionless at the estimated surgical duration and the *"Irrevocable Upon Signing"* clause on the plan.

consult.speaker: patient
consult.text: 所有条件都清楚。……只有一个问题，为什么一想到签完字就没法毁约，这十几个小时看上去就像十几年？
consult.text_en: All terms are clear. ...Just one question: why does knowing I can't breach the contract once I sign make these ten-plus hours look like ten-plus years?

consult.speaker: player
consult.text: 害怕很正常。落笔前还可以算清楚。
consult.text_en: Being scared is normal. You can still run the numbers before putting pen to paper.

consult.speaker: patient
consult.text: 不用算了，我已经做过决定。赶紧让我签字吧，否则再多看两眼，我可能真的会打退堂鼓。
consult.text_en: No need to run them again, I've made my decision. Let me sign right now, or if I stare at it two seconds longer, I might actually get cold feet.

night.speaker: narrator
night.text: 她把账本合上，居然塞进了病房抽屉最深处。
night.text_en: Closing her ledger, she actually shoves it into the deepest corner of the ward drawer.

night.speaker: patient
night.text: 先说清楚。今晚我想你留下来，不是合同的一部分，也跟明天的补偿没有任何关系。
night.text_en: Let's get one thing straight first. Wanting you to stay tonight isn't part of the contract, and has zero connection to tomorrow's compensation.

night.speaker: player
night.text: 是你的邀请。
night.text_en: It's your personal invitation.

night.speaker: patient
night.text: 是我喜欢你。……你要我把这句写在纸上确认吗？
night.text_en: It's because I love you. ...Do you need me to put that in writing to confirm?

night.speaker: narrator
night.text: 坂口反锁房门，脱去衣物。狩谷换下病服，解开实用的深蓝色胸罩与内裤扔到床边，先试着赤身摆出一副理直气壮的样子，最终自己羞得笑场，拉起被单向他招手。
night.text_en: Sakaguchi locks the door and removes his clothes. Changing out of her hospital gown, Kariya unfastens her practical navy-blue bra and panties and tosses them beside the bed; she tries to strike a bold pose stark naked first, only to burst out laughing in embarrassment and pull up the sheet while waving him over.

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 狩谷浑身酥软地喘着气，伸手去够抽屉，摸到账本，却忽然不敢翻开。
after.text_en: Panting and limp, Kariya reaches for the drawer, touches her ledger, and suddenly hesitates to open it.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 我发现我做了一笔这辈子最离谱的亏本交易。
after.text_en: I just realized I signed the most absurd money-losing deal of my life.

after.speaker: player
after.text: 又在算钱？
after.text_en: Counting money again?

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 不是钱！我把明天十几个小时交给你们，自己全麻睡过去，任由你们在台上真刀真枪地切开、流血、切除、再缝合！按理说知道术后能完全恢复、什么也不用干，多轻松！可我现在脑子一清醒，一想到明早就要被推上去动那么大的刀，心都快从嗓子眼跳出来了！
after.text_en: Not money! Tomorrow I'm handing over ten-plus hours to you guys while I sleep under general anesthesia, letting you cut me open for real on the table, bleed, resect, and suture me back up! On paper, knowing I'll heal completely afterward without lifting a finger sounds like easy street! Yet now that my head is clear, just thinking about being wheeled in tomorrow morning for such a huge knife has my heart jumping out of my throat!

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她把账本重新推回去，光着身子坐在被单里抓紧了坂口的手腕。
after.text_en: Shoving the ledger back inside, she sits naked under the sheet and clutches Sakaguchi's wrist.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 坂口医生……那个，如果我现在说我不要补贴了、连违约金我都认赔，能不能把明天的手术取消掉……？
after.text_en: Dr. Sakaguchi... um, what if I say right now that I waive the stipend—and I'll even pay the penalty fee out of pocket—can we cancel tomorrow's surgery...?

after.speaker: player
after.text: 星见的手术同意书没有违约金退订这一条。字签了，明天的手术台你就必须躺上去。
after.text_en: Hoshimi's surgical consent form doesn't have a penalty-fee cancellation clause. Once signed, you have to get on that operating table tomorrow.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: ……我就知道！黑心医院！连花钱消灾都不行！明早她们要把我推上台，麻醉一打我就没法再插嘴了，亏死了！
after.text_en: ...I knew it! What a loan-shark hospital! You won't even let me buy my way out! Tomorrow morning the nurses will wheel me onto the table, and once the anesthesia hits I won't even be able to get a word in—what a rip-off!

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她盯着床边的深蓝色内裤和病服，气鼓鼓地往被窝里一躺。
after.text_en: Glaring at her navy-blue panties and hospital gown beside the bed, she flops back under the covers in a huff.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 既然退不掉，那我今晚就不穿衣服了！刚才出了那么多汗，反正明早得换衣准备，省一次穿内裤的力气也算赚回来一点！让她们明早看见患者本人已经宣布罢工！
after.text_en: Since I can't cancel, I'm not getting dressed tonight! I sweated buckets just now, and they have to change and prep me tomorrow morning anyway—saving the effort of putting my panties back on counts as recouping a little labor cost! Let them see tomorrow morning that the patient herself has gone on strike!

after.speaker: player
after.text: 这不会减少明早的任何医疗步骤。
after.text_en: That won't reduce a single medical prep step tomorrow morning.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 你连我这点自我安慰都要扣成本吗？！
after.text_en: Are you really going to deduct overhead from my tiny bit of self-consolation?!

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她带着怒气笑，笑完慢慢靠到坂口身旁，声音低了下来。
after.text_en: She laughs indignantly, before slowly leaning against Sakaguchi's side, her voice dropping.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 明明知道不会留下永久伤害，可一想到逃不掉了，我还是怕得手心冒汗。……这种心情，真的一点价格也标不出来。
after.text_en: Even knowing it won't leave permanent damage, realizing there's no way out still makes my palms sweat with fear. ...You really can't put a price tag on a feeling like this.

success.speaker: patient
success.text: 合同上写的东西都兑现了。现在平安醒过来一算账，前天晚上我居然吓得想认赔违约金取消手术、还光着身子骂医院黑心，简直把精明人设全丢光了！
success.text_en: Everything written in the contract was honored. Waking up safely now and auditing the books, remembering how I got so scared two nights ago that I offered to pay a penalty fee to cancel the surgery—and lay naked calling the hospital a loan shark—completely bankrupted my shrewd image!

success.speaker: player
success.text: 那这笔交易最终算赚了还是亏了？
success.text_en: So did this transaction end up in the black or in the red?

success.speaker: patient
success.text: 大赚特赚好不好！光是一想起术前夜在床上被你蹭着下面问‘值不值’、然后被你顶得连声音都忍住的滋味，那份快感就千金不换了。先让我靠着你回味一会儿，明天再算账。
success.text_en: A massive windfall, obviously! Just remembering how you rubbed me down there in bed on the pre-op night asking 'Is it worth it?' and drove inside until I couldn't hold my voice back—that pleasure alone was priceless. Let me lean on you and savor the return on investment for a minute, we'll settle the ledger tomorrow.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 我就说前天晚上我摸着账本直犯怵、总觉得这是一笔离谱的亏本交易，果然我的商业直觉一点都没错，手术还真没做成！
failure.text_en: I told you touching my ledger two nights ago and feeling like this was an absurdly bad deal was my business intuition talking—sure enough, the surgery really didn't finish!

failure.speaker: player
failure.text: 保障和事先说好的安排照旧，手术未达目标由医疗团队负责。
failure.text_en: All guarantees and prior arrangements stand as agreed. Falling short of the surgical target is the medical team's responsibility.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 那当然得照旧！不过坂口医生，咱们来算算内部账——你是不是前天晚上听说‘没有打卡记录想做多久都行’，就在我身上透支了太多体力，导致第二天站在手术台上技术缩水了呀？
failure.text_en: Of course they stand! Still, Dr. Sakaguchi, let's audit our internal books—when you heard 'there's no timecard tonight, do it as long as you want' two nights ago, did you overdraw so much stamina inside me that your surgical precision took a haircut at the table the next day?

failure.speaker: narrator
failure.text: 她精明地挑起眉头揶揄了一句，见坂口无奈，自己却先脸红着笑出声，伸手勾住他的手指。
failure.text_en: Raising an eyebrow with a shrewd tease, she sees Sakaguchi's wry look and blushes, bursting into laughter as she hooks her finger around his.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 算啦，不扣你的绩效了。虽然手术没完成挺让人失望的，但回味起前天晚上被你弄得那么舒服、连一分钱都不想算的滋味……这顿刀我挨得还是挺值的。把报告拿来吧。
failure.text_en: Alright, I won't dock your performance bonus. Even though falling short is disappointing, whenever I savor how good you made me feel two nights ago until I didn't care about counting a single yen... taking this knife was still well worth it. Hand over the report.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 现在我不报价，你也不许讨价还价。过来。
dark.text_en: Tonight I'm not quoting prices, and you're not allowed to haggle. Get over here.

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 她主动吻他，灯暗。
dark.text_en: She kisses him first as the lights dim.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 嗯……这次我是真的一分钱也不想算……唔、你的手往哪儿摸呢……
dark.text_en: Mmn... Tonight I genuinely don't want to count a single yen... Nnh, where do you think your hand is wandering...

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 啊……你怎么还故意一边蹭下面一边问我值不值？
dark.text_en: Ah... How dare you rub me down there while asking if it's worth the price?!

dark.speaker: player
dark.text: 值吗？
dark.text_en: Is it worth it?

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: ……值。十分值！好了别问了，快点进来！
dark.text_en: ...Worth it. Tenout-of-ten worth it! Alright, stop asking and hurry up and come inside!

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 坂口一举深入到底，狩谷倒吸一口气，原本精明干练的语调瞬间被撞碎成了急促的喘息。
dark.text_en: Sakaguchi drives all the way to the hilt in one stroke; Kariya sucks in a sharp breath, her shrewd, brisk tone shattering instantly into breathless gasps.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 啊——！哈啊、好深……！再亲一次，我还不想睡……今晚没有打卡记录，你想做多久都行……
dark.text_en: Aah—! Haah, so deep...! Kiss me again, I don't want to sleep yet... There's no timecard tonight, you can do it as long as you want...

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 我居然被你弄得这么舒服……太不划算了，连声音都忍不、住了……啊、嗯……反正我喜欢你……要、要去了——啊啊……！
dark.text_en: To think you're making me feel this good... What a terrible bargain, I can't even hold my voice back... Ah, mmn... I love you anyway... I-I'm coming—aah...!

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 彻底黑屏，时间推移。
dark.text_en: Full fade to black as time advances.

nurse_hikami_saeko.title: 我本人不在现场
nurse_hikami_saeko.title_en: The Subject Was Absent from the Scene

consult.speaker: narrator
consult.text: 冴子看完所有核对项目，不动声色地合上笔。
consult.text_en: After reviewing every verification item, Saeko caps her pen without a change in expression.

consult.speaker: patient
consult.text: 我原本以为自己很擅长观察别人面对手术的表情。今天当我自己签下字、断掉所有退路的时候才知道，自己的表情原来最难管理。
consult.text_en: I used to think I was quite skilled at observing people's expressions when facing surgery. Only today, upon signing my own name and cutting off every avenue of retreat, did I learn that one's own expression is the hardest to manage.

consult.speaker: player
consult.text: 需要时间吗？
consult.text_en: Do you need more time?

consult.speaker: patient
consult.text: 不需要。……或者说，需要，但我不打算靠拖延解决。这台手术我签。
consult.text_en: No. ...Or rather, I do, but I have no intention of solving it through delay. I'm signing for this operation.

night.speaker: narrator
night.text: 冴子背对病房门，看向窗外，听见坂口进来才慢慢转身。
night.text_en: Standing with her back to the ward door looking out the window, Saeko turns around slowly when she hears Sakaguchi enter.

night.speaker: patient
night.text: 很奇妙。明天是我的手术，今晚我却只想让你不要问任何问题。
night.text_en: How curious. Tomorrow is my operation, yet tonight all I want is for you to ask no questions at all.

night.speaker: player
night.text: 一个问题都不能问？
night.text_en: Not a single question?

night.speaker: patient
night.text: 只许问‘我想不想吻你’。……答案是想。留下好吗？
night.text_en: You may only ask 'Do I want to kiss you?' ...And the answer is yes. Will you stay?

night.speaker: narrator
night.text: 她轻轻点了点头，看他反锁房门，脱去衣物。冴子慢条斯理地解开病服，褪下冷艳的银灰色缎面胸罩与内裤，把衣物整齐放好，自己赤着身躯主动坐到床上，抬手请他靠近。
night.text_en: Giving a slight nod, she watches him lock the door and remove his clothes. Unhurriedly unbuttoning her hospital gown, Saeko slips off her cool silver-grey satin bra and panties, places her clothes neatly aside, and sits naked on the bed, raising a hand to invite him closer.

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 冴子胸口微微起伏着，睁着湿润的眼睛看窗帘，过了很久突然轻笑。
after.text_en: Her chest rising and falling softly, Saeko stares at the curtain with damp eyes before letting out a quiet laugh after a long silence.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 我想好了明天的患者证言。
after.text_en: I've composed tomorrow's patient testimony.

after.speaker: player
after.text: 证言？
after.text_en: Testimony?

after.speaker: patient
after.text: ‘本人在签下不可撤销的同意书后，于次日清晨在手术室看到一排熟人。麻醉后失去意识。十几个小时内，关于自己身体被切开、切除与缝合的任何事，全由他人转述。’
after.text_en: 'After signing an irrevocable consent form, the subject observed a row of familiar faces in the operating room the following morning. Consciousness was lost following anesthesia induction. For over ten hours, every detail regarding the incision, resection, and suturing of her own body was relayed solely through third-party accounts.'

after.speaker: player
after.text: 你会有完整记录。
after.text_en: You'll receive the complete operative record.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 当然。我不是怀疑记录。
after.text_en: Of course. It isn't the record I doubt.

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她掀开被单，目光落在床边那套银灰色内衣与病服上。
after.text_en: Lifting the sheet, her gaze falls upon the silver-grey lingerie and hospital gown beside the bed.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 只是……刚才在你身下的时候，我可以选择是否让你看见自己失态的样子。明天我戴上患者帽，接受准备、全麻，连中途喊停退出的权利都没有，更无法知道自己究竟有多狼狈。
after.text_en: It's just... beneath you a moment ago, I could choose whether to let you see me lose my composure. Tomorrow I put on a patient cap, undergo prep and general anesthesia without even the right to call a halt and walk away, and cannot even know how disheveled I look.

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她突然十分一本正经地把被单往光裸的肩上拉了拉。
after.text_en: With complete deadpan seriousness, she pulls the sheet up over her bare shoulders.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 要不今晚就不再穿内衣和病服了。既然明天早班接手准备，我从现在起正式宣布自己退出形象管理。
after.text_en: Perhaps I shall refrain from putting my underwear and patient gown back on tonight. Since the morning shift takes over prep tomorrow, I hereby officially announce my withdrawal from image management effective immediately.

after.speaker: player
after.text: 这是你最新的证言？
after.text_en: Is that your latest testimony?

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 不是。……这是我在这里跟你讲的一句傻话。
after.text_en: No. ...That's just a foolish remark spoken to you alone.

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她第一次几乎无处躲藏地抬眼看他。
after.text_en: For the first time, she looks up at him with nowhere left to hide.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 我知道没有不可逆的风险。可一想到明早没有退路，我还是怕。……如果明早我说‘能不能慢一点’，你别急着问原因。
after.text_en: I know there is zero irreversible risk. Yet knowing there is no retreat tomorrow morning still frightens me. ...If I ask 'Could we go a little slower?' tomorrow morning, don't press me for a reason right away.

success.speaker: patient
success.text: 我原本准备了很多可以说的话，醒来以后第一句却只有‘结束了吗’。现在冷静下来回想，术前夜我居然光着身子一本正经地宣布‘退出形象管理’、还因为没有退路而怕得向你撒娇……实在不怎么符合我平时的作风。
success.text_en: I had prepared quite a few lines in advance, yet upon waking, the only words that came out were 'Is it over?' Looking back calmly now, sitting naked two nights ago solemnly announcing my 'withdrawal from image management' and acting spoiled because there was no way out... hardly fits my usual conduct.

success.speaker: player
success.text: 但那份‘患者证言’非常可爱。
success.text_en: That 'patient testimony' was remarkably endearing, though.

success.speaker: patient
success.text: 你就别取笑我了……不过，一想起那天夜里与你合为一体、连自己乱掉的表情都顾不上的欢愉，这十几个小时的空白倒也显得没那么漫长了。谢谢你，隆司。
success.text_en: Spare me your teasing... Still, whenever I recall becoming one with you that night and the bliss of not even caring about my own undone expression, those ten-plus blank hours don't feel quite so long. Thank you, Takashi.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 看来前天夜里我盯着窗帘觉得心神不宁、预感明天在台上会很狼狈，并不是毫无根据的直觉呢。
failure.text_en: It seems staring at the curtains two nights ago feeling restless, with a premonition that I would look disheveled on the table tomorrow, wasn't an unfounded intuition after all.

failure.speaker: player
failure.text: 手术记录我都带来了，这次没能按计划完成。
failure.text_en: I've brought the operative records. We couldn't complete it as planned this time.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 根据我的现场调查，有一项嫌疑不得不排查一下——主刀坂口医生，是不是因为术前夜在特别病房里太过卖力地让我舒服、把精力全交代在我身体最深处了，第二天上台才出现了操作偏差？
failure.text_en: Based on my on-site investigation, there is one lead I must rule out—Lead Surgeon Sakaguchi, did you exert yourself a little too thoroughly making me feel good in the Special Ward on the night before surgery, pouring all your energy into my deepest place and causing a technical deviation at the table the next day?

failure.speaker: narrator
failure.text: 她迎着坂口的目光微微一笑，清冷的眉眼间染上一丝回味的绯红，轻轻握住他的手。
failure.text_en: Meeting Sakaguchi's eyes with a faint smile, a blush of recollection warms her cool brow as she gently clasps his hand.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 开个玩笑而已。虽然手术未达目标让人有些遗憾，但回想起前天晚上在你身下彻彻底底放开自我的滋味……这趟手术台我躺得心甘情愿。来，把记录念给我听吧。
failure.text_en: Just a small jest. Although falling short of the surgical target is regrettable, whenever I savor the feeling of letting myself go completely beneath you two nights ago... I lay on this operating table without a single regret. Come, read me the record.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 你今天可以什么也不知道。只知道我很想和你合为一体就够了。
dark.text_en: Tonight you don't need to know a thing. Knowing how badly I want to become one with you is enough.

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 亲吻，暗灯。
dark.text_en: They kiss as the lights dim.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 嗯……我还以为脱光的时候我会更拘谨。
dark.text_en: Mmn... I thought I would be more reserved once completely undressed.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 啊……别急着说话，手再往下一点……那里已经湿了。
dark.text_en: Ah... Don't rush to speak, move your hand a little lower... I'm already wet down there.

dark.speaker: player
dark.text: 冴子。
dark.text_en: Saeko.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: ……你这样叫我，我会想笑……唔、快进来吧……
dark.text_en: ...When you call my name like that, it makes me want to smile... Nnh, hurry and come inside...

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 当坂口沉身挺入最深处，这位平时冷静的调查员猛地绷紧了脚背，清冷的声线瞬间染上了浓重的鼻音与颤抖。
dark.text_en: As Sakaguchi sinks deep to her core, the usually composed investigator arches her insteps tautly, her cool voice instantly thick with nasal tremors.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 啊——！唔、哈啊……现在不需要观察任何人，包括我自己已经乱掉的表情……
dark.text_en: Aah—! Nnh, haah... Right now there's no need to observe anyone, including my own undone expression...

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 嗯、啊……顶得太深了……今晚不要问我在想什么……我确实很舒服、很开心……啊、不行了、要去了——啊啊……！
dark.text_en: Mmn, ah... You're pressing so deep... Don't ask what I'm thinking tonight... I truly feel wonderful, truly happy... Ah, I can't—I'm coming—aah...!

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 画面全黑，时间推移。
dark.text_en: Full fade to black as time advances.

doc_takemi.title: 手术室幽灵也会怕针
doc_takemi.title_en: Even the OR Ghost Fears the Needle

consult.speaker: narrator
consult.text: 武見漫不经心地用笔在术式旁画了一圈，指尖却一直敲桌面。
consult.text_en: Takemi carelessly draws a circle next to the procedure name with her pen, though her fingertips keep tapping the desk.

consult.speaker: patient
consult.text: 真想看看主刀会怎么处理那个难点。可惜我明天一进全麻，连看都看不到，更别说半路反悔从台上爬起来教你们开刀了。
consult.text_en: I'd love to watch how the lead surgeon handles that tricky step. Too bad the second I go under general anesthesia tomorrow, I won't even get to watch—let alone change my mind halfway, climb off the table, and lecture you on how to cut.

consult.speaker: player
consult.text: 你不会作为术者在场，而且签字后直到缝合结束都不能下台。
consult.text_en: You won't be present as an operator, and once you sign, there's no getting off the table until closure is finished.

consult.speaker: patient
consult.text: 知道。……这比任何惩罚都适合用来对付多嘴的医生。好啦，我签。
consult.text_en: I know. ...No punishment could be better suited for a mouthy doctor. Alright, I'm signing.

night.speaker: narrator
night.text: 武見懒懒靠在床头，望着坂口进门，挑起眉毛。
night.text_en: Lounging lazily against the headboard, Takemi raises an eyebrow as she watches Sakaguchi walk in.

night.speaker: patient
night.text: 今天我是患者。你不是来检查刀口的吧？
night.text_en: Today I'm the patient. You didn't come to inspect my incision before making it, did you?

night.speaker: player
night.text: 还没开刀。
night.text_en: We haven't operated yet.

night.speaker: patient
night.text: 那正好。今晚留下来，陪你的女朋友。……不准把这个说成术前镇静。
night.text_en: Perfect. Then stay the night and keep your girlfriend company. ...And don't you dare log this as pre-op sedation.

night.speaker: narrator
night.text: 他反锁门，脱去衣物；武見慵懒地解开病号服，褪下紫黑色蕾丝内衣与内裤随手放到椅上，大方地展露着成熟的裸体，掀开被单，先用眼神催促他靠近，再自己轻轻一笑。
night.text_en: He locks the door and removes his clothes; lazily unbuttoning her hospital gown, Takemi slips off her alluring purple-black lace bra and panties, tosses them onto the chair, and generously displays her mature naked body as she lifts the sheet, urging him closer with her eyes before chuckling.

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她满脸潮红地靠在床头，像想起什么绝妙笑话一样，忽然笑得赤裸的肩膀都在动。
after.text_en: Leaning against the headboard with flushed cheeks, she suddenly laughs as if recalling a brilliant joke, her bare shoulders shaking.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 你知道吗？手术室里那个最喜欢看大术野的地下女医，刚才在床上被你折腾得够呛，明天还要被全麻强制关机十几个小时，躺着让你们把肚子切开。
after.text_en: You know what? That underground doctor who loves staring into wide-open surgical fields just got worked over in bed by you, and tomorrow she gets forcibly powered down under general anesthesia for over ten hours while you guys cut her belly open.

after.speaker: player
after.text: 你似乎很在意自己看不见这件事。
after.text_en: Not being able to watch really bothers you, doesn't it?

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 我更在意同意书一旦签了就没法叫停，他们会在我睡着的时候在我身体里干那么多活，醒来还得先等你们汇报。我明明活着，却连当场挑刺的机会都没了。
after.text_en: What bothers me more is that once the consent form is signed, there's no calling a halt—you guys will be doing all that work inside my body while I'm asleep, and I have to wait until I wake up just to hear your report. I'm alive, yet I don't even get a chance to nitpick on the spot.

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她伸手捞起病服和紫黑色内裤，刚伸开，又直接丢回去。
after.text_en: Reaching out to snag her hospital gown and purple-black panties, she unfolds them halfway before tossing them right back.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 算啦，衣服也不穿了。明天反正由护士正式做准备，不如今晚先光着待在这儿当一具不想动的‘活体标本’。
after.text_en: Forget it, I'm leaving the clothes off. The nurses are doing formal prep tomorrow morning anyway, so tonight I might as well lie here naked as an unmoving 'living specimen.'

after.speaker: player
after.text: 这个笑话不太吉利。
after.text_en: That joke is a little ominous.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 我知道不会有什么不可逆的事！……正因为知道百分百安全、却已经没有任何退路，自己还吓成这样才更可笑。
after.text_en: I know nothing irreversible will happen! ...Knowing it's 100% safe while having zero avenues of retreat—and still getting this jittery—is what makes it so laughable.

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她将被单拉上来，冷冷地看向门口。
after.text_en: Pulling the sheet up, she casts a cool glance toward the door.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 明早她们一推床，我估计连一句像样的挖苦都说不出。最可怕的不是刀，是我居然会乖乖闭嘴等她们打针。
after.text_en: When they wheel the gurney in tomorrow morning, I doubt I'll even manage a decentwisecrack. The scariest part isn't the scalpel—it's the fact that I'll actually shut my mouth obediently and wait for the needle.

after.speaker: player
after.text: 你可以在那之前告诉大家自己会怕。
after.text_en: You can tell everyone beforehand that you're scared.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 我可以。……但今晚先借个肩膀，别逼我变成一个善于表达的好患者。
after.text_en: I could. ...For tonight, though, just lend me your shoulder and don't force me to be an expressive model patient.

success.speaker: patient
success.text: 我现在依然想就那几个步骤跟你争辩，不过先让我把这杯水喝完。……啧，现在醒过来回想，术前夜我居然光着身子把内裤丢在一边、说什么当‘活体标本’，还怕得跟你要肩膀靠，真是太没出息了，绝对不准传出去。
success.text_en: I still want to argue with you over a few of those surgical steps, right after I finish this glass of water. ...Tch, waking up now and remembering how I tossed my panties aside naked two nights ago calling myself a 'living specimen' and asking to borrow your shoulder out of fear... how pathetic. Breathe a word of that outside and you're dead.

success.speaker: player
success.text: 我只记得那天晚上的‘活体标本’在床上非常热情。
success.text_en: All I remember is how enthusiastic that 'living specimen' was in bed.

success.speaker: patient
success.text: 你还敢贫嘴？……不过算了，回味起那天夜里被你弄得乱七八糟、奢侈地爽了一整晚的滋味，这十几个小时的‘强制关机’倒也挺划算的。来，让我听听你的手术汇报。
success.text_en: Getting cheeky with me now? ...Forget it. Whenever I savor getting thoroughly wrecked by you that night and indulging in a whole night of luxury pleasure, those ten-plus hours of 'forced shutdown' were a pretty fair trade. Come on, let's hear your operative report.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 哼，我就说前天晚上我怎么想怎么不踏实，总觉得自己睡着了没办法当场挑刺肯定会出状况，结果还真让你给停下来了吧。
failure.text_en: Hmph, I knew feeling restless two nights ago—figuring something would go sideways if I was asleep and couldn't nitpick on the spot—was right on the money. You really had to call a halt!

failure.speaker: player
failure.text: 停下来是对的，这是按临床安全标准做的决定。
failure.text_en: Calling a halt was the right move by clinical safety standards.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 决定本身我没意见。不过我的大主刀——你是不是手术前夜在床上对我太不客气、把体力全花在怎么让我叫得好听上了，结果第二天进了手术室反而手软了？
failure.text_en: I have no issue with the call itself. Though tell me, my grand lead surgeon—did you get so rough with me in bed on the night before surgery, pouring all your stamina into making me moan sweetly, that your hands went soft once you stepped into the OR the next day?

failure.speaker: narrator
failure.text: 她挑起嘴角似笑非笑地睨着他，随后懒洋洋地伸手勾住他的领带往下拉了拉。
failure.text_en: Curling her lips into a half-smile, she lazily reaches out to hook her finger around his necktie and tugs it down slightly.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 行了，别摆出那副检讨的脸。虽然手术没做成让我很不甘心，但光凭术前夜在你身下尝到的那份快感，这趟手术台我也没白躺。等我恢复了，准备好迎接一场难听的病例讨论吧。
failure.text_en: Drop the repentant face. Even if falling short leaves me unsatisfied, the sheer pleasure I tasted beneath you on the pre-op night more than paid for my time on that operating table. Once I'm recovered, get ready for a brutal case conference.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 看够了？过来。今天不用查体，直接做正事。
dark.text_en: Had enough of a look? Get over here. Skip the physical exam tonight and get straight to business.

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 相拥接吻，灯暗。
dark.text_en: They embrace and kiss as the lights dim.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 嗯……挺会哄人的嘛，手一上来就摸对地方了。
dark.text_en: Mmn... You sure know how to coax a woman, putting your hands in the exact right spots from the start.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 啊……别让我叫得太好听，我不习惯……唔、下面已经够湿了，别磨蹭……
dark.text_en: Ah... Don't make me moan too sweetly, it's not my style... Nnh, I'm plenty wet down there already, stop stalling...

dark.speaker: player
dark.text: 那我不客气了。
dark.text_en: Then I won't hold back.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 谁让你客气了？……快点进来，再亲我一次。
dark.text_en: Who asked you to hold back? ...Hurry up and come inside, and kiss me again.

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 坂口沉腰猛地深入到底，武見发出一声低沉而性感的喘息，修长的双腿顺势勾住他的腰，在激烈的律动中仰起了头。
dark.text_en: Sakaguchi sinks his hips and drives all the way to the hilt; Takemi lets out a low, sultry gasp, hooking her long legs around his waist as she tilts her head back amidst the fierce rhythm.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 啊——！哈啊、今晚没什么手术室幽灵，只有被你弄得乱七八糟的我……
dark.text_en: Aah—! Haah, there's no OR ghost tonight, just me getting thoroughly wrecked by you...

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 嗯、啊……这种快感还挺奢侈的……再用力一点，我明天可没机会在台上继续缠着你……啊、要去了，别开灯——啊啊……！
dark.text_en: Nnh, ah... Pleasure like this is quite the luxury... Harder—I won't get a chance to pester you on the table tomorrow... Ah, I'm coming, leave the lights off—aah...!

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 真正黑屏，时间跳过。
dark.text_en: Full fade to black as time skips forward.

nurse_takano_miyo.title: 病人栏的那个人是我
nurse_takano_miyo.title_en: The Name in the Patient Field Is Mine

consult.speaker: narrator
consult.text: 鹰野护士低头看了一眼腕带，忽然主动要求再核对一次姓名与本人。
consult.text_en: Glancing down at her wristband, Nurse Takano suddenly requests one more verification of her name and identity.

consult.speaker: patient
consult.text: 可以再念一次吗？我想听见你们确认，明天那个签了字就不能下台的患者究竟是谁。
consult.text_en: Would you read it out loud one more time? I want to hear you confirm who it is that's signing away her right to get off the table tomorrow.

consult.speaker: player
consult.text: 是你本人。不是只核对一行名字。
consult.text_en: It's you in person. Not just a name on a chart.

consult.speaker: patient
consult.text: ……谢谢。这样我反而安心一点。那我签字了。
consult.text_en: ...Thank you. Hearing that actually puts me a little more at ease. I'll sign now.

night.speaker: narrator
night.text: 她看着门上的患者姓名牌，像在看一张不该出现在这里的名片。
night.text_en: She gazes at the patient nameplate by the door as if looking at a calling card that shouldn't exist here.

night.speaker: patient
night.text: 白天你叫这个名字，是在安排患者；现在你再叫一次，我想知道有没有不同。
night.text_en: When you called this name during the day, you were scheduling a patient; call it once more right now—I want to know if it sounds different.

night.speaker: player
night.text: 三四。
night.text_en: Miyo.

night.speaker: patient
night.text: ……有。留下来，做我的恋人吧。今晚不必把我放回患者栏。
night.text_en: ...It does. Stay with me and be my lover tonight. Don't put me back in the patient column until morning.

night.speaker: narrator
night.text: 坂口锁好门，脱去衣物。她缓缓换下病号服，解开淡紫色蕾丝胸罩与内裤，将衣物放到房间最不起眼的角落，赤着身躯坐回床边，伸手牵住他。
night.text_en: Sakaguchi locks the door and removes his clothes. Slowly changing out of her hospital gown, she unfastens her lavender lace bra and panties, places her clothes in the most inconspicuous corner of the room, and sits naked on the edge of the bed, reaching out to take his hand.

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她依偎在坂口怀里，盯着床头那张“明日手术”的牌子，忽然笑了一声。
after.text_en: Nestled in Sakaguchi's arms with flushed cheeks, she stares at the *"Surgery Tomorrow"* sign at the head of the bed and lets out a sudden laugh.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 我刚想到一件很好笑的事。明天有十几个人围着一位叫三四的患者忙十几个小时，真刀真枪地切开又缝上，偏偏最该知道发生什么的那个人要全麻睡着。
after.text_en: I just thought of something terribly funny. Tomorrow, over a dozen people will spend ten-plus hours bustling around a patient named Miyo, cutting her open and sewing her back up for real, while the one person who ought to know what's happening most sleeps right through it under general anesthesia.

after.speaker: player
after.text: 醒来以后，你会知道结果。
after.text_en: You'll know the result when you wake up.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 这不是结果的问题。刚才在你身下，我能自己说想要多深、想要多久；明天日程已经锁死，她们替我换衣、戴帽子、摆好体位，我连说一句‘今天算了吧’的权利都没有，只能在麻醉前短短几分钟里把你看仔细一点。
after.text_en: It isn't about the result. Beneath you just now, I could ask for how deep and how long I wanted it; tomorrow the schedule is locked, the nurses will change my gown, put on my cap, and position my body, and I don't even have the right to say 'let's call it off today'—only a few brief minutes before anesthesia to look at you closely.

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她微笑着看了一眼角落里的淡紫色内衣和病服，下一秒又像忽然赌气般缩回被窝。
after.text_en: Smiling toward the lavender underwear and hospital gown in the corner, she suddenly shrinks back under the covers as if in a sulk.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 不如我今晚就保持这样光着吧。既然明天一定要接受全套准备，我索性不再穿衣，等她们早上来把我送去手术台。很荒唐吧？
after.text_en: Perhaps I'll just stay naked like this tonight. Since I must undergo full prep tomorrow anyway, I might as well leave my clothes off and wait for the morning nurses to deliver me to the operating table. Absurd, isn't it?

after.speaker: player
after.text: 确实有点。
after.text_en: A little.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: ……我居然真的认真考虑了三秒钟。
after.text_en: ...I actually considered it seriously for three whole seconds.

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: 她自己笑了，随后笑声断掉。
after.text_en: She laughs at herself, before her laughter trails off.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: 明早如果我突然抓住护士的手，说‘我还不想进去’，即使按规矩必须把我推进去，你能不能替我跟她们解释：我平时并没有这么难缠？
after.text_en: Tomorrow morning, if I suddenly grab the nurse's hand and say 'I don't want to go in yet'—even though protocol says they must wheel me in—will you explain to them that I'm not usually this difficult?

after.speaker: player
after.text: 也许不用解释。她们只需要知道你害怕。
after.text_en: Perhaps no explanation is needed. They only need to know you're scared.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: ……你说得对。今晚就先只记住我这个样子。
after.text_en: ...You're right. For tonight, just remember me as I am right now.

success.speaker: patient
success.text: 麻醉前有人叫我的名字，苏醒后也有人叫，中间十几个小时像是大家替我保管了一段人生。现在醒来想想，前天晚上我居然认真考虑了三秒钟‘干脆光着身子等早班护士来推上台’、还怕得想抓别人的手……真是有点不好意思呢。
success.text_en: Someone called my name before anesthesia, and someone called it when I woke up; the ten-plus hours in between felt as though everyone were keeping a slice of my life in safekeeping for me. Waking up now and remembering how I seriously considered staying naked for three seconds waiting for the morning nurses, and was scared enough to cling to someone's hand... is rather embarrassing.

success.speaker: player
success.text: 毕竟那晚的三四可是一点定力都没有。
success.text_en: After all, the Miyo of that night had zero self-control.

success.speaker: patient
success.text: 呵呵，你还记得那句话呀……不过，一想起那天夜里你顶进来的每一次心跳、把我的身体彻底填满的余温，我就觉得这段被保管的人生非常圆满。
success.text_en: Hehe, you still remember that line... Still, whenever I recall every heartbeat as you pressed inside me that night and the lingering warmth that filled my body completely, I feel this slice of life kept in safekeeping was wonderfully complete.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 看来前天晚上我盯着‘明日手术’的牌子觉得心慌、总遗憾自己睡着了什么都不知道，果然是因为隐约预感到了这次结果会留一点遗憾呢。
failure.text_en: It seems staring at the 'Surgery Tomorrow' sign two nights ago feeling uneasy, regretting that I would sleep through everything without knowing, was a faint premonition that this outcome would leave a small regret.

failure.speaker: player
failure.text: 抱歉，三四，这次没能按计划完成，我会把详细报告给你。
failure.text_en: I'm sorry, Miyo. We couldn't complete it as planned this time—I'll give you the detailed report.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 我不急着当冷静的观察员哦。只是我在想……坂口医生是不是手术前夜在床上太放肆了，只顾着满足我‘想要多深、想要多久’的要求，结果第二天站在手术台前反而精神不济了呢？
failure.text_en: I'm in no rush to play the detached observer. I was just wondering... did Dr. Sakaguchi get a little too bold in bed on the night before surgery, focusing so hard on granting every wish of mine for 'how deep and how long' that his spirits flagged at the operating table the next day?

failure.speaker: narrator
failure.text: 她轻笑着歪了歪头，手指温柔地摩挲着他的手背，眼神里满是眷恋。
failure.text_en: Tilting her head with a soft laugh, her fingers caress the back of his hand with unmistakable fondness.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 开玩笑的。虽然想到那十几个小时里没能完成目标会有一点难过，但只要回味起术前夜在你怀里真真切切感受到的爱抚与高潮……这趟手术台，三四躺得一点也不后悔。
failure.text_en: I'm only teasing. Although thinking about how the goal wasn't reached during those ten-plus hours makes me a little sad, as long as I savor the caresses and climaxes I felt so vividly in your arms on the pre-op night... Miyo doesn't regret lying on this operating table one bit.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 你看，今晚的我不会消失。……靠近点，好好感受我。
dark.text_en: See? Tonight's me won't vanish. ...Come closer and feel me properly.

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 他们轻轻亲吻，灯光暗去。
dark.text_en: They kiss softly as the lights dim.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 嗯……再叫我一次，手也可以再放肆一点。
dark.text_en: Mmn... Call my name again, and let your hands be a little bolder.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 啊……你怎么把我摸得像个一点定力都没有的普通女人……
dark.text_en: Ah... How are you touching me until I'm reduced to an ordinary woman with zero self-control...

dark.speaker: player
dark.text: 你就是我的恋人。
dark.text_en: You're my lover.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: ……这答案真好。……唔、下面已经湿透了……现在不要问我今天观察到了什么，直接进来吧。
dark.text_en: ...What a lovely answer. ...Nnh, I'm already soaked down there... Don't ask me what I observed today, just come straight inside.

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 坂口沉身进入她温暖紧致的深处，鹰野发出一声绵长的叹息，双臂紧紧缠住他的脖颈。
dark.text_en: Sakaguchi sinks his hips into her warm, tight depths; Takano lets out a long, lingering sigh, wrapping both arms tightly around his neck.

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 啊——！哈啊、好深……再亲我一下，让我认真高兴一会儿……
dark.text_en: Aah—! Haah, so deep... Kiss me again, let me revel in this joy for a while...

dark.speaker: patient
dark.text: 我想记住你顶进来的每一次心跳……啊、嗯……三四现在全都是你的……要、要去了——啊啊……！
dark.text_en: I want to remember every heartbeat as you press inside me... Ah, mmn... Miyo belongs entirely to you right now... I-I'm coming—aah...!

dark.speaker: narrator
dark.text: 画面彻底黑，时间跳过。
dark.text_en: Full fade to black as time skips forward.

consult.speaker: player
consult.text: 手术是〈本次术式〉。这是真正按高级手术流程执行的一台大手术，不是比划两下的示范演习。先把准备项目、团队安排和预计时间看完。
consult.text_en: The procedure is 〈本次术式〉. This is a full-scale advanced operation executed to exact clinical standards, not a mock drill. Take a look through the prep items, team roster, and estimated duration first.

consult.speaker: player
consult.text: 全麻期间，你不会清醒地经历手术；院内的特殊复原机制也保障你术后会完全恢复，不会留下任何永久损伤。但手术本身是真刀真枪的——切开、止血、切除、缝合，每一步都会在你身上完整做完。
consult.text_en: Under general anesthesia, you won't experience the surgery while awake; our hospital's special recovery mechanism also guarantees you will heal completely afterward with zero permanent damage. However, the operation itself is completely real—incision, hemostasis, resection, and closure will all be carried out on your body from start to finish.

consult.speaker: player
consult.text: 在落笔之前，你随时可以暂缓。但只要签下名字、扣上腕带，全院的手术室排班和准备流程就会正式锁定，直到手术完成前都不能中途取消。想清楚了吗？
consult.text_en: Before you put pen to paper, you are free to put this on hold. But the moment you sign your name and snap on that wristband, the hospital's OR schedule and prep workflow are officially locked—there is no canceling halfway until the surgery is over. Have you thought it through?

night.speaker: narrator
night.text: 特别病房。她把术前计划放到桌面。
night.text_en: Special Ward. She sets the surgical plan down on the table.

night.speaker: patient
night.text: 我本来以为，做过一次这种大手术就不会再怕了。
night.text_en: I used to think that once I'd been through a major operation like this once, I wouldn't be scared a second time.

night.speaker: player
night.text: 结果呢？
night.text_en: And the verdict?

night.speaker: patient
night.text: 结果一看到签完字不能取消的腕带，我更清楚自己在怕什么了。……今晚还愿意陪我吗？
night.text_en: The verdict is that seeing a signed wristband that can't be canceled only makes me know even more clearly what I'm afraid of. ...Will you stay with me tonight too?

night.speaker: narrator
night.text: 双方明确愿意。关门、私密更衣、相拥亲吻，灯暗；以简短非露骨亲昵对白确认当夜，再全黑推进。
night.text_en: Both explicitly consent. Door locked, private undressing, embrace and kiss as lights dim; brief non-explicit affectionate lines confirm the night together before a full fade to black.

after.speaker: patient
after.text: ……真好。明天的事现在终于又有一点勇气面对了。
after.text_en: ...That felt wonderful. Now I finally have a little courage to face tomorrow again.

success.speaker: patient
success.text: 这次比第一次从容多了，连前天晚上在你怀里的温度都记得清清楚楚。谢谢你们。
success.text_en: This time I felt much more composed than the first time—and I still remember the warmth of being in your arms two nights ago crystal clear. Thank you, everyone.

failure.speaker: patient
failure.text: 明明不是第一次了，没做成还是有点不甘心……算了，看在术前夜被你哄得那么舒服的份上，先把记录拿来吧。
failure.text_en: Even though it wasn't my first time, falling short is still a little frustrating... Forget it, considering how wonderfully you coaxed me in bed on the pre-op night, hand over the chart first.
